CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._apply_project_extension_internal(_project_id uuid, _new_start date, _new_end date, _trigger_id uuid, _trigger_kind text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  pr record;
BEGIN
  SELECT id, organization_id, workspace_id, start_date, target_end_date, name
    INTO pr FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;

  UPDATE public.projects
     SET start_date = COALESCE(_new_start, start_date),
         target_end_date = COALESCE(_new_end, target_end_date)
   WHERE id = _project_id;

  PERFORM public.log_activity_event(
    pr.organization_id,
    auth.uid(),
    'parent_extended_for_child_edit',
    'project',
    _project_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'trigger_kind', _trigger_kind,
      'trigger_id',   _trigger_id,
      'old_start',    pr.start_date,
      'old_end',      pr.target_end_date,
      'new_start',    _new_start,
      'new_end',      _new_end
    ),
    pr.workspace_id
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._clone_anchor_for_project(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _start date;
  _earliest date;
BEGIN
  SELECT start_date INTO _start FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF _start IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN _start;
  END IF;

  SELECT MIN(d) INTO _earliest FROM (
    SELECT start_date AS d FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id
    UNION ALL SELECT target_end_date FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id
    UNION ALL SELECT start_date FROM public.phases
      WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
    UNION ALL SELECT target_end_date FROM public.phases
      WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
    UNION ALL SELECT start_date FROM public.tasks
      WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
    UNION ALL SELECT due_date FROM public.tasks
      WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
    UNION ALL SELECT start_date FROM public.sprints
      WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
    UNION ALL SELECT end_date FROM public.sprints
      WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
  ) s WHERE d IS NOT NULL;

  RETURN _earliest;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._gov_derive_cadence_status(_frequency_type text, _next_expected_date date, _archived_at timestamp with time zone, _due_soon_days integer DEFAULT 7)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _archived_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'inactive'
    WHEN _frequency_type = 'ad_hoc' THEN 'ad_hoc'
    WHEN _next_expected_date IS NULL THEN 'no_next_date'
    WHEN _next_expected_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'overdue'
    WHEN _next_expected_date <= CURRENT_DATE + (_due_soon_days || ' days')::interval THEN 'due_soon'
    ELSE 'on_track'
  END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._gov_frequency_next_date(_base_date date, _frequency_type text)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _base_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN _frequency_type = 'weekly'    THEN _base_date + INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN _frequency_type = 'biweekly'  THEN _base_date + INTERVAL '14 days'
    WHEN _frequency_type = 'monthly'   THEN _base_date + INTERVAL '1 month'
    WHEN _frequency_type = 'quarterly' THEN _base_date + INTERVAL '3 months'
    ELSE NULL
  END::date
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._is_allowed_tenant_integration_secret_name(_integration_kind tenant_integration_kind, _secret_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _secret_name IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN _secret_name !~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,48}$' THEN false
    ELSE _secret_name = ANY (
      CASE _integration_kind::text
        WHEN 'openai'          THEN ARRAY['api_key']
        WHEN 'azure_openai'    THEN ARRAY['api_key','endpoint','deployment','api_version']
        WHEN 'microsoft_graph' THEN ARRAY['tenant_id','client_id','client_secret']
        WHEN 'sharepoint'      THEN ARRAY['site_url','site_id']
        -- 'powerbi' branch retired (PBI 6.4C2): generic REST integration is frozen.
        WHEN 'mulesoft_kpi'    THEN ARRAY['api_url','username','password']
        WHEN 'smtp'            THEN ARRAY['host','port','username','password','from_email','from_name']
        ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
      END
    )
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._provision_default_tenant_integrations(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _tenant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.tenant_integrations (tenant_id, kind, name, status, is_enabled, config_metadata)
  SELECT _tenant_id, k.kind::public.tenant_integration_kind, 'default',
         'not_configured'::public.tenant_integration_status, false, '{}'::jsonb
    FROM (VALUES
      ('openai'),
      ('azure_openai'),
      ('microsoft_graph'),
      ('sharepoint'),
      -- 'powerbi' default provisioning retired (PBI 6.4C2).
      ('mulesoft_kpi'),
      ('smtp')
    ) AS k(kind)
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, kind, name) DO NOTHING;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._recompute_phase_actuals(_phase_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_min_start date;
  v_max_end   date;
  v_any_unfinished boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT
    MIN(actual_start_date),
    MAX(actual_end_date),
    bool_or(actual_start_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_end_date IS NULL)
  INTO v_min_start, v_max_end, v_any_unfinished
  FROM public.tasks
  WHERE phase_id = _phase_id
    AND status <> 'cancelled'
    AND is_archived = false;

  IF v_any_unfinished THEN
    v_max_end := NULL;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('app.allow_actual_rollup', 'on', true);
  UPDATE public.phases
  SET actual_start_date = v_min_start,
      actual_end_date   = v_max_end,
      updated_at        = now()
  WHERE id = _phase_id
    AND (actual_start_date IS DISTINCT FROM v_min_start
      OR actual_end_date   IS DISTINCT FROM v_max_end);
  PERFORM set_config('app.allow_actual_rollup', '', true);
END;
$function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$

  USING public.knowledge_articles a

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_get_knowledge_article_ai_metadata(_article_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(article_id uuid, ai_flow text, feature_area text[], route_patterns text[], user_intents text[], audience text[], synonyms text[], freshness_label text, related_feature_flags text[], question_examples text[], answer_rules text[], forbidden_claims text[], created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, created_by uuid, updated_by uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_org uuid := public.get_user_org_id(auth.uid());
BEGIN
  IF v_org IS NULL OR NOT public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), v_org) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    m.article_id,
    m.ai_flow,
    m.feature_area,
    m.route_patterns,
    m.user_intents,
    m.audience,
    m.synonyms,

    public._kc_ai_meta_decrypt_array(m.question_examples_protected, m.organization_id),
    public._kc_ai_meta_decrypt_array(m.answer_rules_protected,      m.organization_id),
    public._kc_ai_meta_decrypt_array(m.forbidden_claims_protected,  m.organization_id),
    m.created_at,
    m.updated_at,
    m.created_by,
    m.updated_by
  FROM public.knowledge_article_ai_metadata m
  JOIN public.knowledge_articles a ON a.id = m.article_id
  WHERE m.article_id = _article_id
    AND a.organization_id = v_org;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_btpm_import_batches(_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, organization_id uuid, workspace_id uuid, workspace_name text, requested_by uuid, requested_by_email text, requested_by_display_name text, schema_version text, import_type text, source_name text, source_file_name text, payload_hash text, status text, counts_json jsonb, safe_summary_json jsonb, safe_issue_summary_json jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone, dry_run_at timestamp with time zone, committed_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _user uuid := auth.uid();
  _active boolean;
BEGIN
  IF _user IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;
  SELECT is_active INTO _active FROM public.profiles WHERE id = _user;
  IF _active IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inactive_user';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(_user, _organization_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'org_admin_required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.organization_id,
    b.workspace_id,
    w.name AS workspace_name,
    b.requested_by,
    p.email AS requested_by_email,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.display_name), ''), p.email) AS requested_by_display_name,
    b.schema_version,
    b.import_type,
    b.source_name,
    b.source_file_name,
    b.payload_hash,
    b.status,
    b.counts_json,
    b.safe_summary_json,
    b.safe_issue_summary_json,
    b.created_at,
    b.dry_run_at,
    b.committed_at
  FROM public.btpm_import_batches b
  LEFT JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = b.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = b.requested_by
  WHERE b.organization_id = _organization_id
  ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 200;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_invitations(_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, status text, role text, workspace_name text, invited_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, is_expired boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), _organization_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: not an organization admin'; END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT inv.id, inv.email, inv.status, inv.role::text, w.name AS workspace_name, inv.created_at AS invited_at, inv.expires_at,
    (inv.status = 'pending' AND inv.expires_at <= now()) AS is_expired
  FROM public.invitations inv LEFT JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = inv.workspace_id
  WHERE inv.organization_id = _organization_id ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_portfolio_items(_organization_id uuid, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(_uid, _organization_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.name_sort), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      pi.id,
      pi.organization_id,
      public.btpm_decrypt(pi.name,        pi.organization_id) AS name,
      public.btpm_decrypt(pi.code,        pi.organization_id) AS code,
      public.btpm_decrypt(pi.description, pi.organization_id) AS description,
      pi.lifecycle_state,
      pi.strategic_priority,
      pi.owner_id,
      pi.is_archived,
      pi.archived_at,
      pi.created_by,
      pi.updated_by,
      pi.created_at,
      pi.updated_at,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.projects p WHERE p.portfolio_item_id = pi.id) AS project_count,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.projects p WHERE p.portfolio_item_id = pi.id AND p.is_archived = false) AS active_project_count,
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT p.workspace_id) FROM public.projects p WHERE p.portfolio_item_id = pi.id) AS workspace_count,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.portfolio_item_team_members tm
         WHERE tm.portfolio_item_id = pi.id AND tm.is_active = true) AS active_team_member_count,
      public.btpm_decrypt(pi.name, pi.organization_id) AS name_sort
    FROM public.portfolio_items pi
    WHERE pi.organization_id = _organization_id
      AND (_include_archived OR pi.is_archived = false)
  ) t;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_portfolio_project_assignment_candidates(_portfolio_item_id uuid, _workspace_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _search text DEFAULT NULL::text, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _org uuid;
  _result jsonb;
  _q text;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;

  SELECT organization_id INTO _org FROM public.portfolio_items WHERE id = _portfolio_item_id;
  IF _org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Portfolio item not found'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(_uid, _org) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized'; END IF;

  _q := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(_search, '')), '');

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.project_name), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id AS project_id,
      public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) AS project_name,
      p.workspace_id,
      w.name AS workspace_name,
      p.program_id,
      (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(pr.name, p.organization_id)
         FROM public.programs pr WHERE pr.id = p.program_id) AS program_name,
      p.status,
      p.priority,
      p.project_stage,
      p.delivery_model,
      p.start_date,
      p.target_end_date,
      p.is_archived,
      p.portfolio_item_id AS current_portfolio_item_id,
      CASE WHEN p.portfolio_item_id IS NOT NULL
           THEN public.btpm_decrypt(cur.name, p.organization_id) END AS current_portfolio_name,
      CASE WHEN p.portfolio_item_id IS NOT NULL
           THEN public.btpm_decrypt(cur.code, p.organization_id) END AS current_portfolio_code,
      CASE
        WHEN p.portfolio_item_id IS NULL THEN 'unassigned'
        WHEN p.portfolio_item_id = _portfolio_item_id THEN 'assigned_to_current'
        ELSE 'assigned_to_other'
      END AS assignment_state
    FROM public.projects p
    JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = p.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN public.portfolio_items cur ON cur.id = p.portfolio_item_id
    WHERE p.organization_id = _org
      AND (_include_archived OR p.is_archived = false)
      AND (_workspace_ids IS NULL OR array_length(_workspace_ids, 1) IS NULL
           OR p.workspace_id = ANY(_workspace_ids))
      AND (p.portfolio_item_id IS DISTINCT FROM _portfolio_item_id)
      AND (
        _q IS NULL
        OR public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) ILIKE '%' || _q || '%'
      )
  ) t;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_project_move_candidates(_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(v_uid, _organization_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized: org admin required';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.project_name), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_rows
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id              AS project_id,
      p.name            AS project_name,
      p.workspace_id    AS source_workspace_id,
      w.name            AS source_workspace_name,
      p.program_id      AS program_id,
      CASE WHEN pg.id IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(pg.name, pg.organization_id) END AS program_name,
      p.status, p.project_stage, p.delivery_model, p.is_archived
    FROM public.projects p
    JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = p.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN public.programs pg ON pg.id = p.program_id
    WHERE p.organization_id = _organization_id
  ) t;

  RETURN v_rows;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_tenant_integrations(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(integration_id uuid, kind tenant_integration_kind, name text, status tenant_integration_status, is_enabled boolean, config_metadata jsonb, has_config_metadata boolean, config_metadata_key_count integer, last_tested_at timestamp with time zone, last_success_at timestamp with time zone, last_error_at timestamp with time zone, last_error_message text, tenant_secret_count integer, active_secret_count integer, organization_override_count integer, required_secret_count integer, configured_required_secret_count integer, missing_required_secret_count integer, configuration_ready boolean, configuration_issue_code text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_caller(_tenant_id);
  RETURN QUERY
    WITH req AS (
      SELECT ti.id AS integration_id,
             public._required_tenant_integration_secret_names(ti.kind) AS names,
             public._required_tenant_integration_config_names(ti.kind) AS config_names
      FROM public.tenant_integrations ti
      WHERE ti.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    ),
    req_counts AS (
      SELECT r.integration_id,
             COALESCE(array_length(r.names, 1), 0) AS required_secret_count,
             (
               SELECT COUNT(*)::int
               FROM unnest(r.names) req_name
               WHERE EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_secret_refs tr
                 WHERE tr.tenant_id = _tenant_id
                   AND tr.integration_id = r.integration_id
                   AND tr.secret_name = req_name
                   AND tr.secret_scope = 'tenant'
                   AND tr.disabled_at IS NULL
                   AND tr.revoked_at IS NULL
                   AND tr.status = 'active'
               )
             ) AS configured_required_secret_count,
             r.config_names AS required_config_names
      FROM req r
    )
    SELECT ti.id,
           ti.kind,
           ti.name,
           ti.status,
           ti.is_enabled,
           '{}'::jsonb AS config_metadata,
           (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
             AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb))) > 0) AS has_config_metadata,
           CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
                THEN (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)))
                ELSE 0 END AS config_metadata_key_count,
           ti.last_tested_at, ti.last_success_at, ti.last_error_at, ti.last_error_message,
           (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r2 WHERE r2.integration_id = ti.id)::int,
           (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r2 WHERE r2.integration_id = ti.id AND r2.status = 'active')::int,
           (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.organization_secret_overrides o WHERE o.integration_id = ti.id)::int,
           rc.required_secret_count,
           rc.configured_required_secret_count,
           GREATEST(rc.required_secret_count - rc.configured_required_secret_count, 0) AS missing_required_secret_count,
           (
             COALESCE(array_length(rc.required_config_names, 1), 0) = 0
             OR NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM unnest(rc.required_config_names) cfg
               WHERE NOT (
                 jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
                 AND COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ? cfg
                 AND jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) -> cfg) = 'string'
                 AND btrim(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ->> cfg) <> ''
               )
             )
           ) AS configuration_ready,
           (
             SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL
                         ELSE 'missing:' || string_agg(cfg, ',' ORDER BY cfg) END
             FROM unnest(rc.required_config_names) cfg
             WHERE NOT (
               jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
               AND COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ? cfg
               AND jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) -> cfg) = 'string'
               AND btrim(COALESCE(ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) ->> cfg) <> ''
             )
           ) AS configuration_issue_code
      FROM public.tenant_integrations ti
      JOIN req_counts rc ON rc.integration_id = ti.id
     WHERE ti.tenant_id = _tenant_id
     ORDER BY ti.kind::text, ti.name;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_preview_project_workspace_move(_organization_id uuid, _project_id uuid, _target_workspace_id uuid, _target_program_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_project public.projects%ROWTYPE;
  v_src_ws public.workspaces%ROWTYPE;
  v_tgt_ws public.workspaces%ROWTYPE;
  v_tgt_pg public.programs%ROWTYPE;
  v_blocking text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
  v_dup boolean := false;
  v_counts jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_access_removed int := 0;
  v_cross_dep int := 0;
  v_program_clear boolean := false;
  v_phases uuid[];
  v_tasks uuid[];
  v_kpis uuid[];
  v_src_program_name text;
  v_tgt_program_name text;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(v_uid, _organization_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized: org admin required';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_project FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_project.organization_id <> _organization_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Project not found in organization';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_src_ws FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = v_project.workspace_id;
  SELECT * INTO v_tgt_ws FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = _target_workspace_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_tgt_ws.organization_id <> _organization_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Target workspace not found in organization';
  END IF;

  IF v_project.is_archived THEN v_blocking := v_blocking || 'project_is_archived'; END IF;
  IF v_src_ws.id = v_tgt_ws.id THEN v_blocking := v_blocking || 'same_workspace'; END IF;
  IF v_src_ws.is_archived OR v_src_ws.is_active = false THEN v_blocking := v_blocking || 'source_workspace_inactive'; END IF;
  IF v_tgt_ws.is_archived OR v_tgt_ws.is_active = false THEN v_blocking := v_blocking || 'target_workspace_inactive'; END IF;

  IF _target_program_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO v_tgt_pg FROM public.programs WHERE id = _target_program_id;
    IF NOT FOUND
       OR v_tgt_pg.organization_id <> _organization_id
       OR v_tgt_pg.workspace_id <> _target_workspace_id
       OR v_tgt_pg.is_archived THEN
      v_blocking := v_blocking || 'invalid_target_program';
    ELSE
      v_tgt_program_name := public.btpm_decrypt(v_tgt_pg.name, v_tgt_pg.organization_id);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  v_program_clear := (v_project.program_id IS NOT NULL AND _target_program_id IS NULL);

  IF v_project.program_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(name, organization_id) INTO v_src_program_name
    FROM public.programs WHERE id = v_project.program_id;
  END IF;

  -- Duplicate name in target workspace (case-insensitive, exclude this project, exclude archived)
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.projects
    WHERE workspace_id = _target_workspace_id
      AND id <> _project_id
      AND is_archived = false
      AND lower(name) = lower(v_project.name)
  ) INTO v_dup;
  IF v_dup THEN v_blocking := v_blocking || 'duplicate_project_name_in_target'; END IF;

  -- Discovery sets
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(id), ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_phases FROM public.phases WHERE project_id = _project_id;
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(id), ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_tasks FROM public.tasks WHERE project_id = _project_id;
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(id), ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_kpis FROM public.kpi_definitions
    WHERE (target_type = 'project' AND target_id = _project_id)
       OR (target_type = 'phase'   AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
       OR (target_type = 'task'    AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks));

  -- Counts (Move Set A direct project-scoped)
  v_counts := jsonb_build_object(
    'phases',                          array_length(v_phases,1),
    'tasks',                           array_length(v_tasks,1),
    'backlog_items',                   (SELECT count(*) FROM public.backlog_items WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'sprints',                         (SELECT count(*) FROM public.sprints WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'board_workflow_states',           (SELECT count(*) FROM public.board_workflow_states WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'project_team_members',            (SELECT count(*) FROM public.project_team_members WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'project_stakeholders',            (SELECT count(*) FROM public.project_stakeholders WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'generated_operational_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.generated_operational_documents WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'governance_cadences',             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.governance_cadences WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'governance_records',              (SELECT count(*) FROM public.governance_records WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'governance_record_decisions',     (SELECT count(*) FROM public.governance_record_decisions WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'governance_record_links',         (SELECT count(*) FROM public.governance_record_links WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'kpi_snapshots',                   (SELECT count(*) FROM public.kpi_snapshots WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'kpi_snapshot_capture_run_items',  (SELECT count(*) FROM public.kpi_snapshot_capture_run_items WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'kpi_app_mappings',                (SELECT count(*) FROM public.kpi_app_mappings WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'kpi_app_submission_outbox',       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.kpi_app_submission_outbox WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'kpi_app_scheduler_run_items',     (SELECT count(*) FROM public.kpi_app_scheduler_run_items WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'powerbi_data_scope_rules',        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.powerbi_data_scope_rules WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'sharepoint_project_bindings',     (SELECT count(*) FROM public.sharepoint_project_bindings WHERE project_id=_project_id),
    'kpi_definitions',                 array_length(v_kpis,1),
    'kpi_updates',                     (SELECT count(*) FROM public.kpi_updates WHERE kpi_definition_id = ANY(v_kpis)),
    'task_assignments',                (SELECT count(*) FROM public.task_assignments WHERE task_id = ANY(v_tasks)),
    'comments',                        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.comments
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'execution_updates',               (SELECT count(*) FROM public.execution_updates
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'activity_events_history',         (SELECT count(*) FROM public.activity_events
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'blockers',                        (SELECT count(*) FROM public.blockers
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'risks',                           (SELECT count(*) FROM public.risks
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'dependencies',                    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.dependencies
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'raci_assignments',                (SELECT count(*) FROM public.raci_assignments
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'notification_outbox',             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.notification_outbox
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'email_payload_snapshots',         (SELECT count(*) FROM public.email_payload_snapshots
                                          WHERE (target_type='project' AND target_id=_project_id)
                                             OR (target_type='phase' AND target_id = ANY(v_phases))
                                             OR (target_type='task'  AND target_id = ANY(v_tasks))),
    'entity_object_links',             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entity_object_links
                                          WHERE (owner_type IN ('project','phase','task') AND (owner_id=_project_id OR owner_id = ANY(v_phases) OR owner_id = ANY(v_tasks)))
                                             OR (referenced_type IN ('project','phase','task') AND (referenced_id=_project_id OR referenced_id = ANY(v_phases) OR referenced_id = ANY(v_tasks)))),
    'entity_user_links',               (SELECT count(*) FROM public.entity_user_links
                                          WHERE owner_type IN ('project','phase','task')
                                            AND (owner_id=_project_id OR owner_id = ANY(v_phases) OR owner_id = ANY(v_tasks)))
  );

  -- Access removal preview
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_access_removed
  FROM public.project_memberships pm
  WHERE pm.project_id = _project_id
    AND pm.removed_at IS NULL
    AND pm.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM public.workspace_memberships WHERE workspace_id = _target_workspace_id);

  -- Cross-workspace dependency warning: dependencies attached to this project whose counterparty resolves to a different workspace
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_cross_dep
  FROM public.dependencies d
  WHERE d.target_type='project' AND d.target_id = _project_id;
  -- (Best-effort signal: count of project-level dependency rows; cross-workspace nature is reported via UI for admin review.)

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'project_id', _project_id,
    'project_name', v_project.name,
    'source_workspace_id', v_src_ws.id,
    'source_workspace_name', v_src_ws.name,
    'target_workspace_id', v_tgt_ws.id,
    'target_workspace_name', v_tgt_ws.name,
    'current_program_id', v_project.program_id,
    'current_program_name', v_src_program_name,
    'target_program_id', _target_program_id,
    'target_program_name', v_tgt_program_name,
    'program_will_be_cleared', v_program_clear,
    'duplicate_name_in_target', v_dup,
    'cross_workspace_dependency_count', v_cross_dep,
    'access_removed_count', v_access_removed,
    'counts', v_counts,
    'blocking_issues', to_jsonb(v_blocking)
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_upsert_tenant_integration(_tenant_id uuid, _kind tenant_integration_kind, _name text DEFAULT 'default'::text, _config jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, _is_enabled boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, _status tenant_integration_status DEFAULT NULL::tenant_integration_status, _reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS tenant_integrations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _row public.tenant_integrations;
  _cfg jsonb := COALESCE(_config, '{}'::jsonb);
BEGIN
  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_or_super(_tenant_id, _reason);

  IF jsonb_typeof(_cfg) <> 'object' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'config_metadata must be a JSON object'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- Phase 4D.10A.5: Fail-closed on ANY non-empty config_metadata. Only '{}'
  -- is permitted until per-integration metadata allowlists are implemented.
  IF _cfg <> '{}'::jsonb THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'config_metadata is disabled until per-integration metadata allowlists are implemented. Store secrets through tenant secret setup only.'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.tenant_integrations (tenant_id, kind, name, config_metadata, is_enabled, status, created_by, updated_by)
  VALUES (_tenant_id, _kind, _name, '{}'::jsonb,
          COALESCE(_is_enabled, false), COALESCE(_status, 'not_configured'), auth.uid(), auth.uid())
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, kind, name) DO UPDATE
    SET is_enabled = COALESCE(_is_enabled, public.tenant_integrations.is_enabled),
        status = COALESCE(_status, public.tenant_integrations.status),
        updated_by = auth.uid(),
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO _row;

  INSERT INTO public.tenant_secret_access_audit(tenant_id, integration_id, actor_user_id, action, reason, function_name, result)
  VALUES (_tenant_id, _row.id, auth.uid(), 'updated', _reason, 'admin_upsert_tenant_integration', 'success');

  RETURN _row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_guide_v2_match_knowledge_chunks(query_embedding extensions.vector, p_organization_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_route text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_feature_area text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], p_intent_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_workflow_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_match_count integer DEFAULT 8, p_min_similarity numeric DEFAULT 0.0)
 RETURNS TABLE(chunk_id uuid, source_type text, article_id uuid, article_slug text, article_title text, source_id text, similarity numeric, hybrid_score numeric, metadata jsonb, route_match boolean, feature_match boolean, workflow_match boolean, source_confidence text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
declare
  _caller_org uuid;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    return;
  end if;
  if p_user_id is null or p_user_id <> auth.uid() then
    return;
  end if;

  _caller_org := public.get_user_org_id(auth.uid());
  if _caller_org is null or _caller_org <> p_organization_id then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with scored as (
    select
      c.id as chunk_id,
      c.source_type,
      c.article_id,
      c.article_slug,
      c.article_title,
      c.source_id,
      (1 - (c.embedding <=> query_embedding))::numeric as similarity,
      c.metadata,
      (p_route is not null and c.route_patterns is not null and p_route = any(c.route_patterns)) as route_match,
      (p_feature_area is not null and c.feature_area is not null and c.feature_area && p_feature_area) as feature_match,
      (p_workflow_id is not null and c.workflow_id is not null and c.workflow_id = p_workflow_id) as workflow_match
    from public.ai_guide_v2_knowledge_chunks c
    where c.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and c.source_status = 'published'
      and c.vector_ready = true
  )
  select
    s.chunk_id,
    s.source_type,
    s.article_id,
    s.article_slug,
    s.article_title,
    s.source_id,
    s.similarity,
    (
      0.55 * s.similarity
      + (case when s.route_match then 0.10 else 0.0 end)
      + (case when s.feature_match then 0.10 else 0.0 end)
      + (case when s.workflow_match then 0.15 else 0.0 end)
    )::numeric as hybrid_score,
    s.metadata,
    s.route_match,
    s.feature_match,
    s.workflow_match,
    case
      when s.similarity >= 0.80 then 'high'
      when s.similarity >= 0.60 then 'medium'
      else 'low'
    end as source_confidence
  from scored s
  where s.similarity >= coalesce(p_min_similarity, 0.0)
  order by hybrid_score desc, s.similarity desc
  limit greatest(coalesce(p_match_count, 8), 1);
end;
$function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_help_admin_list_history_feedback(_date_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, _date_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, _user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _rating text DEFAULT NULL::text, _reason_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, _context_route text DEFAULT NULL::text, _search text DEFAULT NULL::text, _limit integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS TABLE(conversation_id uuid, conversation_title text, conversation_created_at timestamp with time zone, conversation_updated_at timestamp with time zone, user_id uuid, user_email text, user_message_id uuid, user_question text, assistant_message_id uuid, assistant_answer text, source_article_ids uuid[], context_route text, context_label text, assistant_created_at timestamp with time zone, feedback_id uuid, feedback_rating text, feedback_reason_code text, feedback_comment text, feedback_created_at timestamp with time zone, feedback_updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_org uuid := public.get_user_org_id(auth.uid());
  v_lim int  := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(_limit, 500), 1), 1000);
BEGIN
  IF v_org IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), v_org) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH asst AS (
    SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.organization_id, m.user_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(m.content, m.organization_id) AS answer,
           m.source_article_ids, m.context_route,
           public.btpm_decrypt(m.context_label, m.organization_id) AS context_label,
           m.created_at
    FROM public.ai_help_messages m
    WHERE m.organization_id = v_org AND m.role = 'assistant'
  ),
  paired AS (
    SELECT a.*,
           (
             SELECT u.id FROM public.ai_help_messages u
             WHERE u.conversation_id = a.conversation_id
               AND u.role = 'user'
               AND u.created_at <= a.created_at
             ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
           ) AS user_message_id
    FROM asst a
  )
  SELECT
    c.id AS conversation_id,
    public.btpm_decrypt(c.title, c.organization_id) AS conversation_title,
    c.created_at AS conversation_created_at,
    c.updated_at AS conversation_updated_at,
    p.user_id,
    pr.email AS user_email,
    p.user_message_id,
    (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(um.content, um.organization_id)
       FROM public.ai_help_messages um WHERE um.id = p.user_message_id) AS user_question,
    p.id AS assistant_message_id,
    p.answer AS assistant_answer,
    p.source_article_ids,
    p.context_route,
    p.context_label,
    p.created_at AS assistant_created_at,
    f.id AS feedback_id,
    f.rating AS feedback_rating,
    f.reason_code AS feedback_reason_code,
    public.btpm_decrypt(f.comment, f.organization_id) AS feedback_comment,
    f.created_at AS feedback_created_at,
    f.updated_at AS feedback_updated_at
  FROM paired p
  JOIN public.ai_help_conversations c ON c.id = p.conversation_id
  LEFT JOIN public.ai_help_message_feedback f
         ON f.assistant_message_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = p.user_id
  WHERE
    (_date_from IS NULL OR p.created_at >= _date_from)
    AND (_date_to   IS NULL OR p.created_at <= _date_to)
    AND (_user_id   IS NULL OR p.user_id = _user_id)
    AND (
      _rating IS NULL
      OR (_rating = 'none' AND f.id IS NULL)
      OR (_rating IN ('helpful','not_helpful') AND f.rating = _rating)
    )
    AND (_reason_code IS NULL OR f.reason_code = _reason_code)
    AND (_context_route IS NULL OR p.context_route = _context_route)
    AND (
      _search IS NULL OR _search = ''
      OR p.answer ILIKE '%' || _search || '%'
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.ai_help_messages um2
        WHERE um2.id = p.user_message_id
          AND public.btpm_decrypt(um2.content, um2.organization_id) ILIKE '%' || _search || '%'
      )
    )
  ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
  LIMIT v_lim;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_help_list_conversations(_include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, context_route text, context_label text, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, archived_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid := public.get_user_org_id(auth.uid());
BEGIN
  IF v_org IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT c.id,
         public.btpm_decrypt(c.title, c.organization_id),
         c.context_route,
         public.btpm_decrypt(c.context_label, c.organization_id),
         c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.archived_at
  FROM public.ai_help_conversations c
  WHERE c.user_id = auth.uid()
    AND c.organization_id = v_org
    AND (_include_archived OR c.archived_at IS NULL)
  ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
  LIMIT 100;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_help_update_conversation_title(_conversation_id uuid, _title text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_org uuid := public.get_user_org_id(auth.uid());
BEGIN
  IF v_org IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden'; END IF;
  UPDATE public.ai_help_conversations
  SET title = _title
  WHERE id = _conversation_id AND user_id = auth.uid() AND organization_id = v_org;
END; $function$

functions.signature: apply_governance_record_create(_project_id uuid, _event_type text, _actual_date_held date, _cadence_id uuid, _event_name text, _expected_date_snapshot date, _summary text, _decisions_summary text, _external_reference_url text, _sharepoint_evidence_reference text, _record_kind text, _decision_stage text, _decision_question text, _decision_owner_stakeholder_id uuid, _target_decision_date date, _decisions jsonb, _links jsonb, _correlation_id text, _idempotency_key text)
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_governance_record_create(_project_id uuid, _event_type text, _actual_date_held date, _cadence_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _event_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _expected_date_snapshot date DEFAULT NULL::date, _summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decisions_summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, _external_reference_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, _sharepoint_evidence_reference text DEFAULT NULL::text, _record_kind text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decision_stage text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decision_question text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decision_owner_stakeholder_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _target_decision_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _decisions jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, _links jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, _correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, _idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_new_id uuid;
  v_decision_count int := 0;
  v_link_count int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
      'governance_record', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF _decisions IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(_decisions) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
      'governance_record', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','Decisions payload must be a JSON array'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;
  IF _links IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(_links) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
      'governance_record', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','Links payload must be a JSON array'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  -- Server-resolve workspace from the parent Project. If the Project does not
  -- exist, fall through so the delegate returns its canonical invalid error.
  SELECT workspace_id INTO v_workspace_id
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = _project_id;

  IF v_workspace_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT public.can_write_demo(v_actor, v_workspace_id) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
      'governance_record', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    v_new_id := public.create_governance_record(
      _project_id, _event_type, _actual_date_held, _cadence_id, _event_name,
      _expected_date_snapshot, _summary, _decisions_summary,
      _external_reference_url, _sharepoint_evidence_reference,
      _record_kind, _decision_stage, _decision_question,
      _decision_owner_stakeholder_id, _target_decision_date);

    IF _decisions IS NOT NULL THEN
      PERFORM public.set_governance_record_decisions(v_new_id, _decisions);
      v_decision_count := jsonb_array_length(_decisions);
    END IF;
    IF _links IS NOT NULL THEN
      PERFORM public.set_governance_record_links(v_new_id, _links);
      v_link_count := jsonb_array_length(_links);
    END IF;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
        'governance_record', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason', SQLERRM),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
    WHEN invalid_parameter_value
      OR check_violation
      OR not_null_violation
      OR invalid_text_representation
      OR no_data_found
      OR foreign_key_violation
      OR unique_violation
      OR raise_exception THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
        'governance_record', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason', SQLERRM),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END;

  PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
    'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
    _project_id, 'governance_record', v_new_id, NULL,
    _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'project_id', _project_id,
      'event_type', _event_type,
      'record_kind', coalesce(_record_kind,'evidence_record'),
      'decision_stage', _decision_stage,
      'cadence_id', _cadence_id,
      'actual_date_held', _actual_date_held,
      'decisions_provided', (_decisions IS NOT NULL),
      'links_provided', (_links IS NOT NULL),
      'decision_count', v_decision_count,
      'link_count', v_link_count,
      'has_summary', (_summary IS NOT NULL),
      'has_decisions_summary', (_decisions_summary IS NOT NULL),
      'has_external_reference_url', (_external_reference_url IS NOT NULL),
      'has_sharepoint_evidence_reference', (_sharepoint_evidence_reference IS NOT NULL),
      'has_decision_question', (_decision_question IS NOT NULL),
      'has_decision_owner', (_decision_owner_stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL),
      'has_target_decision_date', (_target_decision_date IS NOT NULL)
    ));

  RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_create',
    'governance_record', v_new_id, _project_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_new_id,
      'governance_record_id', v_new_id,
      'decision_count', v_decision_count,
      'link_count', v_link_count),
    '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_governance_record_update(_record_id uuid, _expected_updated_at timestamp with time zone, _event_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _actual_date_held date DEFAULT NULL::date, _cadence_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _event_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _expected_date_snapshot date DEFAULT NULL::date, _summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decisions_summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, _external_reference_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, _sharepoint_evidence_reference text DEFAULT NULL::text, _clear_cadence boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_event_name boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_expected_date_snapshot boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_summary boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_decisions_summary boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_external_reference_url boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_sharepoint_evidence_reference boolean DEFAULT false, _decision_stage text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decision_question text DEFAULT NULL::text, _decision_owner_stakeholder_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _target_decision_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _clear_decision_question boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_decision_owner_stakeholder_id boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_target_decision_date boolean DEFAULT false, _decisions jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, _links jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, _correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, _idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_project_id uuid;
  v_workspace_id uuid;
  v_current_updated_at timestamptz;
  v_decision_count int := 0;
  v_link_count int := 0;
  v_decisions_provided boolean := (_decisions IS NOT NULL);
  v_links_provided boolean := (_links IS NOT NULL);
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_update',
      'governance_record', _record_id, NULL,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF _record_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_update',
      'governance_record', NULL, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','Record id is required'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF _expected_updated_at IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_update',
      'governance_record', _record_id, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','expected_updated_at_required'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF v_decisions_provided AND jsonb_typeof(_decisions) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_update',
      'governance_record', _record_id, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','Decisions payload must be a JSON array'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;
  IF v_links_provided AND jsonb_typeof(_links) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_update',
      'governance_record', _record_id, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','Links payload must be a JSON array'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  -- Lock the record and derive project id + current updated_at for the
  -- PMG envelope, audit, and stale-write check. Do not leak existence:
  -- mirror not_authorized when the record is missing.
  SELECT project_id, updated_at
    INTO v_project_id, v_current_updated_at
    FROM public.governance_records
    WHERE id = _record_id
    FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_governance_record_update',
      'governance_record', _record_id, NULL,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  -- Server-resolve workspace from the parent Project (authoritative).
  SELECT workspace_id INTO v_workspace_id
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = v_project_id;

functions.signature: apply_phase_create(_project_id uuid, _name text, _description text, _status pm_status, _phase_type phase_type, _start_date date, _target_end_date date, _sort_order integer, _correlation_id text, _idempotency_key text)
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_phase_create(_project_id uuid, _name text, _description text DEFAULT NULL::text, _status pm_status DEFAULT 'planned'::pm_status, _phase_type phase_type DEFAULT 'work_item'::phase_type, _start_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _target_end_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _sort_order integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, _correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, _idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_project record;
  v_name text;
  v_description text;
  v_max_sort int;
  v_resolved_sort int;
  v_shifted_count int := 0;
  v_new_id uuid;
  v_new_row record;
  v_data jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Authentication
  IF v_actor IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Active-user gate before any object lookup
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Project existence (non-leaking on missing)
  SELECT id, organization_id, workspace_id, start_date, target_end_date
    INTO v_project
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = _project_id;

  IF v_project.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Authority (project-level PM + demo write gate on resolved workspace)
  IF NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(v_actor, _project_id)
     OR NOT public.can_write_demo(v_actor, v_project.workspace_id) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Name validation
  v_name := btrim(COALESCE(_name, ''));
  IF v_name = '' THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','name_blank'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  IF _description IS NULL THEN
    v_description := NULL;
  ELSE
    v_description := btrim(_description);
    IF v_description = '' THEN
      v_description := NULL;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Date pair validation
  IF _start_date IS NOT NULL AND _target_end_date IS NOT NULL
     AND _start_date > _target_end_date THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','start_after_end'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Sort-order structural validation
  IF _sort_order IS NOT NULL AND _sort_order < 0 THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','sort_order_negative'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Phase window must fit inside Project planned window; do not widen.
  IF _start_date IS NOT NULL AND v_project.start_date IS NOT NULL
     AND _start_date < v_project.start_date THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'confirmation_required'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'reason','phase_start_before_project_start',
        'project_start_date', v_project.start_date,
        'project_target_end_date', v_project.target_end_date,
        'phase_start_date', _start_date,
        'phase_target_end_date', _target_end_date
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb,
      jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'code','extend_project_window_required',
        'required_project_start_date', _start_date,
        'required_project_target_end_date', v_project.target_end_date
      )),
      NULL
    );
  END IF;

  IF _target_end_date IS NOT NULL AND v_project.target_end_date IS NOT NULL
     AND _target_end_date > v_project.target_end_date THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'confirmation_required'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
      'phase', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'reason','phase_end_after_project_end',
        'project_start_date', v_project.start_date,
        'project_target_end_date', v_project.target_end_date,
        'phase_start_date', _start_date,
        'phase_target_end_date', _target_end_date
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb,
      jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
        'code','extend_project_window_required',
        'required_project_start_date', v_project.start_date,
        'required_project_target_end_date', _target_end_date
      )),
      NULL
    );
  END IF;

  -- Lock all current non-archived Phases in this Project to serialize
  -- concurrent create/reorder operations and yield stable append math.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.phases
    WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false
    FOR UPDATE;

  SELECT COALESCE(max(sort_order), -1) INTO v_max_sort
    FROM public.phases
   WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false;

  IF _sort_order IS NULL THEN
    v_resolved_sort := v_max_sort + 1;
  ELSE
    -- Clamp: cannot exceed one-past-the-end of the active sequence.
    IF _sort_order > v_max_sort + 1 THEN
      v_resolved_sort := v_max_sort + 1;
    ELSE
      v_resolved_sort := _sort_order;
    END IF;

    -- Shift siblings at or after the requested position by +1 to open a slot.
    IF v_resolved_sort <= v_max_sort THEN
      WITH shifted AS (
        UPDATE public.phases
           SET sort_order = sort_order + 1
         WHERE project_id = _project_id
           AND is_archived = false
           AND sort_order >= v_resolved_sort
        RETURNING id
      )
      SELECT count(*) INTO v_shifted_count FROM shifted;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Insert canonical fields only. Encryption and updated_at are handled by
  -- existing table triggers. Archive/actual/baseline are system-maintained.
  INSERT INTO public.phases (
    project_id,
    workspace_id,
    organization_id,
    name,
    description,
    status,
    phase_type,
    start_date,
    target_end_date,
    sort_order,
    created_by
  ) VALUES (
    _project_id,
    v_project.workspace_id,
    v_project.organization_id,
    v_name,
    v_description,
    _status,
    _phase_type,
    _start_date,
    _target_end_date,
    v_resolved_sort,
    v_actor
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;

  SELECT id, project_id, workspace_id, organization_id, status, phase_type,
         start_date, target_end_date, sort_order, is_archived, created_at, updated_at
    INTO v_new_row
    FROM public.phases
   WHERE id = v_new_id;

  v_data := jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_new_row.id,
    'project_id', v_new_row.project_id,
    'workspace_id', v_new_row.workspace_id,
    'organization_id', v_new_row.organization_id,
    'status', v_new_row.status,
    'phase_type', v_new_row.phase_type,
    'start_date', v_new_row.start_date,
    'target_end_date', v_new_row.target_end_date,
    'sort_order', v_new_row.sort_order,
    'is_archived', v_new_row.is_archived,
    'created_at', v_new_row.created_at,
    'updated_at', v_new_row.updated_at,
    'shifted_sibling_count', v_shifted_count
  );

  PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
    'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
    _project_id, 'phase', v_new_id, NULL,
    _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'phase_id', v_new_id,
      'resolved_sort_order', v_resolved_sort,
      'shifted_sibling_count', v_shifted_count,
      'has_start_date', (_start_date IS NOT NULL),
      'has_target_end_date', (_target_end_date IS NOT NULL),
      'has_description', (v_description IS NOT NULL),
      'status', _status,
      'phase_type', _phase_type
    )
  );

  RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_phase_create',
    'phase', v_new_id, _project_id,
    v_data, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL
  );
END;
$function$

functions.signature: apply_project_raci_add(_project_id uuid, _raci_role text, _stakeholder_id uuid, _user_id uuid, _correlation_id text, _idempotency_key text)
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_project_raci_add(_project_id uuid, _raci_role text, _stakeholder_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, _idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_project record;
  v_role public.raci_role;
  v_stakeholder record;
  v_effective_user uuid;
  v_existing_id uuid;
  v_new_id uuid;
  v_data jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF _project_id IS NULL OR _raci_role IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','project_id_and_raci_role_required'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF _stakeholder_id IS NULL AND _user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','stakeholder_or_user_required'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    v_role := _raci_role::public.raci_role;
  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation OR others THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','invalid_raci_role'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END;

  SELECT id, workspace_id, organization_id
    INTO v_project
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = _project_id
   FOR SHARE;

  IF v_project.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(v_actor, _project_id)
     OR NOT public.can_write_demo(v_actor, v_project.workspace_id) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  -- Eligibility: stakeholder must belong to the same project (and be active).
  IF _stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id, project_id, user_id, removed_at
      INTO v_stakeholder
      FROM public.project_stakeholders
     WHERE id = _stakeholder_id
     LIMIT 1;

    IF v_stakeholder.id IS NULL
       OR v_stakeholder.project_id <> _project_id
       OR v_stakeholder.removed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
        'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason','stakeholder_not_eligible'),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
    END IF;

    -- Derive user_id from stakeholder when caller passed a user_id too, ensure they match.
    IF _user_id IS NOT NULL AND v_stakeholder.user_id IS NOT NULL AND v_stakeholder.user_id <> _user_id THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
        'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason','stakeholder_user_mismatch'),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
    END IF;

    v_effective_user := v_stakeholder.user_id; -- may be NULL for external
  ELSE
    v_effective_user := _user_id;
    IF v_effective_user IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT public.is_active_user(v_effective_user) THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
        'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason','user_not_eligible'),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Duplicate detection (same target + same stakeholder/user + same role) → no_change.
  SELECT id INTO v_existing_id
    FROM public.raci_assignments
   WHERE target_type = 'project'
     AND target_id = _project_id
     AND raci_role = v_role
     AND (stakeholder_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _stakeholder_id)
     AND (user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_effective_user)
   LIMIT 1;

  IF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_data := jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_existing_id, 'project_id', _project_id,
      'raci_role', v_role, 'stakeholder_id', _stakeholder_id,
      'user_id', v_effective_user);
    PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
      'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
      _project_id, 'raci_assignment', v_existing_id, NULL,
      _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
      jsonb_build_object('workspace_id', v_project.workspace_id, 'reason','already_assigned'));
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
      'raci_assignment', v_existing_id, _project_id,
      v_data, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.raci_assignments (
      organization_id, workspace_id,
      target_type, target_id,
      user_id, stakeholder_id, raci_role
    ) VALUES (
      v_project.organization_id, v_project.workspace_id,
      'project', _project_id,
      v_effective_user, _stakeholder_id, v_role
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN unique_violation THEN
      -- Distinguish accountable-uniqueness from generic dup.
      IF v_role = 'accountable' THEN
        PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
          'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
          'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
          _project_id, 'raci_assignment', NULL, NULL,
          _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
          jsonb_build_object('workspace_id', v_project.workspace_id, 'reason','accountable_already_assigned'));
        RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
          'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
          'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
          jsonb_build_object('reason','accountable_already_assigned'),
          '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
      END IF;
      -- Race: same stakeholder/user/role
      SELECT id INTO v_existing_id
        FROM public.raci_assignments
       WHERE target_type = 'project' AND target_id = _project_id
         AND raci_role = v_role
         AND (stakeholder_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _stakeholder_id)
         AND (user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_effective_user)
       LIMIT 1;
      v_data := jsonb_build_object('id', v_existing_id, 'project_id', _project_id);
      PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
        'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
        'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
        _project_id, 'raci_assignment', v_existing_id, NULL,
        _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
        jsonb_build_object('workspace_id', v_project.workspace_id, 'reason','race_already_assigned'));
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
        'raci_assignment', v_existing_id, _project_id,
        v_data, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
    WHEN foreign_key_violation OR not_null_violation OR check_violation OR invalid_text_representation THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
        'raci_assignment', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason', SQLERRM),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END;

  v_data := jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_new_id, 'project_id', _project_id,
    'raci_role', v_role, 'stakeholder_id', _stakeholder_id,
    'user_id', v_effective_user);

  PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
    'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
    _project_id, 'raci_assignment', v_new_id, NULL,
    _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'workspace_id', v_project.workspace_id,
      'raci_role', v_role,
      'stakeholder_present', _stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL,
      'user_present', v_effective_user IS NOT NULL));

  RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_add',
    'raci_assignment', v_new_id, _project_id,
    v_data, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_project_raci_remove(_assignment_id uuid, _correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, _idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_row record;
  v_project record;
  v_data jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
      'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, NULL,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF _assignment_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
      'raci_assignment', NULL, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','assignment_id_required'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  SELECT id, target_type, target_id, workspace_id, organization_id, raci_role
    INTO v_row
    FROM public.raci_assignments
   WHERE id = _assignment_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_row.id IS NULL THEN
    -- Idempotent: nothing to remove.
    PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
      'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
      'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
      NULL, 'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, NULL,
      _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','not_found'));
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
      'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('id', _assignment_id),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  IF v_row.target_type <> 'project' THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
      'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, NULL,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','unsupported_target_type'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  SELECT id, workspace_id, organization_id
    INTO v_project
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = v_row.target_id
   FOR SHARE;

  IF v_project.id IS NULL
     OR NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(v_actor, v_project.id)
     OR NOT public.can_write_demo(v_actor, v_project.workspace_id) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
      'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, v_row.target_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.raci_assignments WHERE id = _assignment_id;

  v_data := jsonb_build_object(
    'id', _assignment_id,
    'project_id', v_row.target_id,
    'raci_role', v_row.raci_role);

  PERFORM public.pmg_record_command_audit(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
    'btpm_ui'::public.pmg_source_channel,
    v_row.target_id, 'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, NULL,
    _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
    jsonb_build_object('workspace_id', v_project.workspace_id, 'raci_role', v_row.raci_role));

  RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status, 'apply_project_raci_remove',
    'raci_assignment', _assignment_id, v_row.target_id,
    v_data, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.btpm_check_entity_schedule(_type text, _id uuid, _new_start date, _new_end date)
 RETURNS TABLE(side text, other_id uuid, other_name text, other_start date, other_end date)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Outgoing edges: this entity is SOURCE (predecessor). Successors are targets.
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      'predecessor'::text,
      d.target_id,
      ed.name,
      ed.start_date,
      ed.end_date
    FROM public.dependencies d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.btpm_get_entity_dates(d.target_type, d.target_id) ed
    WHERE d.source_id = _id
      AND d.source_type = _type
      AND d.dependency_type = 'finish_to_start'
      AND public.btpm_fs_pair_conflict(_new_end, ed.start_date)
    LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN RETURN; END IF;

  -- Incoming edges: this entity is TARGET (successor). Predecessors are sources.
  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      'successor'::text,
      d.source_id,
      ed.name,
      ed.start_date,
      ed.end_date
    FROM public.dependencies d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.btpm_get_entity_dates(d.source_type, d.source_id) ed
    WHERE d.target_id = _id
      AND d.target_type = _type
      AND d.dependency_type = 'finish_to_start'
      AND public.btpm_fs_pair_conflict(ed.end_date, _new_start)
    LIMIT 1;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.btpm_fs_pair_conflict(_predecessor_end date, _successor_start date)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _predecessor_end IS NULL OR _successor_start IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN _successor_start < _predecessor_end THEN true
    ELSE false
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.btpm_get_entity_dates(_type text, _id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(start_date date, end_date date, name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _type = 'project' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT p.start_date, p.target_end_date, p.name
      FROM public.projects p WHERE p.id = _id;
  ELSIF _type = 'phase' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT ph.start_date, ph.target_end_date, ph.name
      FROM public.phases ph WHERE ph.id = _id;
  ELSIF _type = 'task' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
      SELECT t.start_date, t.due_date, t.name
      FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.id = _id;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_profile(_target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN auth.uid() IS NULL OR _target_user_id IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN auth.uid() = _target_user_id THEN true
      ELSE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.organization_memberships om_viewer
        JOIN public.organization_memberships om_target
          ON om_target.organization_id = om_viewer.organization_id
         AND om_target.tenant_id       = om_viewer.tenant_id
        JOIN public.organizations o
          ON o.id        = om_viewer.organization_id
         AND o.tenant_id = om_viewer.tenant_id
        JOIN public.tenant_memberships tm_viewer
          ON tm_viewer.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
         AND tm_viewer.user_id   = om_viewer.user_id
         AND tm_viewer.status    = 'active'
        JOIN public.tenant_memberships tm_target
          ON tm_target.tenant_id = o.tenant_id
         AND tm_target.user_id   = om_target.user_id
         AND tm_target.status    = 'active'
        WHERE om_viewer.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND om_viewer.status  = 'active'
          AND om_target.user_id = _target_user_id
          AND om_target.status  = 'active'
      )
    END
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.projects p
    JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = p.workspace_id
    WHERE p.id = _project_id
      AND public.is_active_user(_user_id)
      AND (
        public.is_org_admin(_user_id, p.organization_id)
        OR public.is_workspace_admin_or_higher(_user_id, p.workspace_id)
        OR public.is_workspace_member(_user_id, p.workspace_id)
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles pr
          WHERE pr.id = _user_id
            AND w.is_demo = true
            AND w.organization_id = pr.organization_id
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.project_memberships pm
          WHERE pm.project_id = _project_id
            AND pm.user_id = _user_id
            AND pm.removed_at IS NULL
        )
      )
  );
$function$
