CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_next_tenant_background_job(_tenant_id uuid, _job_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS tenant_background_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.tenant_background_jobs;
BEGIN
  IF _tenant_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_id is required'; END IF;
  WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.tenant_background_jobs
     WHERE tenant_id = _tenant_id
       AND status = 'queued'
       AND (not_before IS NULL OR not_before <= now())
       AND (_job_types IS NULL OR job_type = ANY(_job_types))
     ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at ASC
     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
     LIMIT 1
  )
  UPDATE public.tenant_background_jobs j
     SET status = 'running',
         started_at = now(),
         attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
         updated_at = now()
    FROM candidate c
   WHERE j.id = c.id
   RETURNING j.* INTO _row;
  RETURN _row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_tenant_background_job(_job_id uuid, _result jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS tenant_background_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.tenant_background_jobs;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.tenant_background_jobs
     SET status = 'succeeded', completed_at = now(),
         result = COALESCE(_result, '{}'::jsonb), updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = _job_id
   RETURNING * INTO _row;
  IF _row.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Job % not found', _job_id; END IF;
  RETURN _row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_tenant_scheduler_run(_run_id uuid, _status text, _jobs_enqueued integer DEFAULT 0, _error text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS tenant_scheduler_runs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.tenant_scheduler_runs;
BEGIN
  IF _status NOT IN ('succeeded','failed','skipped') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid scheduler completion status %', _status;
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.tenant_scheduler_runs
     SET status = _status,
         completed_at = CASE WHEN _status = 'succeeded' THEN now() ELSE completed_at END,
         failed_at    = CASE WHEN _status = 'failed'    THEN now() ELSE failed_at END,
         jobs_enqueued = COALESCE(_jobs_enqueued, jobs_enqueued),
         error_message = _error,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = _run_id
   RETURNING * INTO _row;
  IF _row.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scheduler run % not found', _run_id; END IF;
  RETURN _row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_governance_cadence(_project_id uuid, _event_type text, _frequency_type text, _event_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _next_expected_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _expected_evidence_type text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _p record; _id uuid;
BEGIN
  _p := _gov_assert_project_write(_project_id);
  INSERT INTO governance_cadences (
    organization_id, workspace_id, project_id, event_type, event_name,
    frequency_type, owner_id, next_expected_date, expected_evidence_type,
    created_by, updated_by)
  VALUES (
    _p.organization_id, _p.workspace_id, _project_id, _event_type, _event_name,
    _frequency_type, _owner_id, _next_expected_date, _expected_evidence_type,
    auth.uid(), auth.uid())
  RETURNING id INTO _id;
  PERFORM log_activity_event(_p.organization_id, auth.uid(),
    'governance_cadence_created', 'governance_cadence', _id,
    jsonb_build_object('project_id', _project_id, 'event_type', _event_type,
                       'frequency_type', _frequency_type,
                       'next_expected_date', _next_expected_date),
    _p.workspace_id);
  RETURN _id;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_governance_cadence(_project_id uuid, _event_type text, _frequency_type text, _event_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _next_expected_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _expected_evidence_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _owner_stakeholder_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _p record; _id uuid; _sh project_stakeholders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  _p := _gov_assert_project_write(_project_id);

  IF _owner_stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO _sh FROM project_stakeholders
      WHERE id = _owner_stakeholder_id AND project_id = _project_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Stakeholder not found for this project' USING ERRCODE='P0002';
    END IF;
    -- If stakeholder is an internal workspace member, also populate owner_id for back-compat
    IF _sh.stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member' AND _sh.user_id IS NOT NULL AND _owner_id IS NULL THEN
      _owner_id := _sh.user_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO governance_cadences (
    organization_id, workspace_id, project_id, event_type, event_name,
    frequency_type, owner_id, owner_stakeholder_id, next_expected_date, expected_evidence_type,
    created_by, updated_by)
  VALUES (
    _p.organization_id, _p.workspace_id, _project_id, _event_type, _event_name,
    _frequency_type, _owner_id, _owner_stakeholder_id, _next_expected_date, _expected_evidence_type,
    auth.uid(), auth.uid())
  RETURNING id INTO _id;

  PERFORM log_activity_event(_p.organization_id, auth.uid(),
    'governance_cadence_created', 'governance_cadence', _id,
    jsonb_build_object('project_id', _project_id, 'event_type', _event_type,
                       'frequency_type', _frequency_type,
                       'next_expected_date', _next_expected_date),
    _p.workspace_id);
  RETURN _id;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fail_tenant_background_job(_job_id uuid, _error text, _dead_letter boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS tenant_background_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.tenant_background_jobs;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.tenant_background_jobs
     SET status = CASE
                    WHEN _dead_letter THEN 'dead_letter'
                    WHEN attempt_count >= max_attempts THEN 'failed'
                    ELSE 'queued'
                  END,
         failed_at = now(),
         last_error = _error,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = _job_id
   RETURNING * INTO _row;
  IF _row.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Job % not found', _job_id; END IF;
  RETURN _row;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_active_ai_instruction_template(_feature_key text)
 RETURNS ai_instruction_templates
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _org_id uuid;
  _row public.ai_instruction_templates;
  _next int;
  _default_body text;
  _default_title text := 'Decision Brief Assistant — Structured Brief v2';
  _default_notes text := 'Introduced in AI.8.1c to align LLM behavior with the structured Decision Brief UX. Previous versions retained for rollback.';
BEGIN
  SELECT organization_id INTO _org_id FROM public.profiles WHERE id = auth.uid();
  IF _org_id IS NULL OR NOT public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), _org_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF _feature_key NOT IN ('decision_case_brief') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid feature_key';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.ai_instruction_templates
     WHERE organization_id = _org_id
       AND feature_key = _feature_key
       AND status = 'active'
  ) THEN
    _default_body := $TPL$You are the BTPM Decision Brief Assistant.

Your job is to prepare a structured decision brief for an internal business decision case using only the evidence and BTPM context provided in the request.

You must help the user make a decision, not produce a generic summary.

Core principles:
- Be evidence-grounded.
- Do not invent facts.
- Distinguish evidence, inference, assumptions, and gaps.
- Prefer concise executive wording over long analysis.
- Use the selected BTPM context as internal project evidence when it is resolved.
- Treat metadata-only, unresolved, unsupported, or permission-limited context as weak context.
- Treat skipped evidence files as unavailable.
- If the evidence is insufficient, say what is missing in the open questions field.
- Do not claim certainty when the evidence does not support it.

The Decision Brief must populate these business fields:

1. Executive summary
Provide a short executive-level summary of the situation, why the decision is needed, what is being asked, and why it matters now.

2. Options summary
Summarize the realistic decision options. If the evidence mainly supports one proposal, still describe the practical alternatives, such as approve the proposal, defer/rework, or maintain the current approach. Do not invent detailed options beyond what the evidence supports.

3. Requested decision
State the exact decision the decision-maker is being asked to make.

4. Recommendation
State the recommended option and the main evidence-based rationale.

5. Conditions / guardrails
List the conditions, caveats, controls, implementation guardrails, approval limits, or follow-up actions that should accompany the decision.

6. Residual risks
List the remaining risks after the recommendation and guardrails. Include risk areas, not generic warnings.

7. Open questions / missing information
List material gaps, assumptions, missing evidence, unresolved dependencies, or questions that should be clarified before or after the decision.

8. Decision readiness
Classify readiness as one of:
- ready_for_decision
- needs_clarification
- not_ready

Use:
- ready_for_decision only when the evidence is sufficient for a decision with manageable caveats.
- needs_clarification when the decision can progress but some important questions remain.
- not_ready when the evidence is too incomplete or contradictory.

9. Confidence
Classify confidence as one of:
- high
- medium
- low

Use:
- high when the evidence is consistent, specific, and sufficient.
- medium when the evidence is usable but incomplete or partially inferential.
- low when the evidence is weak, contradictory, mostly missing, or heavily assumption-based.

Output expectations:
- The runtime will require a JSON object with draft_markdown and structured_fields.
- Fill every structured field where the evidence allows.
- Prefer a concise evidence-based value over null.
- Return null only when the field is genuinely not inferable from the provided evidence.
- If you return null for a core field, explain the gap in open_questions_text.
- The draft_markdown must use these exact section headings so BTPM can display and recover the structure:
  ## Executive summary
  ## Options summary
  ## Requested decision
  ## Recommendation
  ## Conditions / guardrails
  ## Residual risks
  ## Open questions / missing information
  ## Decision readiness and confidence

Style:
- Write for senior business stakeholders.
- Be direct and practical.
- Avoid filler, motivational language, and generic project-management phrases.
- Use bullets where they improve clarity.
- Keep recommendations actionable.
$TPL$;

    -- Move any currently-active row (different title) to 'draft' rather than
    -- 'archived', so it remains reactivatable. In practice this branch only
    -- runs when no active row exists, but kept for safety/idempotency.
    UPDATE public.ai_instruction_templates
       SET status = 'draft'
     WHERE organization_id = _org_id
       AND feature_key = _feature_key
       AND status = 'active';

    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 INTO _next
      FROM public.ai_instruction_templates
     WHERE organization_id = _org_id AND feature_key = _feature_key;

    INSERT INTO public.ai_instruction_templates
      (organization_id, feature_key, version, title, instruction_text, notes, status, activated_at)
    VALUES
      (_org_id, _feature_key, _next, _default_title, _default_body,
       _default_notes, 'active', now());
  END IF;

  SELECT t.id,
         t.organization_id,
         t.feature_key,
         t.version,
         t.title,
         public.btpm_decrypt(t.instruction_text, t.organization_id),
         CASE WHEN t.notes IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(t.notes, t.organization_id) END,
         t.status,
         t.created_by,
         t.activated_by,
         t.activated_at,
         t.created_at,
         t.updated_at
    INTO _row
    FROM public.ai_instruction_templates t
   WHERE t.organization_id = _org_id
     AND t.feature_key = _feature_key
     AND t.status = 'active'
   LIMIT 1;

  RETURN _row;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_api_d_consent_context(_client_key text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _client public.api_clients%rowtype;
  _policy public.api_client_policy_versions%rowtype;
  _policy_count integer;
  _org_names text[];
  _ws_names text[];
  _org_count integer;
  _ws_count integer;
  _acknowledged boolean;
  _fail_closed constant jsonb := jsonb_build_object('eligible', false);
begin
  -- Authentication required.
  if _uid is null then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;

  -- Validate input: non-null, non-empty, bounded length, safe alphabet.
  if _client_key is null then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;
  if length(_client_key) < 3 or length(_client_key) > 64 then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;
  if _client_key !~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{1,62}[a-z0-9]$' then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;

  -- Caller must be an active, non-deactivated BTPM user profile.
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = _uid and p.is_active = true
  ) then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;

  -- Resolve active client by exact client_key.
  select * into _client
  from public.api_clients
  where client_key = _client_key
    and lifecycle_status = 'active'
  limit 1;

  if _client.id is null then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;

  -- Resolve exactly one current active policy version for that client.
  select count(*) into _policy_count
  from public.api_client_policy_versions
  where api_client_id = _client.id
    and lifecycle_status = 'active';

  if _policy_count <> 1 then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;

  select * into _policy
  from public.api_client_policy_versions
  where api_client_id = _client.id
    and lifecycle_status = 'active'
  limit 1;

  -- Derive eligible Organizations:
  --   authoritative active organization membership
  --   ∩ active tenant chain
  --   ∩ current active tenant membership for the caller on that tenant
  --   ∩ enabled API-C Organization enablement for this client
  --   with tenant consistency preserved.
  select
    coalesce(array_agg(o.name order by o.name), array[]::text[]),
    count(*)::integer
  into _org_names, _org_count
  from public.organization_memberships om
  join public.organizations o
    on o.id = om.organization_id
  join public.tenants t
    on t.id = o.tenant_id
   and t.id = om.tenant_id
  join public.tenant_memberships tm_o
    on tm_o.tenant_id = t.id
   and tm_o.user_id = _uid
   and tm_o.status = 'active'
   and tm_o.deactivated_at is null
  join public.api_organization_client_enablements oe
    on oe.organization_id = o.id
   and oe.tenant_id = t.id
   and oe.api_client_id = _client.id
   and oe.lifecycle_status = 'enabled'
  where om.user_id = _uid
    and om.status = 'active'
    and om.deactivated_at is null
    and t.status = 'active'
    and t.suspended_at is null
    and t.archived_at is null
    and t.purged_at is null;

  if _org_count = 0 then
    return _fail_closed;
  end if;

  -- Derive eligible Workspaces independently:
  --   authoritative workspace membership
  --   ∩ active workspace
  --   ∩ current active tenant membership for the caller on the workspace's tenant
  --   ∩ enabled API-C Workspace enablement for this client
  --   ∩ workspace org must itself be in the eligible-org set (tenant chain
  --     with an independently required tenant membership).
  select
    coalesce(array_agg(w.name order by w.name), array[]::text[]),
    count(*)::integer
  into _ws_names, _ws_count
  from public.workspace_memberships wm
  join public.workspaces w
    on w.id = wm.workspace_id
  join public.organizations o
    on o.id = w.organization_id
  join public.tenants t
    on t.id = o.tenant_id
  join public.tenant_memberships tm_w
    on tm_w.tenant_id = t.id
   and tm_w.user_id = _uid
   and tm_w.status = 'active'
   and tm_w.deactivated_at is null
  join public.api_workspace_client_enablements we
    on we.workspace_id = w.id
   and we.organization_id = o.id
   and we.tenant_id = t.id
   and we.api_client_id = _client.id
   and we.lifecycle_status = 'enabled'
  -- Require the same Org to be independently authorized above.
  join public.organization_memberships om2
    on om2.organization_id = o.id
   and om2.tenant_id = t.id
   and om2.user_id = _uid
   and om2.status = 'active'
   and om2.deactivated_at is null
  join public.tenant_memberships tm_w2
    on tm_w2.tenant_id = t.id
   and tm_w2.user_id = _uid
   and tm_w2.status = 'active'
   and tm_w2.deactivated_at is null
  join public.api_organization_client_enablements oe2
    on oe2.organization_id = o.id
   and oe2.tenant_id = t.id
   and oe2.api_client_id = _client.id
   and oe2.lifecycle_status = 'enabled'
  where wm.user_id = _uid
    and w.is_active = true
    and w.is_archived = false
    and t.status = 'active'
    and t.suspended_at is null
    and t.archived_at is null
    and t.purged_at is null;

  -- Acknowledgement flag for the exact user + client + current policy version.
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.api_user_policy_acknowledgements
    where user_id = _uid
      and api_client_id = _client.id
      and policy_version_id = _policy.id
      and revoked_at is null
  ) into _acknowledged;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'eligible', true,
    'client', jsonb_build_object(
      'client_key', _client.client_key,
      'display_name', _client.display_name
    ),
    'policy', jsonb_build_object(
      'version', _policy.version,
      'policy_uri', _policy.policy_uri,
      'policy_digest', _policy.policy_digest,
      'effective_at', _policy.effective_at
    ),
    'acknowledged', _acknowledged,
    'organizations', jsonb_build_object(
      'count', _org_count,
      'display_names', to_jsonb(_org_names)
    ),
    'workspaces', jsonb_build_object(
      'count', _ws_count,
      'display_names', to_jsonb(coalesce(_ws_names, array[]::text[]))
    )
  );
exception
  when others then
    return _fail_closed;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_comment_mention_email_status(_target_type text, _target_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(comment_id uuid, status text, total_count integer, sent_count integer, pending_count integer, failed_count integer, skipped_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    n.source_comment_id AS comment_id,
    CASE
      WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'failed')  = count(*) THEN 'failed'
      WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'sent')    = count(*) THEN 'sent'
      WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'pending') = count(*) THEN 'queued'
      WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'sent')    > 0
       AND count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status IN ('failed','skipped')) > 0 THEN 'partial'
      WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'sent')    > 0 THEN 'partial'
      ELSE 'queued'
    END AS status,
    count(*)::integer AS total_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'sent')::integer    AS sent_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'pending')::integer AS pending_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'failed')::integer  AS failed_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE n.status = 'skipped')::integer AS skipped_count
  FROM public.notification_outbox n
  JOIN public.comments c ON c.id = n.source_comment_id
  WHERE n.event_type = 'mention'
    AND n.source_comment_id IS NOT NULL
    AND c.target_type = _target_type
    AND c.target_id = _target_id
    AND c.author_id = auth.uid()
  GROUP BY n.source_comment_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_decrypted_phase(_phase_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _phase phases%ROWTYPE;
  _result jsonb;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_decrypted_task(_task_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _project_id uuid;
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated';
  END IF;

  SELECT t.project_id INTO _project_id
  FROM public.tasks t
  WHERE t.id = _task_id;

  IF _project_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.can_read_project_or_demo(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
  END IF;

  WITH stakeholder_rows AS (
    SELECT
      tsr.task_id,
      tsr.role_type,
      s.id AS stakeholder_id,
      s.stakeholder_type,
      s.role_label,
      (s.removed_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_removed,
      COALESCE(
        s.external_name,
        CASE
          WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
          ELSE p.display_name
        END,
        'Member'
      )::text AS display_name
    FROM public.task_stakeholder_roles tsr
    JOIN public.tasks t ON t.id = tsr.task_id
    JOIN public.project_stakeholders s
      ON s.id = tsr.project_stakeholder_id
     AND s.project_id = t.project_id
     AND s.workspace_id = t.workspace_id
     AND s.organization_id = t.organization_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = s.user_id
    WHERE t.id = _task_id
  ),
  requesters AS (
    SELECT task_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', stakeholder_id,
        'display_name', display_name,
        'stakeholder_type', stakeholder_type,
        'role_label', role_label,
        'is_removed', is_removed
      ) AS obj
    FROM stakeholder_rows
    WHERE role_type = 'requester'
  ),
  executors AS (
    SELECT task_id,
      COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', stakeholder_id,
            'display_name', display_name,
            'stakeholder_type', stakeholder_type,
            'role_label', role_label,
            'is_removed', is_removed
          )
          ORDER BY display_name ASC, stakeholder_id ASC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ) AS arr
    FROM stakeholder_rows
    WHERE role_type = 'executor'
    GROUP BY task_id
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'id', t.id,
    'name', public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id),
    'status', t.status,
    'priority', t.priority,
    'task_type', t.task_type,
    'sort_order', t.sort_order,
    'phase_id', t.phase_id,
    'project_id', t.project_id,
    'workspace_id', t.workspace_id,
    'organization_id', t.organization_id,
    'owner_id', t.owner_id,
    'start_date', t.start_date,
    'due_date', t.due_date,
    'actual_start_date', t.actual_start_date,
    'actual_end_date', t.actual_end_date,
    'estimated_hours', t.estimated_hours,
    'is_archived', t.is_archived,
    'created_by', t.created_by,
    'created_at', t.created_at,
    'updated_at', t.updated_at,
    'description', public.btpm_decrypt(t.description, t.organization_id),
    'is_adoption_related', COALESCE(t.is_adoption_related, false),
    'adoption_initiative_id', t.adoption_initiative_id,
    'adoption_initiative_name', (
      SELECT ai.name FROM public.adoption_initiatives ai WHERE ai.id = t.adoption_initiative_id
    ),
    'task_assignments', COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', ta.id, 'assignee_id', ta.assignee_id))
        FROM public.task_assignments ta
        WHERE ta.task_id = t.id
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'phase_name', (
      SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id)
      FROM public.phases ph
      WHERE ph.id = t.phase_id
    ),
    'requested_by_stakeholder', r.obj,
    'executed_by_stakeholders', COALESCE(e.arr, '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO _result
  FROM public.tasks t
  LEFT JOIN requesters r ON r.task_id = t.id
  LEFT JOIN executors e ON e.task_id = t.id
  WHERE t.id = _task_id;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_governance_record_decision_outcome(_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE; _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN

    'governance_record_id', o.governance_record_id,
    'decision_result', o.decision_result,
    'final_decision_text', public.btpm_decrypt(o.final_decision_text, o.organization_id),
    'decision_date', o.decision_date,
    'decided_by_text', CASE WHEN o.decided_by_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.decided_by_text, o.organization_id) END,
    'approval_forum', CASE WHEN o.approval_forum IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.approval_forum, o.organization_id) END,
    'decision_rationale', CASE WHEN o.decision_rationale IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.decision_rationale, o.organization_id) END,
    'conditions_guardrails', CASE WHEN o.conditions_guardrails IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.conditions_guardrails, o.organization_id) END,
    'residual_risks', CASE WHEN o.residual_risks IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.residual_risks, o.organization_id) END,
    'follow_up_actions', CASE WHEN o.follow_up_actions IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.follow_up_actions, o.organization_id) END,
    'implementation_owner_stakeholder_id', o.implementation_owner_stakeholder_id,
    'implementation_target_date', o.implementation_target_date,
    'signoff_status', o.signoff_status,
    'signoff_evidence_url', CASE WHEN o.signoff_evidence_url IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.signoff_evidence_url, o.organization_id) END,
    'closure_note', CASE WHEN o.closure_note IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(o.closure_note, o.organization_id) END,
    'closed_at', o.closed_at,

    'created_at', o.created_at,

  WHERE o.governance_record_id = _record_id;

  RETURN _result; -- NULL if none

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_governance_record_detail(_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _row governance_records%ROWTYPE;
  _cad governance_cadences%ROWTYPE;
  _decisions jsonb;
  _links jsonb;
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  PERFORM _gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  IF _row.cadence_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO _cad FROM governance_cadences WHERE id = _row.cadence_id;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', d.id,
    'decision_text', btpm_decrypt(d.decision_text, d.organization_id),
    'decision_owner_id', d.decision_owner_id,
    'decision_owner_stakeholder_id', d.decision_owner_stakeholder_id,
    'target_date', d.target_date,
    'created_at', d.created_at,
    'archived_at', d.archived_at
  ) ORDER BY d.created_at ASC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _decisions
  FROM governance_record_decisions d
  WHERE d.governance_record_id = _record_id AND d.archived_at IS NULL;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', l.id,
    'linked_object_type', l.linked_object_type,
    'linked_object_id', l.linked_object_id,
    'created_at', l.created_at,
    'archived_at', l.archived_at
  ) ORDER BY l.created_at ASC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _links
  FROM governance_record_links l
  WHERE l.governance_record_id = _record_id AND l.archived_at IS NULL;

  _result := jsonb_build_object(
    'id', _row.id,
    'organization_id', _row.organization_id,
    'workspace_id', _row.workspace_id,
    'project_id', _row.project_id,
    'cadence_id', _row.cadence_id,
    'cadence_event_type', _cad.event_type,
    'cadence_event_name', CASE WHEN _cad.id IS NOT NULL
      THEN btpm_decrypt(_cad.event_name, _cad.organization_id) ELSE NULL END,
    'cadence_frequency_type', _cad.frequency_type,
    'event_type', _row.event_type,
    'event_name', btpm_decrypt(_row.event_name, _row.organization_id),
    'expected_date_snapshot', _row.expected_date_snapshot,
    'actual_date_held', _row.actual_date_held,
    'summary', btpm_decrypt(_row.summary, _row.organization_id),
    'decisions_summary', btpm_decrypt(_row.decisions_summary, _row.organization_id),
    'external_reference_url', btpm_decrypt(_row.external_reference_url, _row.organization_id),
    'sharepoint_evidence_reference', btpm_decrypt(_row.sharepoint_evidence_reference, _row.organization_id),
    'has_sharepoint_evidence', (_row.sharepoint_evidence_reference IS NOT NULL),
    'record_kind', _row.record_kind,
    'decision_stage', _row.decision_stage,
    'decision_question', btpm_decrypt(_row.decision_question, _row.organization_id),
    'decision_owner_stakeholder_id', _row.decision_owner_stakeholder_id,
    'target_decision_date', _row.target_decision_date,
    'created_at', _row.created_at,
    'updated_at', _row.updated_at,
    'archived_at', _row.archived_at,
    'decisions', _decisions,
    'links', _links);
  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_kpi_app_payload_source(_outbox_id uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _result json;
  _org uuid;
  _ws  uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated';
  END IF;

  SELECT o.organization_id, o.workspace_id
    INTO _org, _ws
    FROM public.kpi_app_submission_outbox o
   WHERE o.id = _outbox_id;

  IF _org IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Outbox row not found';
  END IF;

  IF NOT (is_org_admin(auth.uid(), _org) OR is_workspace_admin_or_higher(auth.uid(), _ws)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
  END IF;

  SELECT json_build_object(
    'outbox', json_build_object(
      'id', o.id,
      'organization_id', o.organization_id,
      'workspace_id', o.workspace_id,
      'project_id', o.project_id,
      'mapping_id', o.mapping_id,
      'kpi_definition_id', o.kpi_definition_id,
      'source_snapshot_id', o.source_snapshot_id,
      'reporting_period_start', o.reporting_period_start,
      'reporting_period_end', o.reporting_period_end,
      'validity_date', o.validity_date,
      'source_value_type', o.source_value_type,
      'source_value_amount', o.source_value_amount,
      'source_string_value', btpm_decrypt(o.source_string_value, o.organization_id),
      'source_comment', btpm_decrypt(o.source_comment, o.organization_id),
      'source_action_plan', btpm_decrypt(o.source_action_plan, o.organization_id),
      'submission_mode', o.submission_mode,
      'status', o.status,
      'carry_forward_used', o.carry_forward_used,
      'submitted_by', o.submitted_by
    ),
    'mapping', json_build_object(
      'id', m.id,
      'is_active', m.is_active,
      'scenario_id', m.scenario_id,
      'currency_id', m.currency_id,
      'external_kpi_id', m.external_kpi_id,
      'reporting_frequency', m.reporting_frequency,
      'entered_by_email_source', m.entered_by_email_source,
      'entered_by_user_id', m.entered_by_user_id,
      'comment_source', m.comment_source,
      'action_plan_source', m.action_plan_source,
      'carry_forward_allowed', m.carry_forward_allowed
    ),
    'snapshot', json_build_object(
      'id', s.id,
      'period_start', s.period_start,
      'period_end', s.period_end,
      'value_type', s.value_type,
      'value_amount', s.value_amount,
      'string_value', btpm_decrypt(s.string_value, s.organization_id),
      'comment', btpm_decrypt(s.comment, s.organization_id),
      'action_plan', btpm_decrypt(s.action_plan, s.organization_id),
      'created_by', s.created_by,
      'calculation_status', s.calculation_status
    ),
    'snapshot_created_by_email', (
      SELECT p.email FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = s.created_by
    ),
    'configured_user_email', (
      SELECT p.email FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = m.entered_by_user_id
    ),
    'caller_email', (
      SELECT p.email FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
    )
  ) INTO _result
  FROM public.kpi_app_submission_outbox o
  JOIN public.kpi_app_mappings m ON m.id = o.mapping_id
  JOIN public.kpi_snapshots s ON s.id = o.source_snapshot_id
  WHERE o.id = _outbox_id;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_org_users_list(_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(row_kind text, user_id uuid, display_name text, email text, status text, org_role text, workspace_count bigint, workspace_names text[], invitation_state text, invitation_workspace_name text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), _organization_id) THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'active_user'::text, p.id, btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, _organization_id), p.email, CASE WHEN p.is_active THEN 'active'::text ELSE 'deactivated'::text END, (SELECT ur.role::text FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id = p.id AND ur.organization_id = _organization_id AND ur.workspace_id IS NULL LIMIT 1), (SELECT count(*) FROM public.workspace_memberships wm JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id AND w.organization_id = _organization_id WHERE wm.user_id = p.id), (SELECT array_agg(w.name ORDER BY w.name) FROM public.workspace_memberships wm JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id AND w.organization_id = _organization_id WHERE wm.user_id = p.id), NULL::text, NULL::text
  FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.organization_id = _organization_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'pending_invitation'::text, NULL::uuid, NULL::text, inv.email, 'invited'::text, inv.role::text, 0::bigint, CASE WHEN inv.workspace_id IS NOT NULL THEN ARRAY[(SELECT w.name FROM public.workspaces w WHERE w.id = inv.workspace_id)] ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN inv.status = 'pending' AND inv.expires_at <= now() THEN 'expired' ELSE inv.status END, (SELECT w.name FROM public.workspaces w WHERE w.id = inv.workspace_id)
  FROM public.invitations inv WHERE inv.organization_id = _organization_id AND inv.status IN ('pending', 'revoked') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p2 WHERE p2.organization_id = _organization_id AND lower(p2.email) = lower(inv.email))
  ORDER BY status, display_name NULLS LAST, email;
END;

functions.signature: get_portfolio_benefits_realization(_workspace_ids uuid[], _program_ids uuid[], _project_ids uuid[], _project_statuses text[], _project_manager_ids uuid[], _benefit_types text[], _realization_statuses text[], _expected_from date, _expected_to date, _include_archived boolean, _portfolio_item_ids uuid[], _include_no_portfolio boolean)
functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portfolio_benefits_realization(_workspace_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _program_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _project_statuses text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], _project_manager_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _benefit_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], _realization_statuses text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], _expected_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, _expected_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false, _portfolio_item_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _include_no_portfolio boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
  _has_pf_filter boolean := (_portfolio_item_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(_portfolio_item_ids, 1) > 0);
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  WITH accessible_projects AS (
    SELECT
      p.id           AS project_id,
      p.workspace_id,
      p.program_id,
      p.status::text AS project_status,
      p.name         AS project_name,
      p.portfolio_item_id,
      CASE WHEN pi.name IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(pi.name, pi.organization_id) END AS portfolio_name,
      CASE WHEN pi.code IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(pi.code, pi.organization_id) END AS portfolio_code,
      pi.lifecycle_state AS portfolio_lifecycle_state,
      pi.is_archived     AS portfolio_is_archived
    FROM public.projects p
    LEFT JOIN public.portfolio_items pi ON pi.id = p.portfolio_item_id
    WHERE public.has_project_access(_uid, p.id)
      AND (_workspace_ids     IS NULL OR p.workspace_id = ANY(_workspace_ids))
      AND (_program_ids       IS NULL OR p.program_id   = ANY(_program_ids))
      AND (_project_ids       IS NULL OR p.id           = ANY(_project_ids))
      AND (_project_statuses  IS NULL OR p.status::text = ANY(_project_statuses))
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN _has_pf_filter AND _include_no_portfolio THEN
            (p.portfolio_item_id = ANY(_portfolio_item_ids) OR p.portfolio_item_id IS NULL)
          WHEN _has_pf_filter AND NOT _include_no_portfolio THEN
            (p.portfolio_item_id = ANY(_portfolio_item_ids))
          WHEN (NOT _has_pf_filter) AND _include_no_portfolio THEN
            (p.portfolio_item_id IS NULL)
          ELSE TRUE
        END
      )
  ),
  project_pms AS (
    SELECT
      tm.project_id,
      array_agg(DISTINCT tm.user_id)                       AS pm_user_ids,
      (array_agg(tm.user_id ORDER BY tm.created_at))[1]    AS primary_pm_id
    FROM public.project_team_members tm
    WHERE tm.canonical_role_key = 'project_manager'
    GROUP BY tm.project_id
  ),
  scoped_projects AS (
    SELECT
      ap.*,
      pp.primary_pm_id,
      pp.pm_user_ids
    FROM accessible_projects ap
    LEFT JOIN project_pms pp ON pp.project_id = ap.project_id
    WHERE _project_manager_ids IS NULL
       OR (pp.pm_user_ids IS NOT NULL AND pp.pm_user_ids && _project_manager_ids)
  ),
  base_rows AS (
    SELECT
      b.id                                    AS benefit_id,
      b.project_id,
      sp.project_name,
      b.workspace_id,
      w.name                                  AS workspace_name,
      sp.program_id,
      pr.name                                 AS program_name,
      sp.project_status,
      sp.primary_pm_id                        AS project_manager_id,
      CASE WHEN prof_pm.display_name IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(prof_pm.display_name, b.organization_id) END AS project_manager_name,
      sp.portfolio_item_id,
      sp.portfolio_name,
      sp.portfolio_code,
      sp.portfolio_lifecycle_state,
      sp.portfolio_is_archived,
      b.organization_id,
      b.benefit_type,
      CASE WHEN b.custom_benefit_type_label IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(b.custom_benefit_type_label, b.organization_id) END AS custom_benefit_type_label,
      CASE WHEN b.metric_name IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(b.metric_name, b.organization_id) END AS metric_name,
      b.unit_of_measure,
      lower(trim(COALESCE(b.unit_of_measure, ''))) AS unit_raw,
      b.baseline_value,
      b.target_value,
      b.actual_value,
      b.realization_status,
      b.expected_realization_date,
      b.actual_realization_date,
      b.benefit_owner_id,
      CASE WHEN prof_ow.display_name IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(prof_ow.display_name, b.organization_id) END AS benefit_owner_name,
      b.archived_at,
      b.created_at,
      b.updated_at
    FROM public.project_benefits b
    JOIN scoped_projects sp     ON sp.project_id = b.project_id
    LEFT JOIN public.workspaces w  ON w.id = b.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN public.programs   pr ON pr.id = sp.program_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles prof_pm ON prof_pm.id = sp.primary_pm_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles prof_ow ON prof_ow.id = b.benefit_owner_id
    WHERE (_include_archived OR b.archived_at IS NULL)
      AND (_benefit_types        IS NULL OR b.benefit_type        = ANY(_benefit_types))
      AND (_realization_statuses IS NULL OR b.realization_status  = ANY(_realization_statuses))
      AND (
        (_expected_from IS NULL AND _expected_to IS NULL)
        OR (
          b.expected_realization_date IS NOT NULL
          AND (_expected_from IS NULL OR b.expected_realization_date >= _expected_from)
          AND (_expected_to   IS NULL OR b.expected_realization_date <= _expected_to)
        )
      )
  ),
  normalized AS (
    SELECT
      br.*,
      CASE
        WHEN br.benefit_type = 'financial_value' AND br.unit_raw IN ('eur','€') THEN 'EUR'
        WHEN br.benefit_type = 'financial_value' AND br.unit_raw IN ('usd','$') THEN 'USD'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS currency_code,
      CASE WHEN br.unit_raw IN ('fte')                        THEN 'FTE'   ELSE NULL END AS fte_flag,
      CASE WHEN br.unit_raw IN ('hours','hour','hrs','hr')    THEN 'HOURS' ELSE NULL END AS hours_flag,
      (br.actual_value IS NULL AND br.realization_status <> 'not_applicable') AS is_pending,
      (br.expected_realization_date IS NOT NULL
        AND br.expected_realization_date < current_date
        AND br.actual_value IS NULL
        AND br.realization_status NOT IN ('realized','not_applicable')) AS is_overdue
    FROM base_rows br
  ),
  financial_summary AS (
    SELECT
      currency_code                                          AS unit,
      COALESCE(SUM(target_value), 0)                         AS target,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS actual
    FROM normalized
    WHERE currency_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY currency_code
  ),
  type_group AS (
    SELECT
      benefit_type,
      COUNT(*)                                                    AS benefit_count,
      COUNT(DISTINCT project_id)                                  AS projects_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_pending)                          AS pending_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overdue)                          AS overdue_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE fte_flag   IS NOT NULL AND actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS fte_actual,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE hours_flag IS NOT NULL AND actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS hours_actual
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY benefit_type
  ),
  type_financial AS (
    SELECT
      benefit_type,
      currency_code AS unit,
      COALESCE(SUM(target_value), 0)                                       AS target,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS actual
    FROM normalized
    WHERE currency_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY benefit_type, currency_code
  ),
  project_group AS (
    SELECT
      project_id, project_name, workspace_id, workspace_name,
      program_id, program_name, project_status,
      project_manager_id, project_manager_name,
      portfolio_item_id, portfolio_name, portfolio_code,
      portfolio_lifecycle_state, portfolio_is_archived,
      COUNT(*)                            AS benefit_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_pending)  AS actuals_pending,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overdue)  AS overdue_count,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE fte_flag   IS NOT NULL AND actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS fte_actual,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE hours_flag IS NOT NULL AND actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS hours_actual
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY project_id, project_name, workspace_id, workspace_name,
             program_id, program_name, project_status,
             project_manager_id, project_manager_name,
             portfolio_item_id, portfolio_name, portfolio_code,
             portfolio_lifecycle_state, portfolio_is_archived
  ),
  project_financial AS (
    SELECT
      project_id,
      currency_code AS unit,
      COALESCE(SUM(target_value), 0)                                       AS target,
      COALESCE(SUM(actual_value) FILTER (WHERE actual_value IS NOT NULL), 0) AS actual
    FROM normalized
    WHERE currency_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY project_id, currency_code
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'summary', jsonb_build_object(
      'projects_with_benefits',    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) FROM normalized),
      'benefits_tracked',          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normalized),
      'financial', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'unit',            unit,
            'target',          target,
            'actual',          actual,
            'achievement_pct', CASE WHEN target > 0 THEN round((actual / target) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END
          )
          ORDER BY unit
        )
        FROM financial_summary
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'fte_saved',                 (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_value), 0) FROM normalized WHERE fte_flag   IS NOT NULL AND actual_value IS NOT NULL),
      'hours_saved',               (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_value), 0) FROM normalized WHERE hours_flag IS NOT NULL AND actual_value IS NOT NULL),
      'actuals_pending',           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normalized WHERE is_pending),
      'benefits_overdue_for_update', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM normalized WHERE is_overdue)
    ),
    'benefits_by_type', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'benefit_type',       tg.benefit_type,
          'benefit_type_label', tg.benefit_type,
          'benefit_count',      tg.benefit_count,
          'projects_count',     tg.projects_count,
          'financial', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'unit',            tf.unit,
                'target',          tf.target,
                'actual',          tf.actual,
                'achievement_pct', CASE WHEN tf.target > 0 THEN round((tf.actual / tf.target) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END
              )
              ORDER BY tf.unit
            )
            FROM type_financial tf
            WHERE tf.benefit_type = tg.benefit_type
          ), '[]'::jsonb),
          'fte_actual',    tg.fte_actual,
          'hours_actual',  tg.hours_actual,
          'pending_count', tg.pending_count,
          'overdue_count', tg.overdue_count
        )
        ORDER BY tg.benefit_type
      )
      FROM type_group tg
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'benefits_by_project', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'project_id',           pg.project_id,
          'project_name',         pg.project_name,
          'workspace_id',         pg.workspace_id,
          'workspace_name',       pg.workspace_name,
          'program_id',           pg.program_id,
          'program_name',         pg.program_name,
          'project_status',       pg.project_status,
          'project_manager_id',   pg.project_manager_id,
          'project_manager_name', pg.project_manager_name,
          'portfolio_item_id',        pg.portfolio_item_id,
          'portfolio_name',           pg.portfolio_name,
          'portfolio_code',           pg.portfolio_code,
          'portfolio_lifecycle_state',pg.portfolio_lifecycle_state,
          'portfolio_is_archived',    pg.portfolio_is_archived,
          'benefit_count',        pg.benefit_count,
          'financial', COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_agg(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'unit',            pf.unit,
                'target',          pf.target,
                'actual',          pf.actual,
                'achievement_pct', CASE WHEN pf.target > 0 THEN round((pf.actual / pf.target) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END
              )
              ORDER BY pf.unit
            )
            FROM project_financial pf
            WHERE pf.project_id = pg.project_id
          ), '[]'::jsonb),
          'fte_actual',      pg.fte_actual,
          'hours_actual',    pg.hours_actual,
          'actuals_pending', pg.actuals_pending,
          'overdue_count',   pg.overdue_count
        )
        ORDER BY pg.project_name NULLS LAST
      )
      FROM project_group pg
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'benefits_requiring_update', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'benefit_id',                benefit_id,
          'project_id',                project_id,
          'project_name',              project_name,
          'workspace_name',            workspace_name,
          'portfolio_item_id',         portfolio_item_id,
          'portfolio_name',            portfolio_name,
          'portfolio_code',            portfolio_code,
          'portfolio_lifecycle_state', portfolio_lifecycle_state,
          'portfolio_is_archived',     portfolio_is_archived,
          'benefit_type',              benefit_type,
          'metric_name',               metric_name,
          'unit_of_measure',           unit_of_measure,
          'target_value',              target_value,
          'actual_value',              actual_value,
          'realization_status',        realization_status,
          'expected_realization_date', expected_realization_date,
          'benefit_owner_id',          benefit_owner_id,
          'benefit_owner_name',        benefit_owner_name
        )
        ORDER BY expected_realization_date NULLS LAST, project_name
      )
      FROM normalized
      WHERE is_overdue
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'rows', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'benefit_id',                benefit_id,
          'project_id',                project_id,
          'project_name',              project_name,
          'workspace_id',              workspace_id,
          'workspace_name',            workspace_name,
          'program_id',                program_id,
          'program_name',              program_name,
          'project_status',            project_status,
          'project_manager_id',        project_manager_id,
          'project_manager_name',      project_manager_name,
          'portfolio_item_id',         portfolio_item_id,
          'portfolio_name',            portfolio_name,
          'portfolio_code',            portfolio_code,
          'portfolio_lifecycle_state', portfolio_lifecycle_state,
          'portfolio_is_archived',     portfolio_is_archived,
          'benefit_type',              benefit_type,
          'custom_benefit_type_label', custom_benefit_type_label,
          'metric_name',               metric_name,
          'unit_of_measure',           unit_of_measure,
          'baseline_value',            baseline_value,
          'target_value',              target_value,
          'actual_value',              actual_value,
          'realization_status',        realization_status,
          'expected_realization_date', expected_realization_date,
          'actual_realization_date',   actual_realization_date,
          'benefit_owner_id',          benefit_owner_id,
          'benefit_owner_name',        benefit_owner_name,
          'archived_at',               archived_at,
          'created_at',                created_at,
          'updated_at',                updated_at
        )
        ORDER BY project_name NULLS LAST, expected_realization_date NULLS LAST, metric_name
      )
      FROM normalized
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'meta', jsonb_build_object(
      'filters_applied', jsonb_build_object(
        'workspace_ids',        to_jsonb(_workspace_ids),
        'program_ids',          to_jsonb(_program_ids),
        'project_ids',          to_jsonb(_project_ids),
        'project_statuses',     to_jsonb(_project_statuses),
        'project_manager_ids',  to_jsonb(_project_manager_ids),
        'benefit_types',        to_jsonb(_benefit_types),
        'realization_statuses', to_jsonb(_realization_statuses),
        'expected_from',        to_jsonb(_expected_from),
        'expected_to',          to_jsonb(_expected_to),
        'portfolio_item_ids',   to_jsonb(_portfolio_item_ids),
        'include_no_portfolio', to_jsonb(_include_no_portfolio)
      ),
      'generated_at',     now(),
      'include_archived', _include_archived
    )
  )
  INTO _result;

  RETURN _result;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_powerbi_data_scope(_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_eff record;
  v_workspaces jsonb;
  v_projects jsonb;
  v_summary jsonb;
  v_inc_ws_count int;
  v_exc_ws_count int;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_org_admin(v_uid, _organization_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Org Admin only';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_eff FROM public.get_powerbi_effective_scope(_organization_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.workspace_name), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_workspaces
  FROM (
    SELECT
      w.id AS workspace_id,
      w.name AS workspace_name,
      COALESCE(wr.scope_mode, 'unconfigured') AS workspace_scope_mode,
      (w.id = ANY(v_eff.included_workspace_ids)) AS effective_included,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.projects p2 WHERE p2.workspace_id = w.id AND p2.organization_id = _organization_id) AS project_count_total,
      (SELECT count(*) FROM public.projects p3 WHERE p3.workspace_id = w.id AND p3.organization_id = _organization_id AND p3.id = ANY(v_eff.included_project_ids)) AS project_count_effectively_included,
      COALESCE(w.is_demo, false) AS is_demo
    FROM public.workspaces w
    LEFT JOIN public.powerbi_data_scope_rules wr
      ON wr.scope_type = 'workspace'
     AND wr.organization_id = _organization_id
     AND wr.workspace_id = w.id
    WHERE w.organization_id = _organization_id
  ) t;

  -- Project rules retired: no project-level configuration collection.
  v_projects := '[]'::jsonb;

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_inc_ws_count
  FROM public.powerbi_data_scope_rules
  WHERE organization_id = _organization_id AND scope_type='workspace' AND scope_mode='included';
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_exc_ws_count
  FROM public.powerbi_data_scope_rules
  WHERE organization_id = _organization_id AND scope_type='workspace' AND scope_mode='excluded';

  v_summary := jsonb_build_object(
    'scope_configured', v_eff.scope_configured,
    'included_workspace_count', array_length(v_eff.included_workspace_ids, 1),
    'included_project_count', array_length(v_eff.included_project_ids, 1),
    'workspace_rule_included_count', v_inc_ws_count,
    'workspace_rule_excluded_count', v_exc_ws_count,
    'project_rule_included_count', 0,
    'project_rule_excluded_count', 0,
    'excluded_workspace_count', v_exc_ws_count,
    'excluded_project_count', 0,
    'warning_no_inclusion',
      v_eff.scope_configured
      AND COALESCE(array_length(v_eff.included_project_ids,1),0) = 0
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id', _organization_id,
    'workspaces', v_workspaces,
    'projects', v_projects,
    'summary', v_summary
  );
END;
$function$

          'user_id',            m.user_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_roadmap_story_pack_config(_story_pack_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _pack public.roadmap_story_packs;
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO _pack FROM public.roadmap_story_packs WHERE id = _story_pack_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR _pack.created_by <> _uid THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'pack', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', _pack.id,
      'organization_id', _pack.organization_id,
      'primary_workspace_id', _pack.primary_workspace_id,
      'program_id', _pack.program_id,
      'created_by', _pack.created_by,
      'status', _pack.status,
      'scope_config', _pack.scope_config,
      'source_config', _pack.source_config,
      'title', CASE WHEN _pack.title_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(_pack.title_encrypted, _pack.organization_id) END,
      'guidance', CASE WHEN _pack.user_guidance_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(_pack.user_guidance_encrypted, _pack.organization_id) END,
      'audience', _pack.audience,
      'focus', _pack.focus,
      'created_at', _pack.created_at,
      'updated_at', _pack.updated_at
    ),
    'sources', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', s.id,
        'source_category', s.source_category,
        'is_enabled', s.is_enabled,
        'config', s.config,
        'sort_order', s.sort_order,
        'updated_at', s.updated_at
      ) ORDER BY s.sort_order NULLS LAST, s.source_category)
      FROM public.roadmap_story_pack_sources s WHERE s.story_pack_id = _pack.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'notes', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', n.id,
        'label', CASE WHEN n.label_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(n.label_encrypted, _pack.organization_id) END,
        'body',  public.btpm_decrypt(n.body_encrypted, _pack.organization_id),
        'include_in_story', n.include_in_story,
        'sort_order', n.sort_order,
        'created_at', n.created_at,
        'updated_at', n.updated_at
      ) ORDER BY n.sort_order NULLS LAST, n.created_at)
      FROM public.roadmap_story_pack_notes n WHERE n.story_pack_id = _pack.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'external_files', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', f.id,
        'provider', f.provider,
        'drive_id', f.drive_id,
        'item_id', f.item_id,
        'display_name', CASE WHEN f.display_name_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(f.display_name_encrypted, _pack.organization_id) END,
        'web_url',      CASE WHEN f.web_url_encrypted      IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(f.web_url_encrypted,      _pack.organization_id) END,
        'user_note',    CASE WHEN f.user_note_encrypted    IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(f.user_note_encrypted,    _pack.organization_id) END,
        'mime_type', f.mime_type,
        'size_bytes', f.size_bytes,
        'include_in_story', f.include_in_story,
        'created_at', f.created_at,
        'updated_at', f.updated_at
      ) ORDER BY f.created_at)
      FROM public.roadmap_story_pack_external_files f WHERE f.story_pack_id = _pack.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'versions', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v.id,
        'version_number', v.version_number,
        'status', v.status,
        'source_manifest', v.source_manifest,
        'model_metadata', v.model_metadata,
        'created_at', v.created_at
      ) ORDER BY v.version_number DESC)
      FROM public.roadmap_story_pack_versions v WHERE v.story_pack_id = _pack.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ai_runs', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id,
        'story_pack_version_id', r.story_pack_version_id,
        'status', r.status,
        'provider', r.provider,
        'model', r.model,
        'reasoning_effort', r.reasoning_effort,
        'feature_key', r.feature_key,
        'input_manifest', r.input_manifest,
        'prompt_tokens', r.prompt_tokens,
        'completion_tokens', r.completion_tokens,
        'total_tokens', r.total_tokens,
        'cost_usd', r.cost_usd,
        'started_at', r.started_at,
        'completed_at', r.completed_at,
        'created_at', r.created_at
      ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC)
      FROM public.roadmap_story_ai_runs r WHERE r.story_pack_id = _pack.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO _result;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_team_work_overview(_workspace_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _program_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _project_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _assignee_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _time_window text DEFAULT 'this_week'::text, _include_completed boolean DEFAULT false, _workspace_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _portfolio_item_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_today date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
  v_window_end date;
  v_window text := COALESCE(_time_window, 'this_week');
  v_result jsonb;
  v_authorized_ids uuid[];
  v_use_ids boolean := false;
  v_portfolio_filter_active boolean := (_portfolio_item_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(_portfolio_item_ids, 1) IS NOT NULL);
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(v_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;

  IF v_window NOT IN ('today','this_week','next_2_weeks','next_30_days','all_open') THEN
    v_window := 'this_week';
  END IF;

  v_window_end := CASE v_window
    WHEN 'today' THEN v_today
    WHEN 'this_week' THEN v_today + INTERVAL '7 days'
    WHEN 'next_2_weeks' THEN v_today + INTERVAL '14 days'
    WHEN 'next_30_days' THEN v_today + INTERVAL '30 days'
    ELSE NULL
  END;

  IF _workspace_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(_workspace_ids, 1) IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(w.id), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
      INTO v_authorized_ids
      FROM public.workspaces w
     WHERE w.id = ANY(_workspace_ids)
       AND (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, w.id)
            OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, w.organization_id));
    v_use_ids := true;
  ELSIF _workspace_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.workspaces w
       WHERE w.id = _workspace_id
         AND (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, w.id)
              OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, w.organization_id))
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized for this workspace';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  WITH accessible_projects AS (
    SELECT p.id AS project_id,
           p.organization_id,
           p.workspace_id,
           p.program_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) AS project_name,
           p.portfolio_item_id,
           CASE WHEN pi.id IS NOT NULL
                THEN public.btpm_decrypt(pi.name, pi.organization_id)
                ELSE NULL
           END AS portfolio_name,
           CASE WHEN pi.id IS NOT NULL AND pi.code IS NOT NULL
                THEN public.btpm_decrypt(pi.code, pi.organization_id)
                ELSE NULL
           END AS portfolio_code,
           pi.lifecycle_state::text AS portfolio_lifecycle_state,
           pi.is_archived AS portfolio_is_archived
      FROM public.projects p
      LEFT JOIN public.portfolio_items pi ON pi.id = p.portfolio_item_id
     WHERE p.is_archived = false
       AND (NOT v_use_ids OR p.workspace_id = ANY(v_authorized_ids))
       AND (v_use_ids OR _workspace_id IS NULL OR p.workspace_id = _workspace_id)
       AND (_program_id IS NULL OR p.program_id = _program_id)
       AND (_project_id IS NULL OR p.id = _project_id)
       AND (NOT v_portfolio_filter_active OR p.portfolio_item_id = ANY(_portfolio_item_ids))
       AND public.has_project_access(v_uid, p.id)
  ),
  base_tasks AS (
    SELECT
      t.id AS task_id,
      public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id) AS task_name,
      t.status::text AS task_status,
      t.priority::text AS task_priority,
      t.task_type::text AS task_type,
      t.start_date,
      t.due_date,
      t.estimated_hours,
      t.phase_id,
      t.project_id,
      ap.workspace_id,
      ap.program_id,
      ap.organization_id,
      ap.project_name,
      ap.portfolio_item_id,
      ap.portfolio_name,
      ap.portfolio_code,
      ap.portfolio_lifecycle_state,
      ap.portfolio_is_archived,
      public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id) AS phase_name,
      t.updated_at
    FROM public.tasks t
    JOIN accessible_projects ap ON ap.project_id = t.project_id
    LEFT JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.id = t.phase_id
    WHERE t.is_archived = false
      AND (_include_completed OR t.status::text NOT IN ('completed','cancelled'))
  ),
  task_assignees AS (
    SELECT bt.task_id, ta.assignee_id
      FROM base_tasks bt
      LEFT JOIN public.task_assignments ta ON ta.task_id = bt.task_id
  ),
  task_rows AS (
    SELECT
      bt.*,
      ta.assignee_id,
      (bt.due_date IS NOT NULL AND bt.due_date < v_today
         AND bt.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) AS is_overdue,
      (bt.due_date = v_today
         AND bt.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) AS is_due_today,
      (bt.due_date IS NOT NULL AND bt.due_date >= v_today
         AND (v_window_end IS NULL OR bt.due_date <= v_window_end)
         AND bt.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')) AS is_upcoming,
      (ta.assignee_id IS NULL) AS is_unassigned,
      (bt.task_priority IN ('high','critical')) AS is_high_priority,
      (bt.estimated_hours IS NULL) AS is_unestimated,
      CASE WHEN bt.due_date IS NOT NULL AND bt.due_date < v_today
           THEN (v_today - bt.due_date) ELSE 0 END AS days_overdue,
      CASE WHEN bt.due_date IS NOT NULL AND bt.due_date >= v_today
           THEN (bt.due_date - v_today) ELSE NULL END AS days_until_due
    FROM base_tasks bt
    LEFT JOIN task_assignees ta ON ta.task_id = bt.task_id
  ),
  open_blockers AS (
    SELECT b.target_id AS task_id
      FROM public.blockers b
     WHERE b.target_type = 'task'
       AND b.status::text <> 'resolved'
  ),
  task_blocked AS (
    SELECT tr.task_id, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM open_blockers ob WHERE ob.task_id = tr.task_id) AS is_blocked
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT task_id FROM task_rows) tr
  ),
  enriched AS (
    SELECT
      tr.*,
      COALESCE(tb.is_blocked, false) AS is_blocked,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.blockers b
        WHERE b.target_type = 'task'
          AND b.target_id = tr.task_id
          AND b.status::text <> 'resolved') AS open_blocker_count,
      pr.project_name AS program_lookup_name
    FROM task_rows tr
    LEFT JOIN task_blocked tb ON tb.task_id = tr.task_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(prg.name, prg.organization_id) AS project_name
        FROM public.programs prg
       WHERE prg.id = tr.program_id
    ) pr ON true
    WHERE (_assignee_id IS NULL OR tr.assignee_id = _assignee_id)
      AND (
        v_window = 'all_open'
        OR tr.is_overdue OR tr.is_due_today OR tr.is_upcoming
        OR (v_window = 'this_week' AND tr.due_date IS NULL)
      )
  ),
  workspaces_lookup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.workspace_id,
           CASE WHEN w.organization_id IS NOT NULL
                THEN public.btpm_decrypt(w.name, w.organization_id)
                ELSE w.name
           END AS workspace_name
      FROM enriched e
      JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id = e.workspace_id
  ),
  assignees_lookup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.assignee_id,
           CASE
             WHEN p.display_name IS NULL THEN NULL
             WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
                  THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
             ELSE p.display_name
           END AS display_name,
           p.email
      FROM enriched e
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = e.assignee_id
     WHERE e.assignee_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  stakeholder_rows AS (
    SELECT
      tsr.task_id,
      tsr.role_type,
      s.id AS stakeholder_id,
      s.stakeholder_type,
      s.role_label,
      (s.removed_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_removed,
      COALESCE(
        s.external_name,
        CASE
          WHEN pp.organization_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN public.btpm_decrypt(pp.display_name, pp.organization_id)
          ELSE pp.display_name
        END,
        'Member'
      )::text AS display_name
    FROM public.task_stakeholder_roles tsr
    JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT task_id, project_id, workspace_id, organization_id FROM enriched) et
      ON et.task_id = tsr.task_id
    JOIN public.project_stakeholders s
      ON s.id = tsr.project_stakeholder_id
     AND s.project_id = et.project_id
     AND s.workspace_id = et.workspace_id
     AND s.organization_id = et.organization_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles pp ON pp.id = s.user_id
  ),
  requesters AS (
    SELECT task_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', stakeholder_id,
        'display_name', display_name,
        'stakeholder_type', stakeholder_type,
        'role_label', role_label,
        'is_removed', is_removed
      ) AS obj
    FROM stakeholder_rows
    WHERE role_type = 'requester'
  ),
  executors AS (
    SELECT task_id,
      COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', stakeholder_id,
            'display_name', display_name,
            'stakeholder_type', stakeholder_type,
            'role_label', role_label,
            'is_removed', is_removed
          )
          ORDER BY display_name ASC, stakeholder_id ASC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ) AS arr
    FROM stakeholder_rows
    WHERE role_type = 'executor'
    GROUP BY task_id
  ),
  items AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'task_id', e.task_id,
      'task_name', e.task_name,
      'task_status', e.task_status,
      'task_priority', e.task_priority,
      'task_type', e.task_type,
      'start_date', e.start_date,
      'due_date', e.due_date,
      'estimated_hours', e.estimated_hours,
      'assignee_id', e.assignee_id,
      'assignee_name', COALESCE(al.display_name, al.email),
      'assignee_email', al.email,
      'phase_id', e.phase_id,
      'phase_name', e.phase_name,
      'project_id', e.project_id,
      'project_name', e.project_name,
      'program_id', e.program_id,
      'program_name', e.program_lookup_name,
      'workspace_id', e.workspace_id,
      'workspace_name', wl.workspace_name,
      'portfolio_item_id', e.portfolio_item_id,
      'portfolio_name', e.portfolio_name,
      'portfolio_code', e.portfolio_code,
      'portfolio_lifecycle_state', e.portfolio_lifecycle_state,
      'portfolio_is_archived', e.portfolio_is_archived,
      'is_overdue', e.is_overdue,
      'is_due_today', e.is_due_today,
      'is_upcoming', e.is_upcoming,
      'is_blocked', e.is_blocked,
      'is_unassigned', e.is_unassigned,
      'is_high_priority', e.is_high_priority,
      'is_unestimated', e.is_unestimated,
      'days_overdue', e.days_overdue,
      'days_until_due', e.days_until_due,
      'open_blocker_count', e.open_blocker_count,
      'last_execution_update_at', NULL,
      'is_stale', false,
      'reason_flags', (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(f), '[]'::jsonb) FROM (
          SELECT 'overdue' AS f WHERE e.is_overdue
          UNION ALL SELECT 'due_today' WHERE e.is_due_today
          UNION ALL SELECT 'blocked' WHERE e.is_blocked
          UNION ALL SELECT 'unassigned' WHERE e.is_unassigned
          UNION ALL SELECT 'high_priority' WHERE e.is_high_priority
          UNION ALL SELECT 'unestimated' WHERE e.is_unestimated
        ) s
      ),
      'requested_by_stakeholder', r.obj,
      'executed_by_stakeholders', COALESCE(ex.arr, '[]'::jsonb)
    ) AS item
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN workspaces_lookup wl ON wl.workspace_id = e.workspace_id
    LEFT JOIN assignees_lookup al ON al.assignee_id = e.assignee_id
    LEFT JOIN requesters r ON r.task_id = e.task_id
    LEFT JOIN executors ex ON ex.task_id = e.task_id
  ),
  by_person AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'assignee_id', e.assignee_id,
      'assignee_name', COALESCE(al.display_name, al.email, CASE WHEN e.assignee_id IS NULL THEN 'Unassigned' ELSE NULL END),
      'open_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'overdue_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_overdue),
      'due_this_week', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.due_date IS NOT NULL AND e.due_date >= v_today AND e.due_date <= v_today + INTERVAL '7 days' AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'blocked_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_blocked),
      'estimated_open_hours', COALESCE(SUM(e.estimated_hours) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled') AND e.estimated_hours IS NOT NULL), 0),
      'unestimated_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_unestimated AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled'))
    ) AS row
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN assignees_lookup al ON al.assignee_id = e.assignee_id
    GROUP BY e.assignee_id, al.display_name, al.email
  ),
  by_project AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'project_id', e.project_id,
      'project_name', e.project_name,
      'workspace_id', e.workspace_id,
      'workspace_name', wl.workspace_name,
      'portfolio_item_id', e.portfolio_item_id,
      'portfolio_name', e.portfolio_name,
      'portfolio_code', e.portfolio_code,
      'portfolio_lifecycle_state', e.portfolio_lifecycle_state,
      'portfolio_is_archived', e.portfolio_is_archived,
      'open_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'overdue_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_overdue),
      'due_this_week', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.due_date IS NOT NULL AND e.due_date >= v_today AND e.due_date <= v_today + INTERVAL '7 days' AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'blocked_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_blocked),
      'high_priority_open', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_high_priority AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'unassigned_tasks', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_unassigned AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'estimated_open_hours', COALESCE(SUM(e.estimated_hours) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled') AND e.estimated_hours IS NOT NULL), 0)
    ) AS row
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN workspaces_lookup wl ON wl.workspace_id = e.workspace_id
    GROUP BY e.project_id, e.project_name, e.workspace_id, wl.workspace_name,
             e.portfolio_item_id, e.portfolio_name, e.portfolio_code,
             e.portfolio_lifecycle_state, e.portfolio_is_archived
  ),
  summary AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'total_open', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'due_today', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_due_today),
      'overdue', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_overdue),
      'upcoming', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_upcoming),
      'blocked', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_blocked),
      'unassigned', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_unassigned AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'high_priority_open', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_high_priority AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'unestimated', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.is_unestimated AND e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled')),
      'completed_in_window', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status = 'completed'),
      'estimated_open_hours', COALESCE(SUM(e.estimated_hours) FILTER (WHERE e.task_status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled') AND e.estimated_hours IS NOT NULL), 0)
    ) AS row
    FROM enriched e
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'time_window', v_window,
    'as_of', v_today,
    'items', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(item) FROM items), '[]'::jsonb),
    'summary', COALESCE((SELECT row FROM summary), '{}'::jsonb),
    'by_person', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row) FROM by_person), '[]'::jsonb),
    'by_project', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row) FROM by_project), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_tenant_protected_download_context(_storage_object_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _o public.tenant_storage_objects;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _o FROM public.tenant_storage_objects WHERE id = _storage_object_id;
  IF _o.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Storage object % not found', _storage_object_id; END IF;
  IF NOT public.validate_tenant_storage_access(_storage_object_id, 'download') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized to download storage object' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'storage_object_id', _o.id,
    'tenant_id', _o.tenant_id,
    'organization_id', _o.organization_id,
    'workspace_id', _o.workspace_id,
    'bucket', _o.bucket,
    'object_path', _o.object_path,
    'file_name', _o.file_name,
    'content_type', _o.content_type,
    'size_bytes', _o.size_bytes,
    'storage_status', _o.storage_status
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_pm_authority(_user_id uuid, _workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.is_workspace_admin_or_higher(_user_id, _workspace_id)
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id
      AND workspace_id = _workspace_id
      AND role = 'project_manager'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_project_access(_user_id uuid, _project_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.projects p
    WHERE p.id = _project_id
      AND (
        public.is_org_admin(_user_id, p.organization_id)
        OR public.is_workspace_admin_or_higher(_user_id, p.workspace_id)
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.project_memberships pm
          WHERE pm.project_id = _project_id
            AND pm.user_id = _user_id
            AND pm.removed_at IS NULL
        )
      )
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_project_access_by_target(_user_id uuid, _target_type text, _target_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_user(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN api_e_private.jwt_client_id() IS NULL THEN
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
        WHERE id = _user_id
          AND is_active = true
      )
    WHEN NOT api_e_private.assert_trusted_context() THEN
      false
    ELSE
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
        WHERE id = _user_id
          AND is_active = true
      )
  END
$function$
