CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_org_admin(_user_id uuid, _organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _has_om boolean;
BEGIN
  -- API-E.2C OAuth containment: signed client_id sessions must present
  -- API-E.1 trusted transaction context established by an explicit wrapper.
  IF api_e_private.jwt_client_id() IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT api_e_private.assert_trusted_context() THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Original Organization-admin authorization logic (unchanged).
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_memberships
    WHERE user_id = _user_id AND organization_id = _organization_id
  ) INTO _has_om;

  IF _has_om THEN
    RETURN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.organization_memberships om
      JOIN public.tenant_memberships tm
        ON tm.tenant_id = om.tenant_id AND tm.user_id = om.user_id
      WHERE om.user_id = _user_id
        AND om.organization_id = _organization_id
        AND om.status = 'active'
        AND om.role = 'org_admin'
        AND tm.status = 'active'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Legacy transition fallback: only when no new-membership row exists at all.
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles
    WHERE user_id = _user_id
      AND role = 'org_admin'
      AND organization_id = _organization_id
      AND workspace_id IS NULL
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_org_member(_user_id uuid, _organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _has_om boolean; _active boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_memberships
    WHERE user_id = _user_id AND organization_id = _organization_id
  ) INTO _has_om;

  IF _has_om THEN
    RETURN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.organization_memberships om
      JOIN public.tenant_memberships tm
        ON tm.tenant_id = om.tenant_id AND tm.user_id = om.user_id
      WHERE om.user_id = _user_id
        AND om.organization_id = _organization_id
        AND om.status = 'active'
        AND tm.status = 'active'
    );
  END IF;

  -- Legacy transition fallback: only when no new-membership row exists at all.
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = _user_id AND organization_id = _organization_id
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kpi_scheduler_diagnostics()
 RETURNS TABLE(expected_jobname text, job_configured boolean, jobid bigint, schedule text, active boolean, last_run_started_at timestamp with time zone, last_run_finished_at timestamp with time zone, last_run_status text, last_run_return_message text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'cron', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_is_org_admin boolean;
BEGIN
  -- Authority gate: caller must be Org Admin in at least one organization.
  -- Diagnostics expose global cron state, so workspace-admin is insufficient.
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.organizations o
    WHERE public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), o.id)
  ) INTO v_is_org_admin;

  IF NOT v_is_org_admin THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Org-admin authority required'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH expected(expected_jobname) AS (
    VALUES
      ('run-kpi-snapshot-capture-scheduler-cron'),
      ('run-kpi-app-scheduler-cron')
  ),
  jobs AS (
    SELECT j.jobid, j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active
    FROM cron.job j
    WHERE j.jobname IN (
      'run-kpi-snapshot-capture-scheduler-cron',
      'run-kpi-app-scheduler-cron'
    )
  ),
  last_runs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.jobid)
      d.jobid,
      d.start_time AS last_run_started_at,
      d.end_time   AS last_run_finished_at,
      d.status     AS last_run_status,
      LEFT(COALESCE(d.return_message, ''), 200) AS last_run_return_message
    FROM cron.job_run_details d
    JOIN jobs j ON j.jobid = d.jobid
    ORDER BY d.jobid, d.start_time DESC
  )
  SELECT
    e.expected_jobname,
    (j.jobid IS NOT NULL)            AS job_configured,
    j.jobid,
    j.schedule,
    j.active,
    lr.last_run_started_at,
    lr.last_run_finished_at,
    lr.last_run_status,
    NULLIF(lr.last_run_return_message, '') AS last_run_return_message
  FROM expected e
  LEFT JOIN jobs j      ON j.jobname = e.expected_jobname
  LEFT JOIN last_runs lr ON lr.jobid  = j.jobid;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_adoption_templates(_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _org uuid;
  _result jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  _r record;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;
  SELECT organization_id INTO _org FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = _workspace_id;
  IF _org IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_workspace';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (public.is_workspace_member(_uid, _workspace_id)
          OR public.is_org_admin(_uid, _org)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  -- System template entry (always available, never editable)
  _result := jsonb_build_array(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'template_id', NULL,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decision_case_ai_runs(_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE;
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'AI runs are only available for decision cases' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public._gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(payload ORDER BY started_at_v DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.started_at AS started_at_v,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', r.id,
        'status', r.status,
        'run_type', r.run_type,
        'model_provider', r.model_provider,
        'model_id', r.model_id,
        'model_source', r.model_source,
        'reasoning_effort', r.reasoning_effort,
        'template_id', r.template_id,
        'template_version', r.template_version,
        'files_selected_count', r.files_selected_count,
        'files_sent_count', r.files_sent_count,
        'files_skipped_count', r.files_skipped_count,
        'total_bytes_sent', r.total_bytes_sent,
        'error_code', r.error_code,
        'brief_version_id', r.brief_version_id,
        'started_by', r.started_by,
        'started_by_display', (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
                               FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = r.started_by),
        'started_at', r.started_at,
        'completed_at', r.completed_at,
        'saved_at', r.saved_at,
        'discarded_at', r.discarded_at
      ) AS payload
    FROM public.decision_case_ai_runs r
    WHERE r.governance_record_id = _record_id
    ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
    LIMIT 50
  ) sub;

  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decrypted_comments(_target_type text, _target_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(v_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(c_obj ORDER BY (c_obj->>'created_at') ASC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result
  FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'id', c.id,
      'target_type', c.target_type,
      'target_id', c.target_id,
      'author_id', c.author_id,
      'is_edited', c.is_edited,
      'organization_id', c.organization_id,
      'workspace_id', c.workspace_id,
      'created_at', c.created_at,
      'updated_at', c.updated_at,
      'body', public.btpm_decrypt(c.body, c.organization_id),
      'references', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', l.id,
          'referenced_type', l.referenced_type,
          'referenced_id', l.referenced_id,
          'workspace_id', l.workspace_id,
          'project_id', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'project' THEN l.referenced_id
            WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT ph.project_id FROM public.phases ph WHERE ph.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT t.project_id  FROM public.tasks  t  WHERE t.id  = l.referenced_id)
          END,
          'phase_id', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'task' THEN (SELECT t.phase_id FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.id = l.referenced_id)
            ELSE NULL
          END,
          'display_label', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'project' THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) FROM public.projects p WHERE p.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id) FROM public.phases ph WHERE ph.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id) FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.id = l.referenced_id)
          END,
          'context_label', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'phase' THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) FROM public.projects p JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.project_id = p.id WHERE ph.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'task'  THEN (
              SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) || ' › ' || public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id)
                FROM public.tasks t JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.id = t.phase_id JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
               WHERE t.id = l.referenced_id
            )
            ELSE NULL
          END,
          'sort_order', l.sort_order
        ) ORDER BY l.sort_order)
        FROM public.entity_object_links l
        WHERE l.owner_type = 'comment' AND l.owner_id = c.id AND l.link_role = 'reference'
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) AS c_obj
    FROM public.comments c
    WHERE c.target_type = _target_type AND c.target_id = _target_id
      AND (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, c.workspace_id) OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, c.organization_id))
  ) sub;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'

DECLARE

         a.workspace_id, a.owner_id, a.version,
         a.published_at, a.archived_at, a.created_at, a.updated_at

              AND a.workspace_id IS NOT NULL

    )
  ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decrypted_kpi_definitions(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _ws_id uuid; _org_id uuid; _result json;
BEGIN
  SELECT workspace_id, organization_id INTO _ws_id, _org_id FROM projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF _ws_id IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::json; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not authorized to read this project' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) INTO _result FROM (
    SELECT kd.id, kd.name, kd.unit, kd.target_value, kd.current_value,
      kd.target_direction, kd.target_type, kd.target_id,
      kd.is_archived, kd.created_at, kd.updated_at, kd.created_by,
      kd.workspace_id, kd.organization_id,
      kd.source_mode, kd.value_type, kd.cadence,
      kd.calculation_key, kd.formula_version,
      kd.completion_method, kd.comment_required, kd.action_plan_required,
      kd.auto_snapshot_enabled,
      CASE WHEN kd.description IS NOT NULL
           THEN btpm_decrypt(kd.description, kd.organization_id) ELSE NULL END AS description
    FROM kpi_definitions kd
    WHERE kd.target_type='project' AND kd.target_id=_project_id
    ORDER BY kd.is_archived, kd.created_at) t;
  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decrypted_kpi_snapshots(_project_id uuid, _kpi_definition_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _ws_id uuid; _org_id uuid; _result json;
BEGIN
  SELECT workspace_id, organization_id INTO _ws_id, _org_id FROM projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF _ws_id IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::json; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not authorized to read this project' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) INTO _result FROM (
    SELECT
      ks.id, ks.kpi_definition_id, ks.project_id,
      ks.workspace_id, ks.organization_id,
      ks.snapshot_date, ks.period_start, ks.period_end,
      ks.source_mode, ks.value_type, ks.value_amount,
      ks.calculation_key, ks.formula_version,
      ks.calculation_status, ks.generated_by,
      ks.created_at, ks.created_by,
      CASE WHEN ks.string_value IS NOT NULL
           THEN public.btpm_decrypt(ks.string_value, ks.organization_id) ELSE NULL END AS string_value,
      CASE WHEN ks.comment IS NOT NULL
           THEN public.btpm_decrypt(ks.comment, ks.organization_id) ELSE NULL END AS comment,
      CASE WHEN ks.action_plan IS NOT NULL
           THEN public.btpm_decrypt(ks.action_plan, ks.organization_id) ELSE NULL END AS action_plan
    FROM public.kpi_snapshots ks
    WHERE ks.project_id = _project_id
      AND (_kpi_definition_id IS NULL OR ks.kpi_definition_id = _kpi_definition_id)
    ORDER BY ks.snapshot_date DESC, ks.created_at DESC
  ) t;
  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decrypted_kpi_updates(_kpi_definition_id uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _ws_id uuid;
  _org_id uuid;
  _result json;
BEGIN
  SELECT workspace_id, organization_id INTO _ws_id, _org_id
    FROM kpi_definitions WHERE id = _kpi_definition_id;
  IF _ws_id IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::json; END IF;

  IF NOT (is_workspace_member(auth.uid(), _ws_id) OR is_org_admin(auth.uid(), _org_id)) THEN
    RETURN '[]'::json;
  END IF;

  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ku.id, ku.kpi_definition_id, ku.value, ku.update_date,
      ku.created_at, ku.author_id,
      ku.workspace_id, ku.organization_id,
      CASE WHEN ku.note IS NOT NULL
           THEN btpm_decrypt(ku.note, ku.organization_id)
           ELSE NULL END AS note,
      CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND p.display_name IS NOT NULL
           THEN btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)

      CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND p.email IS NOT NULL
           THEN btpm_decrypt(p.email, p.organization_id)
           ELSE p.email END AS author_email
    FROM kpi_updates ku
    LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = ku.author_id
    WHERE ku.kpi_definition_id = _kpi_definition_id
    ORDER BY ku.update_date DESC, ku.created_at DESC
  ) t;

  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END;
$function$

BEGIN

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT

    b.unit_of_measure,

    b.actual_value,

         ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, b.organization_id) END,
    p.email,
    b.realization_status,
    b.expected_realization_date,
    b.actual_realization_date,
    CASE WHEN b.evidence_note IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(b.evidence_note, b.organization_id) END,
    b.created_by,
    b.updated_by,
    b.created_at,
    b.updated_at,
    b.archived_at
  FROM public.project_benefits b
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = b.benefit_owner_id
  WHERE b.project_id = _project_id
    AND (_include_archived OR b.archived_at IS NULL)
  ORDER BY b.archived_at IS NOT NULL, b.created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decrypted_project_phases(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_proj public.projects%ROWTYPE; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_proj FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_decrypted_project_tasks(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_proj public.projects%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_proj FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project_or_demo(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized';
  END IF;

  WITH stakeholder_rows AS (
    SELECT
      tsr.task_id,
      tsr.role_type,
      s.id AS stakeholder_id,
      s.stakeholder_type,
      s.role_label,
      (s.removed_at IS NOT NULL) AS is_removed,
      COALESCE(
        s.external_name,
        CASE
          WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
          ELSE p.display_name
        END,
        'Member'
      )::text AS display_name
    FROM public.task_stakeholder_roles tsr
    JOIN public.tasks t ON t.id = tsr.task_id
    JOIN public.project_stakeholders s
      ON s.id = tsr.project_stakeholder_id
     AND s.project_id = t.project_id
     AND s.workspace_id = t.workspace_id
     AND s.organization_id = t.organization_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = s.user_id
    WHERE t.project_id = _project_id
  ),
  requesters AS (
    SELECT task_id,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', stakeholder_id,
        'display_name', display_name,
        'stakeholder_type', stakeholder_type,
        'role_label', role_label,
        'is_removed', is_removed
      ) AS obj
    FROM stakeholder_rows
    WHERE role_type = 'requester'
  ),
  executors AS (
    SELECT task_id,
      COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', stakeholder_id,
            'display_name', display_name,
            'stakeholder_type', stakeholder_type,
            'role_label', role_label,
            'is_removed', is_removed
          )
          ORDER BY display_name ASC, stakeholder_id ASC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ) AS arr
    FROM stakeholder_rows
    WHERE role_type = 'executor'
    GROUP BY task_id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', t.id, 'organization_id', t.organization_id,
    'workspace_id', t.workspace_id, 'project_id', t.project_id, 'phase_id', t.phase_id,
    'name', t.name,
    'description', public.btpm_decrypt(t.description, t.organization_id),
    'status', t.status, 'priority', t.priority, 'task_type', t.task_type,
    'sort_order', t.sort_order,
    'start_date', t.start_date, 'due_date', t.due_date,
    'actual_start_date', t.actual_start_date,
    'actual_end_date', t.actual_end_date,
    'baseline_start_date', t.baseline_start_date,
    'baseline_end_date', t.baseline_end_date,
    'added_after_baseline', t.added_after_baseline,
    'estimated_hours', t.estimated_hours, 'owner_id', t.owner_id,
    'workflow_state_id', t.workflow_state_id,
    'backlog_item_id', t.backlog_item_id,
    'is_adoption_related', COALESCE(t.is_adoption_related, false),
    'adoption_initiative_id', t.adoption_initiative_id,
    'is_archived', t.is_archived,
    'created_at', t.created_at, 'updated_at', t.updated_at,
    'created_by', t.created_by,
    'requested_by_stakeholder', r.obj,
    'executed_by_stakeholders', COALESCE(e.arr, '[]'::jsonb)
  ) ORDER BY t.sort_order), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_result
  FROM public.tasks t
  LEFT JOIN requesters r ON r.task_id = t.id
  LEFT JOIN executors  e ON e.task_id = t.id
  WHERE t.project_id = _project_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_entity_links(_owner_type text, _owner_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(v_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  IF _owner_type NOT IN ('comment','blocker','risk') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid owner_type'; END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_obj), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result FROM (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'owner_id', oid,
      'people', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', l.id,
          'user_id', l.user_id,
          'stakeholder_id', l.stakeholder_id,
          'stakeholder_type', CASE
            WHEN l.stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.stakeholder_type
            WHEN l.user_id        IS NOT NULL THEN 'workspace_member'
          END,
          'link_role', l.link_role,
          'display_name', CASE
            WHEN l.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
            WHEN l.stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(
              s.external_name,
              public.btpm_decrypt(sp.display_name, sp.organization_id)
            )
          END,
          'sort_order', l.sort_order
        ) ORDER BY l.sort_order)
        FROM public.entity_user_links l
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = l.user_id
        LEFT JOIN public.project_stakeholders s ON s.id = l.stakeholder_id
        LEFT JOIN public.profiles sp ON sp.id = s.user_id
        WHERE l.owner_type = _owner_type AND l.owner_id = oid
          AND (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, l.workspace_id) OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, l.organization_id))
      ), '[]'::jsonb),
      'objects', COALESCE((
        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', l.id,
          'referenced_type', l.referenced_type,
          'referenced_id',   l.referenced_id,
          'workspace_id',    l.workspace_id,
          'link_role',       l.link_role,
          'project_id', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'project' THEN l.referenced_id
            WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT ph.project_id FROM public.phases ph WHERE ph.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT t.project_id  FROM public.tasks  t  WHERE t.id  = l.referenced_id)
          END,
          'phase_id', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'task' THEN (SELECT t.phase_id FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.id = l.referenced_id)
            ELSE NULL
          END,
          'display_label', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'project' THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) FROM public.projects p WHERE p.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id) FROM public.phases ph WHERE ph.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id) FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.id = l.referenced_id)
          END,
          'context_label', CASE l.referenced_type
            WHEN 'phase' THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) FROM public.projects p JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.project_id = p.id WHERE ph.id = l.referenced_id)
            WHEN 'task'  THEN (
              SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) || ' › ' || public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id)
                FROM public.tasks t JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.id = t.phase_id JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = t.project_id
               WHERE t.id = l.referenced_id
            )
            ELSE NULL
          END,
          'sort_order', l.sort_order
        ) ORDER BY l.sort_order)
        FROM public.entity_object_links l
        WHERE l.owner_type = _owner_type AND l.owner_id = oid
          AND (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, l.workspace_id) OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, l.organization_id))
      ), '[]'::jsonb)
    ) AS row_obj
    FROM unnest(_owner_ids) AS oid
  ) sub;
  RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_generated_decision_case_documents(_record_id uuid, _document_type generated_doc_type DEFAULT NULL::generated_doc_type)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE;
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Generated documents are only available for decision cases' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public._gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', g.id,
    'document_type', g.document_type,
    'generation_status', g.generation_status,
    'output_filename', g.output_filename,
    'generated_at', g.generated_at,
    'generated_by', g.generated_by,
    'source_snapshot_at', g.source_snapshot_at,
    'sharepoint_publish_status', g.sharepoint_publish_status,
    'sharepoint_item_id', g.sharepoint_item_id,
    'sharepoint_web_url', g.sharepoint_web_url,
    'error_note', g.error_note
  ) ORDER BY g.generated_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM public.generated_operational_documents g
  WHERE g.governance_record_id = _record_id
    AND (_document_type IS NULL OR g.document_type = _document_type);

  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_governance_record_brief_versions(_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE; _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Brief versions are only available for decision cases' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public._gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(payload ORDER BY current_sort, version_number_v DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN v.is_current THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS current_sort,
      v.version_number AS version_number_v,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', v.id,
        'organization_id', v.organization_id,
        'workspace_id', v.workspace_id,
        'project_id', v.project_id,
        'governance_record_id', v.governance_record_id,
        'version_number', v.version_number,
        'source_type', v.source_type,
        'is_current', v.is_current,
        'raw_copilot_output', CASE WHEN v.raw_copilot_output IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.raw_copilot_output, v.organization_id) END,
        'edited_brief_text', CASE WHEN v.edited_brief_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.edited_brief_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'executive_intro_text', CASE WHEN v.executive_intro_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.executive_intro_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'options_summary', CASE WHEN v.options_summary IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.options_summary, v.organization_id) END,
        'recommendation_text', CASE WHEN v.recommendation_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.recommendation_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'guardrails_text', CASE WHEN v.guardrails_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.guardrails_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'residual_risks_text', CASE WHEN v.residual_risks_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.residual_risks_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'requested_decision_text', CASE WHEN v.requested_decision_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.requested_decision_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'open_questions_text', CASE WHEN v.open_questions_text IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(v.open_questions_text, v.organization_id) END,
        'confidence_level', v.confidence_level,
        'decision_readiness', v.decision_readiness,
        'created_at', v.created_at,
        'created_by', v.created_by,
        'updated_at', v.updated_at,
        'updated_by', v.updated_by
      ) AS payload
    FROM public.governance_record_brief_versions v
    WHERE v.governance_record_id = _record_id
  ) sub;

  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_governance_record_btpm_context_links(_record_id uuid, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE; _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'BTPM context links are only available for decision cases' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public._gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_payload ORDER BY archived_sort, sp_name_v, relevance_sort, object_type_v, created_at_v DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      (l.archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS archived_sort,
      public.btpm_decrypt(sp.name, sp.organization_id) AS sp_name_v,
      CASE l.relevance_level WHEN 'high' THEN 0 WHEN 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS relevance_sort,
      l.object_type AS object_type_v,
      l.created_at AS created_at_v,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', l.id,
        'organization_id', l.organization_id,
        'workspace_id', l.workspace_id,
        'project_id', l.project_id,
        'governance_record_id', l.governance_record_id,
        'source_project_id', l.source_project_id,
        'source_workspace_id', l.source_workspace_id,
        'object_type', l.object_type,
        'object_id', l.object_id,
        'relationship_type', l.relationship_type,
        'context_reason',
          CASE WHEN l.context_reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(l.context_reason, l.organization_id) END,
        'relevance_level', l.relevance_level,
        'included_in_package', l.included_in_package,
        'created_at', l.created_at,
        'created_by', l.created_by,
        'updated_at', l.updated_at,
        'updated_by', l.updated_by,
        'archived_at', l.archived_at,
        'archived_by', l.archived_by,
        'source_project_name', public.btpm_decrypt(sp.name, sp.organization_id),
        'source_workspace_name', public.btpm_decrypt(sw.name, sw.organization_id),
        'source_program_id', sp.program_id,
        'source_program_name',
          CASE WHEN sp.program_id IS NULL THEN NULL
               ELSE (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(pr.name, pr.organization_id)
                       FROM public.programs pr WHERE pr.id = sp.program_id) END,
        'source_project_status', sp.status::text,
        'source_project_priority', sp.priority,
        'object_name', CASE l.object_type
          WHEN 'project' THEN public.btpm_decrypt(sp.name, sp.organization_id)
          WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) FROM public.phases p WHERE p.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id) FROM public.tasks  t WHERE t.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'risk'    THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(r.title, r.organization_id) FROM public.risks r WHERE r.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'blocker' THEN (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(b.title, b.organization_id) FROM public.blockers b WHERE b.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'kpi_definition' THEN (SELECT k.name FROM public.kpi_definitions k WHERE k.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'kpi_update' THEN (SELECT k.name FROM public.kpi_updates u JOIN public.kpi_definitions k ON k.id = u.kpi_definition_id WHERE u.id = l.object_id)
          ELSE NULL END,
        'object_status', CASE l.object_type
          WHEN 'project' THEN sp.status::text
          WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT p.status::text FROM public.phases p WHERE p.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT t.status::text FROM public.tasks  t WHERE t.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'risk'    THEN (SELECT r.status::text FROM public.risks r WHERE r.id = l.object_id)
          WHEN 'blocker' THEN (SELECT b.status::text FROM public.blockers b WHERE b.id = l.object_id)
          ELSE NULL END
      ) AS row_payload
    FROM public.governance_record_btpm_context_links l
    JOIN public.projects sp ON sp.id = l.source_project_id
    JOIN public.workspaces sw ON sw.id = sp.workspace_id
    WHERE l.governance_record_id = _record_id
      AND (_include_archived OR l.archived_at IS NULL)
      AND public.has_project_access(auth.uid(), l.source_project_id)
  ) sub;

  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_governance_record_copilot_data_packages(_record_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE; _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Data packages are only available for decision cases' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public._gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(payload ORDER BY current_sort, version_number_v DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE WHEN p.is_current THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS current_sort,
      p.version_number AS version_number_v,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', p.id,
        'organization_id', p.organization_id,
        'workspace_id', p.workspace_id,
        'project_id', p.project_id,
        'governance_record_id', p.governance_record_id,
        'version_number', p.version_number,
        'is_current', p.is_current,
        'package_status', p.package_status,
        'package_filename', public.btpm_decrypt(p.package_filename, p.organization_id),
        'package_json', public.btpm_decrypt(p.package_json, p.organization_id),
        'package_hash', p.package_hash,
        'source_project_ids', p.source_project_ids,
        'source_snapshot_at', p.source_snapshot_at,
        'downloaded_at', p.downloaded_at,
        'downloaded_by', p.downloaded_by,
        'created_at', p.created_at,
        'created_by', p.created_by,
        'package_format', p.package_format,
        'bundle_status', p.bundle_status,
        'bundle_filename',
          CASE WHEN p.bundle_filename IS NULL THEN NULL
               ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(p.bundle_filename, p.organization_id) END,
        'bundle_mime_type', p.bundle_mime_type,
        'bundle_size_bytes', p.bundle_size_bytes,
        'bundle_hash', p.bundle_hash,
        'bundle_generated_at', p.bundle_generated_at,
        'bundle_file_count', p.bundle_file_count,
        'bundle_packaged_file_count', p.bundle_packaged_file_count,
        'bundle_failed_file_count', p.bundle_failed_file_count,
        'bundle_metadata_only_count', p.bundle_metadata_only_count,
        'bundle_downloaded_at', p.bundle_downloaded_at,
        'bundle_downloaded_by', p.bundle_downloaded_by
      ) AS payload
    FROM public.governance_record_copilot_data_packages p
    WHERE p.governance_record_id = _record_id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM unnest(p.source_project_ids) AS sp(id)
        WHERE NOT public.has_project_access(auth.uid(), sp.id)
      )
  ) sub;

  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_governance_record_cross_project_links(_record_id uuid, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row public.governance_records%ROWTYPE; _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM public.governance_records WHERE id = _record_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Record not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  IF _row.record_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'decision_case' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cross-project links are only available for decision cases' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public._gov_assert_project_read(_row.project_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_payload ORDER BY archived_sort, relationship_type, created_at_v DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      (l.archived_at IS NOT NULL) AS archived_sort,
      l.relationship_type,
      l.created_at AS created_at_v,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', l.id,
        'organization_id', l.organization_id,
        'workspace_id', l.workspace_id,
        'project_id', l.project_id,
        'governance_record_id', l.governance_record_id,
        'linked_project_id', l.linked_project_id,
        'linked_project_workspace_id', l.linked_project_workspace_id,
        'relationship_type', l.relationship_type,
        'relationship_reason',
          CASE WHEN l.relationship_reason IS NULL THEN NULL
               ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(l.relationship_reason, l.organization_id) END,
        'source_dependency_id', l.source_dependency_id,
        'included_in_package', l.included_in_package,
        'created_at', l.created_at,
        'created_by', l.created_by,
        'updated_at', l.updated_at,
        'updated_by', l.updated_by,
        'archived_at', l.archived_at,
        'archived_by', l.archived_by,
        'linked_project_name', public.btpm_decrypt(lp.name, lp.organization_id),
        'linked_project_status', lp.status,
        'linked_project_priority', lp.priority,
        'linked_project_workspace_name', public.btpm_decrypt(lw.name, lw.organization_id),
        'linked_project_program_id', lp.program_id,
        'linked_project_program_name',
          CASE WHEN lp.program_id IS NULL THEN NULL
               ELSE (SELECT public.btpm_decrypt(pr.name, pr.organization_id)
                       FROM public.programs pr WHERE pr.id = lp.program_id) END
      ) AS row_payload
    FROM public.governance_record_cross_project_links l
    JOIN public.projects lp ON lp.id = l.linked_project_id
    JOIN public.workspaces lw ON lw.id = lp.workspace_id
    WHERE l.governance_record_id = _record_id
      AND (_include_archived OR l.archived_at IS NULL)
      AND public.has_project_access(auth.uid(), l.linked_project_id)
  ) sub;

  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_activity_events(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_proj public.projects%ROWTYPE; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_proj FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Project not found'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_project_access(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized';
  END IF;

  WITH scope AS (
    SELECT 'project'::text AS t, v_proj.id AS id
    UNION ALL SELECT 'phase'::text, ph.id FROM public.phases ph WHERE ph.project_id = _project_id
    UNION ALL SELECT 'task'::text,  tk.id FROM public.tasks  tk WHERE tk.project_id = _project_id
  ),
  derived_targets AS (
    SELECT 'blocker'::text AS t, b.id FROM public.blockers b
      JOIN scope s ON s.t = b.target_type AND s.id = b.target_id
    UNION ALL SELECT 'risk'::text, r.id FROM public.risks r
      JOIN scope s ON s.t = r.target_type AND s.id = r.target_id
    UNION ALL SELECT 'kpi_definition'::text, k.id FROM public.kpi_definitions k
      JOIN scope s ON s.t = k.target_type AND s.id = k.target_id
  ),
  governance_targets AS (
    SELECT 'governance_cadence'::text AS t, gc.id
      FROM public.governance_cadences gc WHERE gc.project_id = _project_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'governance_record'::text, gr.id
      FROM public.governance_records gr WHERE gr.project_id = _project_id
  ),
  all_targets AS (
    SELECT * FROM scope
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM derived_targets
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM governance_targets
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', ae.id,
    'event_type', ae.event_type,
    'target_type', ae.target_type,
    'target_id', ae.target_id,
    'actor_id', ae.actor_id,
    'organization_id', ae.organization_id,
    'workspace_id', ae.workspace_id,
    'created_at', ae.created_at,
    'metadata', btpm_decrypt(ae.metadata, ae.organization_id))
    ORDER BY ae.created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result
  FROM public.activity_events ae
  JOIN all_targets at ON at.t = ae.target_type AND at.id = ae.target_id
  WHERE ae.organization_id = v_proj.organization_id;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_adoption_reporting_summaries(_workspace_id uuid, _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid    uuid := auth.uid();
  _org_id uuid;
  _today  date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
  _result json;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT organization_id INTO _org_id FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = _workspace_id;
  IF _org_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace not found' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF NOT (public.is_workspace_member(_uid, _workspace_id) OR public.is_org_admin(_uid, _org_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not a workspace member' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  WITH
  plan AS (
    SELECT
      ap.id              AS adoption_plan_id,
      ap.project_id,
      ap.workspace_id,
      ap.organization_id,
      ap.readiness_status,
      ap.enabled,
      ap.created_from_template
    FROM public.adoption_plans ap
    JOIN public.projects p
      ON p.id = ap.project_id
     AND p.is_archived = false
    WHERE ap.workspace_id = _workspace_id
      AND ap.is_archived = false
      AND (_project_ids IS NULL OR ap.project_id = ANY(_project_ids))
      AND public.has_project_access(_uid, ap.project_id)
  ),
  init_agg AS (
    SELECT
      i.adoption_plan_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.is_archived = false)                                         AS initiative_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.is_archived = false AND i.status = 'active')                 AS active_initiative_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.is_archived = false AND i.status = 'at_risk')                AS at_risk_initiative_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.is_archived = false AND i.status = 'completed')              AS completed_initiative_count
    FROM public.adoption_initiatives i
    JOIN plan ON plan.adoption_plan_id = i.adoption_plan_id
    GROUP BY i.adoption_plan_id
  ),
  task_agg AS (
    SELECT
      t.project_id,
      COUNT(*)                                                                              AS adoption_task_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('planned','active','on_hold'))                    AS adoption_task_open_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'completed')                                        AS adoption_task_completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE t.status IN ('planned','active')
          AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL
          AND t.due_date < _today
      )                                                                                     AS adoption_task_overdue_count
    FROM public.tasks t
    JOIN plan ON plan.project_id = t.project_id
    WHERE t.is_archived = false
      AND (t.is_adoption_related = true OR t.adoption_initiative_id IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY t.project_id
  ),
  link_agg AS (
    SELECT
      l.adoption_plan_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.object_type = 'risk')    AS adoption_risk_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.object_type = 'blocker') AS adoption_blocker_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.object_type = 'kpi')     AS adoption_kpi_count
    FROM public.adoption_object_links l
    JOIN plan ON plan.adoption_plan_id = l.adoption_plan_id
    GROUP BY l.adoption_plan_id
  ),
  combined AS (
    SELECT
      plan.project_id,
      plan.workspace_id,
      plan.organization_id,
      plan.adoption_plan_id,
      plan.readiness_status,
      plan.enabled,
      plan.created_from_template,
      COALESCE(init_agg.initiative_count, 0)             AS initiative_count,
      COALESCE(init_agg.active_initiative_count, 0)      AS active_initiative_count,
      COALESCE(init_agg.at_risk_initiative_count, 0)     AS at_risk_initiative_count,
      COALESCE(init_agg.completed_initiative_count, 0)   AS completed_initiative_count,
      COALESCE(task_agg.adoption_task_count, 0)          AS adoption_task_count,
      COALESCE(task_agg.adoption_task_open_count, 0)     AS adoption_task_open_count,
      COALESCE(task_agg.adoption_task_completed_count,0) AS adoption_task_completed_count,
      COALESCE(task_agg.adoption_task_overdue_count, 0)  AS adoption_task_overdue_count,
      COALESCE(link_agg.adoption_risk_count, 0)          AS adoption_risk_count,
      COALESCE(link_agg.adoption_blocker_count, 0)       AS adoption_blocker_count,
      COALESCE(link_agg.adoption_kpi_count, 0)           AS adoption_kpi_count
    FROM plan
    LEFT JOIN init_agg ON init_agg.adoption_plan_id = plan.adoption_plan_id
    LEFT JOIN task_agg ON task_agg.project_id      = plan.project_id
    LEFT JOIN link_agg ON link_agg.adoption_plan_id = plan.adoption_plan_id
  ),
  derived AS (
    SELECT
      c.*,
      CASE
        WHEN c.readiness_status = 'at_risk' THEN 'at_risk'
        WHEN c.adoption_task_overdue_count > 0 THEN 'at_risk'
        WHEN c.at_risk_initiative_count > 0 THEN 'attention'
        WHEN c.readiness_status IN ('ready','reinforced') THEN 'ready'
        WHEN c.adoption_task_open_count > 0 OR c.active_initiative_count > 0 THEN 'on_track'
        ELSE 'preparing'
      END AS adoption_signal
    FROM combined c
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.project_id,
      d.workspace_id,
      d.organization_id,
      d.adoption_plan_id,
      true AS has_adoption_plan,
      d.readiness_status::text AS readiness_status,
      d.enabled,
      d.created_from_template,
      d.initiative_count,
      d.active_initiative_count,
      d.at_risk_initiative_count,
      d.completed_initiative_count,
      d.adoption_task_count,
      d.adoption_task_open_count,
      d.adoption_task_completed_count,
      d.adoption_task_overdue_count,
      d.adoption_risk_count,
      d.adoption_blocker_count,
      d.adoption_kpi_count,
      d.adoption_signal,
      CASE d.adoption_signal
        WHEN 'ready'     THEN 'Adoption ready'
        WHEN 'on_track'  THEN 'Adoption on track'
        WHEN 'attention' THEN 'Adoption needs attention'
        WHEN 'at_risk'   THEN 'Adoption at risk'
        WHEN 'preparing' THEN 'Adoption preparing'
        ELSE 'Adoption preparing'
      END AS adoption_label,
      (
        SELECT array_remove(ARRAY[
          CASE WHEN d.adoption_task_overdue_count > 0
            THEN d.adoption_task_overdue_count || ' adoption task' ||
                 CASE WHEN d.adoption_task_overdue_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' overdue'
          END,
          CASE WHEN d.adoption_task_open_count > 0
            THEN d.adoption_task_open_count || ' adoption task' ||
                 CASE WHEN d.adoption_task_open_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' open'
          END,
          CASE WHEN d.at_risk_initiative_count > 0
            THEN d.at_risk_initiative_count || ' initiative' ||
                 CASE WHEN d.at_risk_initiative_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' at risk'
          END,
          CASE WHEN d.adoption_risk_count > 0
            THEN d.adoption_risk_count || ' adoption risk' ||
                 CASE WHEN d.adoption_risk_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' linked'
          END,
          CASE WHEN d.adoption_blocker_count > 0
            THEN d.adoption_blocker_count || ' adoption blocker' ||
                 CASE WHEN d.adoption_blocker_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' linked'
          END,
          CASE WHEN d.adoption_kpi_count > 0
            THEN d.adoption_kpi_count || ' adoption KPI' ||
                 CASE WHEN d.adoption_kpi_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' linked'
          END,
          'Readiness: ' || initcap(replace(d.readiness_status::text, '_', ' '))
        ], NULL)
      ) AS reason_lines
    FROM derived d
    ORDER BY d.project_id
  ) AS x;

  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_adoption_substrate(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _uid uuid := auth.uid(); _org uuid; _plan record; _result jsonb;
        _initiatives jsonb; _links jsonb; _task_counts jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_project_access(_uid, _project_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden'; END IF;

  SELECT * INTO _plan FROM public.adoption_plans
   WHERE project_id = _project_id AND is_archived = false LIMIT 1;

  IF _plan.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'adoption_plan', NULL,
      'initiatives', '[]'::jsonb,
      'linked_task_counts', '{}'::jsonb,
      'linked_object_counts', '{}'::jsonb,
      'linked_objects', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  END IF;
  _org := _plan.organization_id;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', i.id,
    'adoption_plan_id', i.adoption_plan_id,
    'project_id', i.project_id,
    'name', public.btpm_decrypt(i.name, i.organization_id),
    'summary', public.btpm_decrypt(i.summary, i.organization_id),
    'readiness_area', i.readiness_area,
    'owner_id', i.owner_id,
    'status', i.status,
    'priority', i.priority,
    'target_date', i.target_date,
    'sort_order', i.sort_order,
    'is_archived', i.is_archived,
    'created_at', i.created_at,
    'updated_at', i.updated_at
  ) ORDER BY i.sort_order, i.created_at), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _initiatives
  FROM public.adoption_initiatives i
  WHERE i.adoption_plan_id = _plan.id AND i.is_archived = false;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(adoption_initiative_id::text, cnt), '{}'::jsonb)
  INTO _task_counts
  FROM (
    SELECT adoption_initiative_id, count(*) AS cnt
    FROM public.tasks
    WHERE project_id = _project_id AND adoption_initiative_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY adoption_initiative_id
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id', l.id,
    'adoption_initiative_id', l.adoption_initiative_id,
    'object_type', l.object_type,
    'object_id', l.object_id,
    'created_at', l.created_at
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _links
  FROM public.adoption_object_links l
  WHERE l.adoption_plan_id = _plan.id;

  _result := jsonb_build_object(
    'adoption_plan', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', _plan.id,
      'project_id', _plan.project_id,
      'organization_id', _plan.organization_id,
      'workspace_id', _plan.workspace_id,
      'objective', public.btpm_decrypt(_plan.objective, _org),
      'impacted_audience_summary', public.btpm_decrypt(_plan.impacted_audience_summary, _org),
      'approach_summary', public.btpm_decrypt(_plan.approach_summary, _org),
      'adoption_owner_id', _plan.adoption_owner_id,
      'readiness_status', _plan.readiness_status,
      'enabled', _plan.enabled,
      'created_from_template', _plan.created_from_template,
      'is_archived', _plan.is_archived,
      'created_by', _plan.created_by,
      'created_at', _plan.created_at,
      'updated_at', _plan.updated_at
    ),
    'initiatives', _initiatives,
    'linked_task_counts', _task_counts,
    'linked_object_counts', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(object_type, cnt), '{}'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT object_type, count(*) AS cnt FROM public.adoption_object_links
        WHERE adoption_plan_id = _plan.id GROUP BY object_type
      ) c
    ),
    'linked_objects', _links
  );
  RETURN _result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_all_blockers(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _org_id uuid; _result json;
BEGIN
  SELECT organization_id INTO _org_id FROM projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF _org_id IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::json; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not authorized to read this project' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) INTO _result FROM (
    SELECT b.id, b.title,
      CASE WHEN b.description IS NOT NULL AND b.description != ''
        THEN btpm_decrypt(b.description, b.organization_id) ELSE b.description END AS description,
      b.severity, b.status, b.target_id, b.target_type,
      b.organization_id, b.workspace_id,
      b.reported_by, b.resolved_by, b.resolved_at, b.created_at, b.updated_at
    FROM public.blockers b
    WHERE (b.target_type='project' AND b.target_id=_project_id)
      OR (b.target_type='phase' AND b.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM phases WHERE project_id=_project_id))
      OR (b.target_type='task'  AND b.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM tasks  WHERE project_id=_project_id))
    ORDER BY b.created_at DESC) t;
  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_all_risks(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _org_id uuid; _result json;
BEGIN
  SELECT organization_id INTO _org_id FROM projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF _org_id IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::json; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not authorized to read this project' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) INTO _result FROM (
    SELECT r.id, r.title,
      CASE WHEN r.description IS NOT NULL AND r.description != ''
        THEN btpm_decrypt(r.description, r.organization_id) ELSE r.description END AS description,
      CASE WHEN r.mitigation_plan IS NOT NULL AND r.mitigation_plan != ''
        THEN btpm_decrypt(r.mitigation_plan, r.organization_id) ELSE r.mitigation_plan END AS mitigation_plan,
      r.likelihood, r.impact, r.status, r.target_id, r.target_type,
      r.organization_id, r.workspace_id,
      r.reported_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at
    FROM public.risks r

      OR (r.target_type='phase' AND r.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM phases WHERE project_id=_project_id))
      OR (r.target_type='task'  AND r.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM tasks  WHERE project_id=_project_id))
    ORDER BY r.created_at DESC) t;
  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_governance_cadences(_project_id uuid, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _p record; _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  _p := _gov_assert_project_read(_project_id);
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_obj ORDER BY created_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      c.created_at,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', c.id,
        'organization_id', c.organization_id,
        'workspace_id', c.workspace_id,
        'project_id', c.project_id,
        'event_type', c.event_type,
        'event_name', btpm_decrypt(c.event_name, c.organization_id),
        'frequency_type', c.frequency_type,
        'owner_id', c.owner_id,
        'owner_stakeholder_id', c.owner_stakeholder_id,
        'owner_display_name', CASE
          WHEN c.owner_stakeholder_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            COALESCE(
              btpm_decrypt(sh.external_name, c.organization_id),
              btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, c.organization_id),
              p.email
            )
          WHEN c.owner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            COALESCE(btpm_decrypt(p2.display_name, c.organization_id), p2.email)
          ELSE NULL
        END,
        'next_expected_date', c.next_expected_date,
        'expected_evidence_type', btpm_decrypt(c.expected_evidence_type, c.organization_id),
        'created_at', c.created_at,
        'created_by', c.created_by,
        'updated_at', c.updated_at,
        'updated_by', c.updated_by,
        'archived_at', c.archived_at,
        'archived_by', c.archived_by,
        'last_completed_date', stats.last_completed_date,
        'last_record_id', stats.last_record_id,
        'record_count', COALESCE(stats.record_count, 0),
        'decision_count', COALESCE(stats.decision_count, 0),
        'link_count', COALESCE(stats.link_count, 0),
        'derived_status', _gov_derive_cadence_status(c.frequency_type, c.next_expected_date, c.archived_at),
        'is_overdue', (c.archived_at IS NULL AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
                       AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
                       AND c.next_expected_date < CURRENT_DATE),
        'is_due_soon', (c.archived_at IS NULL AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
                        AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
                        AND c.next_expected_date >= CURRENT_DATE
                        AND c.next_expected_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days')
      ) AS row_obj
    FROM governance_cadences c
    LEFT JOIN project_stakeholders sh ON sh.id = c.owner_stakeholder_id
    LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = sh.user_id
    LEFT JOIN profiles p2 ON p2.id = c.owner_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT
        MAX(r.actual_date_held) AS last_completed_date,
        (SELECT r2.id FROM governance_records r2
           WHERE r2.cadence_id = c.id AND r2.archived_at IS NULL
           ORDER BY r2.actual_date_held DESC, r2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_record_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL) AS record_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance_record_decisions d
           JOIN governance_records gr ON gr.id = d.governance_record_id
          WHERE gr.cadence_id = c.id AND gr.archived_at IS NULL AND d.archived_at IS NULL) AS decision_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance_record_links l
           JOIN governance_records gr ON gr.id = l.governance_record_id
          WHERE gr.cadence_id = c.id AND gr.archived_at IS NULL AND l.archived_at IS NULL) AS link_count
      FROM governance_records r
      WHERE r.cadence_id = c.id
    ) stats ON true
    WHERE c.project_id = _project_id
      AND (_include_archived OR c.archived_at IS NULL)
  ) sub;
  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

    'actual_date_held', r.actual_date_held,
    'summary', btpm_decrypt(r.summary, r.organization_id),
    'decisions_summary', btpm_decrypt(r.decisions_summary, r.organization_id),
    'external_reference_url', btpm_decrypt(r.external_reference_url, r.organization_id),
    'sharepoint_evidence_reference', btpm_decrypt(r.sharepoint_evidence_reference, r.organization_id),
    'has_sharepoint_evidence', (r.sharepoint_evidence_reference IS NOT NULL),
    'record_kind', r.record_kind,
    'decision_stage', r.decision_stage,
    'decision_question', btpm_decrypt(r.decision_question, r.organization_id),
    'decision_owner_stakeholder_id', r.decision_owner_stakeholder_id,
    'target_decision_date', r.target_decision_date,
    'decision_count', COALESCE((
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM governance_record_decisions d
      WHERE d.governance_record_id = r.id AND d.archived_at IS NULL), 0),
    'link_count', COALESCE((
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM governance_record_links l
      WHERE l.governance_record_id = r.id AND l.archived_at IS NULL), 0),
    'created_at', r.created_at,
    'created_by', r.created_by,
    'updated_at', r.updated_at,
    'updated_by', r.updated_by,
    'archived_at', r.archived_at,
    'archived_by', r.archived_by
  ) ORDER BY r.actual_date_held DESC), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _result
  FROM governance_records r
  LEFT JOIN governance_cadences c ON c.id = r.cadence_id
  WHERE r.project_id = _project_id
    AND (_include_archived OR r.archived_at IS NULL);
  RETURN _result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_people_presets(_workspace_id uuid, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, workspace_id uuid, organization_id uuid, name text, description text, created_by uuid, created_by_name text, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, archived_at timestamp with time zone, archived_by uuid, member_count integer, team_count integer, stakeholder_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_org   uuid;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated';
  END IF;
  SELECT w.organization_id INTO v_org FROM public.workspaces w WHERE w.id = _workspace_id;
  IF v_org IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace not found';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (public.is_workspace_member(v_actor, _workspace_id) OR public.is_org_admin(v_actor, v_org)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id,
    p.workspace_id,
    p.organization_id,
    public.btpm_decrypt(p.name,        p.organization_id)                                   AS name,
    public.btpm_decrypt(p.description, p.organization_id)                                   AS description,
    p.created_by,
    (SELECT COALESCE(pr.display_name, pr.email, p.created_by::text)
       FROM public.profiles pr WHERE pr.id = p.created_by)                                  AS created_by_name,
    p.created_at,
    p.updated_at,
    p.archived_at,
    p.archived_by,
    COALESCE(mc.total, 0)::int         AS member_count,
    COALESCE(mc.teams, 0)::int         AS team_count,
    COALESCE(mc.stakeholders, 0)::int  AS stakeholder_count
  FROM public.project_people_presets p
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_kind = 'team_member')::int AS teams,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_kind = 'stakeholder')::int AS stakeholders
      FROM public.project_people_preset_members m
     WHERE m.preset_id = p.id
  ) mc ON true
  WHERE p.workspace_id = _workspace_id
    AND (_include_archived OR p.archived_at IS NULL)
  ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC;
END; $function$
