CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_raci(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _result json;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not authorized to read this project' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t)) INTO _result FROM (
    SELECT ra.id,
           ra.target_type,
           ra.target_id,
           ra.user_id,
           ra.stakeholder_id,
           ra.raci_role,
           ra.created_at,
           ra.updated_at,
           ra.workspace_id,
           ra.organization_id,
           COALESCE(
             ps.external_name,
             CASE WHEN psp.organization_id IS NOT NULL
                  THEN public.btpm_decrypt(psp.display_name, psp.organization_id)
                  ELSE psp.display_name END,
             CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
                  THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
                  ELSE p.display_name END,
             p.email
           )::text AS display_name,
           ps.stakeholder_type AS stakeholder_type,
           ps.role_label AS stakeholder_role_label,
           p.email AS email,
           p.avatar_url AS avatar_url
    FROM public.raci_assignments ra
    LEFT JOIN public.project_stakeholders ps ON ps.id = ra.stakeholder_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles psp ON psp.id = ps.user_id
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = ra.user_id
    WHERE ra.target_type = 'project' AND ra.target_id = _project_id
    ORDER BY ra.created_at
  ) t;
  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_reporting_summaries(_workspace_id uuid, _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _include_demo boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid       uuid := auth.uid();
  _org_id    uuid;
  _is_demo   boolean;
  _today     date := (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date;
  _result    json;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT organization_id, is_demo
  INTO _org_id, _is_demo
  FROM public.workspaces
  WHERE id = _workspace_id;

  IF _org_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace not found' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.can_read_demo_or_member(_uid, _workspace_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not a workspace member' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF _is_demo AND NOT _include_demo AND _project_ids IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '[]'::json;
  END IF;

  WITH
  proj AS (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.workspace_id,
      p.organization_id,
      p.program_id,
      p.status,
      p.target_end_date,
      p.is_baselined,
      p.baseline_end_date
    FROM public.projects p
    WHERE p.workspace_id = _workspace_id
      AND p.is_archived = false
      AND (_project_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(_project_ids))
  ),
  task_agg AS (
    SELECT
      t.project_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status <> 'cancelled') AS task_actionable,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'completed') AS task_completed,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'cancelled') AS task_cancelled,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'planned') AS s_planned,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'active') AS s_active,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'on_hold') AS s_on_hold,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'completed') AS s_completed,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'cancelled') AS s_cancelled,
      COUNT(*) AS s_total,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE t.status IN ('planned','active')
          AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL
          AND t.due_date < _today
      ) AS behind_task_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status <> 'cancelled' AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL) AS tasks_with_dates,
      -- Duration-weighted completion inputs (BTPM headline progress).
      -- Mirrors `duration_weighted_completion_percent` in the canonical
      -- KPI engine: inclusive day math, min 1 day, end basis = due_date
      -- with fallback to baseline_end_date. Cancelled/archived tasks
      -- excluded. If ANY actionable task lacks a usable start/end basis,
      -- we record tasks_missing_dates_actionable > 0 and the computed
      -- step falls back to task-count completion (transparent fallback).
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE t.status <> 'cancelled'
          AND (
            t.start_date IS NULL
            OR COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) IS NULL
            OR COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) < t.start_date
          )
      ) AS tasks_missing_dates_actionable,
      COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN t.status <> 'cancelled'
            AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) >= t.start_date
          THEN GREATEST(1, (COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) - t.start_date) + 1)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ), 0) AS duration_total_days,
      COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN t.status = 'completed'
            AND t.start_date IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) >= t.start_date
          THEN GREATEST(1, (COALESCE(t.due_date, t.baseline_end_date) - t.start_date) + 1)
          ELSE 0
        END
      ), 0) AS duration_completed_days
    FROM public.tasks t
    JOIN proj ON proj.id = t.project_id
    WHERE t.is_archived = false
    GROUP BY t.project_id
  ),
  phase_agg AS (
    SELECT
      ph.project_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.status <> 'cancelled') AS phase_actionable,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.status = 'completed') AS phase_completed,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE ph.status IN ('planned','active')
          AND ph.target_end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND ph.target_end_date < _today
      ) AS behind_phase_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ph.target_end_date IS NOT NULL) AS phases_with_dates
    FROM public.phases ph
    JOIN proj ON proj.id = ph.project_id
    WHERE ph.is_archived = false
    GROUP BY ph.project_id
  ),
  blocker_agg AS (
    SELECT
      _proj.id AS project_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS open_blockers
    FROM proj _proj
    LEFT JOIN public.blockers b
      ON b.workspace_id = _proj.workspace_id
     AND (
          (b.target_type = 'project' AND b.target_id = _proj.id)
       OR (b.target_type = 'phase' AND b.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.phases WHERE project_id = _proj.id))
       OR (b.target_type = 'task' AND b.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.tasks WHERE project_id = _proj.id))
     )
    GROUP BY _proj.id
  ),
  risk_agg AS (
    SELECT
      _proj.id AS project_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (
        WHERE r.status IN ('open','under_mitigation','identified','mitigating')
          AND r.impact IN ('high','critical')
      ) AS active_high_risks,
      COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'realized') AS realized_risks
    FROM proj _proj
    LEFT JOIN public.risks r
      ON r.workspace_id = _proj.workspace_id
     AND (
          (r.target_type = 'project' AND r.target_id = _proj.id)
       OR (r.target_type = 'phase' AND r.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.phases WHERE project_id = _proj.id))
       OR (r.target_type = 'task' AND r.target_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.tasks WHERE project_id = _proj.id))
     )
    GROUP BY _proj.id
  ),
  derived AS (
    SELECT
      proj.id AS project_id,
      proj.workspace_id,
      proj.program_id,
      proj.status AS project_status,
      proj.target_end_date,
      proj.is_baselined,
      proj.baseline_end_date,
      COALESCE(ta.task_actionable, 0) AS task_actionable,
      COALESCE(ta.task_completed, 0) AS task_completed,
      COALESCE(ta.task_cancelled, 0) AS task_cancelled,
      COALESCE(ta.s_planned, 0) AS s_planned,
      COALESCE(ta.s_active, 0) AS s_active,
      COALESCE(ta.s_on_hold, 0) AS s_on_hold,
      COALESCE(ta.s_completed, 0) AS s_completed,
      COALESCE(ta.s_cancelled, 0) AS s_cancelled,
      COALESCE(ta.s_total, 0) AS s_total,
      COALESCE(ta.behind_task_count, 0) AS behind_task_count,
      COALESCE(ta.tasks_with_dates, 0) AS tasks_with_dates,
      COALESCE(ta.tasks_missing_dates_actionable, 0) AS tasks_missing_dates_actionable,
      COALESCE(ta.duration_total_days, 0) AS duration_total_days,
      COALESCE(ta.duration_completed_days, 0) AS duration_completed_days,
      COALESCE(pa.phase_actionable, 0) AS phase_actionable,
      COALESCE(pa.phase_completed, 0) AS phase_completed,
      COALESCE(pa.behind_phase_count, 0) AS behind_phase_count,
      COALESCE(pa.phases_with_dates, 0) AS phases_with_dates,
      COALESCE(ba.open_blockers, 0) AS open_blockers,
      COALESCE(ra.active_high_risks, 0) AS active_high_risks,
      COALESCE(ra.realized_risks, 0) AS realized_risks
    FROM proj
    LEFT JOIN task_agg ta ON ta.project_id = proj.id
    LEFT JOIN phase_agg pa ON pa.project_id = proj.id
    LEFT JOIN blocker_agg ba ON ba.project_id = proj.id
    LEFT JOIN risk_agg ra ON ra.project_id = proj.id
  ),
  computed AS (
    SELECT
      d.*,
      -- Headline project progress (BTPM rule): duration-weighted
      -- completion when every actionable task has a usable date basis,
      -- with transparent fallback to task-count completion otherwise.
      CASE
        WHEN d.task_actionable = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN d.tasks_missing_dates_actionable = 0 AND d.duration_total_days > 0
          THEN ROUND((d.duration_completed_days::numeric / d.duration_total_days::numeric) * 100)::int
        ELSE ROUND((d.task_completed::numeric / d.task_actionable::numeric) * 100)::int
      END AS completion_percent,
      CASE
        WHEN d.task_actionable = 0 THEN 'none'
        WHEN d.tasks_missing_dates_actionable = 0 AND d.duration_total_days > 0 THEN 'duration'
        ELSE 'task_count'
      END AS completion_basis,
      (d.target_end_date IS NOT NULL OR d.phases_with_dates > 0 OR d.tasks_with_dates > 0) AS has_schedule_basis,
      (d.phase_actionable > 0 AND d.phase_actionable = d.phase_completed) AS all_phases_complete,
      (d.target_end_date IS NOT NULL AND d.target_end_date < _today) AS project_target_overdue,
      CASE
        WHEN d.is_baselined AND d.baseline_end_date IS NOT NULL AND d.target_end_date IS NOT NULL
          THEN (d.target_end_date - d.baseline_end_date)
        ELSE NULL
      END AS baseline_slip_days
    FROM derived d
  ),
  scored AS (
    SELECT
      c.*,
      CASE
        WHEN c.all_phases_complete THEN 'complete'
        WHEN NOT c.has_schedule_basis THEN 'no_schedule_basis'
        WHEN c.project_target_overdue OR c.behind_phase_count > 0 OR c.behind_task_count > 0 THEN 'behind_schedule'
        ELSE 'on_track'
      END AS schedule_signal,
      (
          (CASE WHEN c.behind_task_count >= 3 THEN 2 WHEN c.behind_task_count >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN c.behind_phase_count >= 2 THEN 2 WHEN c.behind_phase_count >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN c.project_target_overdue AND NOT c.all_phases_complete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN c.open_blockers >= 2 THEN 2 WHEN c.open_blockers >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN c.active_high_risks >= 2 THEN 2 WHEN c.active_high_risks >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN c.realized_risks > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
      ) AS health_score
    FROM computed c
  )
  SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(out_row) ORDER BY out_row.project_id)
  INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.project_id,
      s.workspace_id,
      s.program_id,
      s.completion_percent,
      s.completion_basis,
      s.s_total AS task_total_count,
      s.task_completed AS task_completed_count,
      s.task_cancelled AS task_cancelled_count,
      json_build_object(
        'planned', s.s_planned,
        'active', s.s_active,
        'on_hold', s.s_on_hold,
        'completed', s.s_completed,
        'cancelled', s.s_cancelled,
        'total', s.s_total
      ) AS status_counts,
      s.schedule_signal,
      (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(code), '[]'::json)
        FROM (
          SELECT 'all_phases_complete' AS code WHERE s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT 'no_schedule_basis' WHERE NOT s.has_schedule_basis
          UNION ALL SELECT 'project_target_overdue' WHERE s.project_target_overdue AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT 'behind_phases' WHERE s.behind_phase_count > 0 AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT 'behind_tasks' WHERE s.behind_task_count > 0 AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT 'baseline_slip' WHERE s.baseline_slip_days IS NOT NULL AND s.baseline_slip_days > 0
        ) x
      ) AS schedule_reason_codes,
      (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(line), '[]'::json)
        FROM (
          SELECT 'All phases complete' AS line WHERE s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT 'No schedule basis available' WHERE NOT s.has_schedule_basis
          UNION ALL SELECT 'Project target end date has passed' WHERE s.project_target_overdue AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT (s.behind_phase_count || ' phase' || CASE WHEN s.behind_phase_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' overdue') WHERE s.behind_phase_count > 0 AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT (s.behind_task_count || ' task' || CASE WHEN s.behind_task_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END || ' overdue') WHERE s.behind_task_count > 0 AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT ('Baseline slip: +' || s.baseline_slip_days || ' day' || CASE WHEN s.baseline_slip_days = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) WHERE s.baseline_slip_days IS NOT NULL AND s.baseline_slip_days > 0
        ) x
      ) AS schedule_reason_lines,
      s.behind_task_count,
      s.behind_phase_count,
      s.has_schedule_basis,
      s.health_score,
      CASE
        WHEN s.health_score = 0 THEN 'green'
        WHEN s.health_score <= 2 THEN 'amber'
        ELSE 'red'
      END AS health_rag,
      CASE
        WHEN s.health_score = 0 THEN 'On Track'
        WHEN s.health_score <= 2 THEN 'Needs Attention'
        ELSE 'At Risk'
      END AS health_label,
      (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(code), '[]'::json)
        FROM (
          SELECT 'overdue_tasks' AS code WHERE s.behind_task_count > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'overdue_phases' WHERE s.behind_phase_count > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'project_target_overdue' WHERE s.project_target_overdue AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT 'open_blockers' WHERE s.open_blockers > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'active_high_risks' WHERE s.active_high_risks > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'realized_risks' WHERE s.realized_risks > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'baseline_slip' WHERE s.baseline_slip_days IS NOT NULL AND s.baseline_slip_days > 0
        ) x
      ) AS health_reason_codes,
      (
        SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(line), '[]'::json)
        FROM (
          SELECT (s.behind_task_count || ' overdue task' || CASE WHEN s.behind_task_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) AS line WHERE s.behind_task_count > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT (s.behind_phase_count || ' overdue phase' || CASE WHEN s.behind_phase_count = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) WHERE s.behind_phase_count > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'Project target end date has passed' WHERE s.project_target_overdue AND NOT s.all_phases_complete
          UNION ALL SELECT (s.open_blockers || ' open blocker' || CASE WHEN s.open_blockers = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) WHERE s.open_blockers > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT (s.active_high_risks || ' high-impact risk' || CASE WHEN s.active_high_risks = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) WHERE s.active_high_risks > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT (s.realized_risks || ' realized risk' || CASE WHEN s.realized_risks = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) WHERE s.realized_risks > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT ('Baseline slip: +' || s.baseline_slip_days || ' day' || CASE WHEN s.baseline_slip_days = 1 THEN '' ELSE 's' END) WHERE s.baseline_slip_days IS NOT NULL AND s.baseline_slip_days > 0
          UNION ALL SELECT 'No issues detected' WHERE s.health_score = 0
        ) x
      ) AS health_reason_lines,
      s.is_baselined,
      s.baseline_end_date,
      s.target_end_date,
      s.baseline_slip_days,
      json_build_object(
        'has_phases', (s.phase_actionable > 0),
        'has_tasks', (s.s_total > 0),
        'has_target_end_date', (s.target_end_date IS NOT NULL),
        'has_baseline', s.is_baselined,
        'has_schedule_basis', s.has_schedule_basis
      ) AS data_sufficiency_flags,
      now() AS computed_at
    FROM scored s
  ) out_row;

  RETURN COALESCE(_result, '[]'::json);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_project_stakeholders(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, stakeholder_type text, user_id uuid, external_name text, display_name text, role_label text, notes text, start_date date, created_at timestamp with time zone, created_by uuid, created_by_name text, removed_at timestamp with time zone, removed_by uuid, removed_by_name text, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_ws uuid;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501'; END IF;
  SELECT pr.organization_id, pr.workspace_id INTO v_org, v_ws
  FROM public.projects pr WHERE pr.id = _project_id;
  IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Project not found' USING ERRCODE = 'P0002'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(v_actor, _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: not authorized to read this project' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT s.id, s.stakeholder_type, s.user_id, s.external_name,
    COALESCE(s.external_name,
      CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
           ELSE p.display_name END,
      p.email, 'Member')::text AS display_name,
    s.role_label, s.notes, s.start_date, s.created_at, s.created_by,
    CASE WHEN cb.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN public.btpm_decrypt(cb.display_name, cb.organization_id)
         ELSE cb.display_name END::text AS created_by_name,
    s.removed_at, s.removed_by,
    CASE WHEN rb.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN public.btpm_decrypt(rb.display_name, rb.organization_id)
         ELSE rb.display_name END::text AS removed_by_name,
    s.updated_at
  FROM public.project_stakeholders s
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = s.user_id
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles cb ON cb.id = s.created_by
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles rb ON rb.id = s.removed_by
  WHERE s.project_id = _project_id
  ORDER BY (s.removed_at IS NOT NULL) ASC, s.created_at DESC;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_roadmap_calendar_markers(_project_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_allowed uuid[];
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RETURN '[]'::jsonb; END IF;
  IF _project_ids IS NULL OR array_length(_project_ids, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '[]'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  -- Filter project list down to those the caller can read (workspace member or org admin).
  SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(p.id), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
  INTO v_allowed
  FROM public.projects p
  WHERE p.id = ANY(_project_ids)
    AND (
      public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, p.workspace_id)
      OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, p.organization_id)
    );

  IF v_allowed IS NULL OR array_length(v_allowed, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '[]'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  WITH
  phase_markers AS (
    SELECT
      'phase'::text                  AS object_kind,
      ph.id                          AS object_id,
      ph.name                        AS object_name,
      ph.phase_type::text            AS semantic_type,
      ph.target_end_date             AS event_date,
      ph.project_id                  AS project_id,
      NULL::uuid                     AS phase_id,
      NULL::text                     AS phase_name
    FROM public.phases ph
    WHERE ph.project_id = ANY(v_allowed)
      AND ph.is_archived = false
      AND ph.target_end_date IS NOT NULL
      AND ph.phase_type::text IN ('milestone','deliverable','decision','review')
  ),
  task_markers AS (
    SELECT
      'task'::text                   AS object_kind,
      t.id                           AS object_id,
      t.name                         AS object_name,
      t.task_type::text              AS semantic_type,
      t.due_date                     AS event_date,
      t.project_id                   AS project_id,
      t.phase_id                     AS phase_id,
      ph.name                        AS phase_name
    FROM public.tasks t
    LEFT JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.id = t.phase_id
    WHERE t.project_id = ANY(v_allowed)
      AND t.is_archived = false
      AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL
      AND t.task_type::text IN ('milestone','deliverable','decision','review')
  ),
  unioned AS (
    SELECT * FROM phase_markers
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM task_markers
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'object_kind',   u.object_kind,
    'object_id',     u.object_id,
    'object_name',   u.object_name,
    'semantic_type', u.semantic_type,
    'event_date',    u.event_date,
    'project_id',    u.project_id,
    'phase_id',      u.phase_id,
    'phase_name',    u.phase_name,
    'workspace_id',  p.workspace_id,
    'project_name',  p.name,
    'project_status', p.status::text
  ) ORDER BY u.event_date, u.object_name), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_result
  FROM unioned u
  JOIN public.projects p ON p.id = u.project_id;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_result, '[]'::jsonb);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_roadmap_story_pack_included_files(_story_pack_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, drive_id text, item_id text, display_name text, web_url text, mime_type text, size_bytes bigint, include_in_story boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _pack public.roadmap_story_packs;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT p.* INTO _pack FROM public.roadmap_story_packs p WHERE p.id = _story_pack_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR _pack.created_by <> _uid THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    f.id,
    f.drive_id,
    f.item_id,
    CASE WHEN f.display_name_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(f.display_name_encrypted, _pack.organization_id) END,
    CASE WHEN f.web_url_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(f.web_url_encrypted, _pack.organization_id) END,
    f.mime_type,
    f.size_bytes,
    f.include_in_story
  FROM public.roadmap_story_pack_external_files f
  WHERE f.story_pack_id = _story_pack_id
  ORDER BY f.created_at ASC;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_roadmap_story_packs(_include_archived boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO _result
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.id,
      p.organization_id,
      p.primary_workspace_id,
      p.program_id,
      p.status,
      p.audience,
      p.focus,
      CASE WHEN p.title_encrypted IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(p.title_encrypted, p.organization_id) END AS title,
      p.created_at,
      p.updated_at
    FROM public.roadmap_story_packs p
    WHERE p.created_by = _uid
      AND (_include_archived OR p.status <> 'archived')
  ) t;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_user_org_admin(auth.uid(), _organization_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT om.user_id,
         CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
              THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
              ELSE p.display_name END AS dn,
         p.email
  FROM public.organization_memberships om
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=om.user_id
  WHERE om.organization_id=_organization_id AND om.status='active' AND om.role='org_member'
    AND (_query IS NULL OR _query='' OR p.email ILIKE '%'||_query||'%' OR
         (CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
               THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
               ELSE p.display_name END) ILIKE '%'||_query||'%')
  ORDER BY dn NULLS LAST, p.email NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 50;
END;$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.pa_can_admin_workspace(_workspace_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized to administer this workspace';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH ws_projects AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.projects WHERE workspace_id = _workspace_id AND is_archived = false
  ),
  total AS (SELECT count(*)::int AS c FROM ws_projects)
  SELECT wm.user_id,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT count(*)::int
           FROM public.project_memberships pm
           WHERE pm.user_id = wm.user_id
             AND pm.removed_at IS NULL
             AND pm.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM ws_projects)
         ), 0),
         (SELECT c FROM total)
  FROM public.workspace_memberships wm
  WHERE wm.workspace_id = _workspace_id;
END;

 RETURNS jsonb

 SET search_path TO 'public'

BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_platform_super_admin(_uid) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(

      'total',            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.organizations),
      'production',       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.organizations WHERE environment_role = 'production'),
      'non_production',   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.organizations WHERE environment_role = 'non_production')
    ),
    'substrate', jsonb_build_object(
      'tenant_memberships',       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_memberships),
      'organization_memberships', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.organization_memberships),
      'tenant_integrations',      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_integrations),

      'tenant_export_packages',   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_export_packages),
      'tenant_background_jobs',   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_background_jobs),
      'tenant_scheduler_runs',    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_scheduler_runs)
    ),
    'generated_at', now(),
    'reason', _reason
  );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preview_project_clone_blueprint(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _project public.projects%ROWTYPE; _org uuid; _ws uuid; _anchor date;
  _schedule_mode text; _anchor_source text;
  _project_obj jsonb; _phases jsonb; _tasks jsonb; _deps jsonb; _kpis jsonb;
  _agile jsonb; _states jsonb; _sprints jsonb; _backlog jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'authentication required'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO _project FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'project not found'; END IF;
  _org := _project.organization_id; _ws := _project.workspace_id;
  IF NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PM authority required for project clone blueprint'; END IF;
  _anchor := public._clone_anchor_for_project(_project_id);
  IF _anchor IS NULL THEN _schedule_mode := 'unscheduled'; _anchor_source := NULL;
  ELSIF _project.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN _schedule_mode := 'relative'; _anchor_source := 'project_start_date';
  ELSE _schedule_mode := 'relative'; _anchor_source := 'earliest_planning_date'; END IF;
  _project_obj := jsonb_build_object('name', _project.name,
    'description', public.btpm_decrypt(_project.description, _org),
    'charter', public.btpm_decrypt(_project.charter, _org),
    'goals', public.btpm_decrypt(_project.goals, _org),
    'scope_in', public.btpm_decrypt(_project.scope_in, _org),
    'scope_out', public.btpm_decrypt(_project.scope_out, _org),
    'priority', _project.priority, 'agile_enabled', _project.agile_enabled,
    'schedule', jsonb_build_object(
      'start_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, _project.start_date),
      'target_end_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, _project.target_end_date)));
  WITH ph AS (SELECT 'phase_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.created_at) AS ref, p.*
    FROM public.phases p WHERE p.project_id = _project_id AND p.is_archived = false)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'source_id', id,
    'name', public.btpm_decrypt(name, _org),
    'description', public.btpm_decrypt(description, _org),
    'phase_type', phase_type, 'sort_order', sort_order,
    'schedule', jsonb_build_object(
      'start_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, start_date),
      'target_end_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, target_end_date))
  ) ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _phases FROM ph;
  WITH ph AS (SELECT 'phase_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.created_at) AS ref, p.id
    FROM public.phases p WHERE p.project_id = _project_id AND p.is_archived = false),
  bi AS (SELECT 'backlog_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.sort_order, b.created_at) AS ref, b.id
    FROM public.backlog_items b WHERE b.project_id = _project_id AND b.is_archived = false),
  ws AS (SELECT 'state_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.sort_order, w.created_at) AS ref, w.id
    FROM public.board_workflow_states w WHERE w.project_id = _project_id AND w.is_archived = false),
  tk AS (SELECT 'task_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.phase_id, t.sort_order, t.created_at) AS ref,
    t.*, ph.ref AS phase_ref, bi.ref AS backlog_ref, ws.ref AS state_ref
    FROM public.tasks t JOIN ph ON ph.id = t.phase_id
    LEFT JOIN bi ON bi.id = t.backlog_item_id
    LEFT JOIN ws ON ws.id = t.workflow_state_id
    WHERE t.project_id = _project_id AND t.is_archived = false)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'source_id', id, 'phase_ref', phase_ref,
    'name', public.btpm_decrypt(name, _org),
    'description', public.btpm_decrypt(description, _org),
    'task_type', task_type, 'priority', priority, 'estimated_hours', estimated_hours,
    'sort_order', sort_order, 'backlog_item_ref', backlog_ref, 'workflow_state_ref', state_ref,
    'schedule', jsonb_build_object(
      'start_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, start_date),
      'due_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, due_date))
  ) ORDER BY phase_ref, sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _tasks FROM tk;
  WITH ph AS (SELECT 'phase_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.created_at) AS ref, p.id
    FROM public.phases p WHERE p.project_id = _project_id AND p.is_archived = false),
  tk AS (SELECT 'task_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.phase_id, t.sort_order, t.created_at) AS ref, t.id
    FROM public.tasks t WHERE t.project_id = _project_id AND t.is_archived = false),
  ph_deps AS (SELECT 'phase' AS entity_type, src.ref AS source_ref, tgt.ref AS target_ref,
    d.dependency_type, public.btpm_decrypt(d.description, _org) AS description
    FROM public.dependencies d JOIN ph src ON d.source_type = 'phase' AND d.source_id = src.id
    JOIN ph tgt ON d.target_type = 'phase' AND d.target_id = tgt.id),
  tk_deps AS (SELECT 'task' AS entity_type, src.ref AS source_ref, tgt.ref AS target_ref,
    d.dependency_type, public.btpm_decrypt(d.description, _org) AS description
    FROM public.dependencies d JOIN tk src ON d.source_type = 'task' AND d.source_id = src.id
    JOIN tk tgt ON d.target_type = 'task' AND d.target_id = tgt.id),
  all_deps AS (SELECT * FROM ph_deps UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tk_deps)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('entity_type', entity_type, 'source_ref', source_ref,
    'target_ref', target_ref, 'dependency_type', dependency_type, 'description', description)),
    '[]'::jsonb) INTO _deps FROM all_deps;
  WITH k AS (SELECT 'kpi_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY kd.created_at) AS ref, kd.*
    FROM public.kpi_definitions kd WHERE kd.target_type='project' AND kd.target_id=_project_id AND kd.is_archived=false)
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'source_id', id,
    'name', public.btpm_decrypt(name, _org),
    'description', public.btpm_decrypt(description, _org),
    'unit', unit, 'target_value', target_value, 'target_direction', target_direction)),
    '[]'::jsonb) INTO _kpis FROM k;
  IF _project.agile_enabled THEN
    WITH ws AS (SELECT 'state_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.sort_order, w.created_at) AS ref, w.*
      FROM public.board_workflow_states w WHERE w.project_id=_project_id AND w.is_archived=false)
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'source_id', id,
      'name', public.btpm_decrypt(name, _org), 'category', category, 'sort_order', sort_order)
      ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _states FROM ws;
    WITH sp AS (SELECT 'sprint_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.created_at) AS ref, s.*
      FROM public.sprints s WHERE s.project_id=_project_id AND s.is_archived=false)
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'source_id', id, 'name', name,
      'goal', public.btpm_decrypt(goal, _org), 'sort_order', sort_order,
      'schedule', jsonb_build_object(
        'start_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, start_date),
        'end_offset_days', public._clone_offset_days(_anchor, end_date)))
      ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _sprints FROM sp;
    WITH ph AS (SELECT 'phase_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.created_at) AS ref, p.id
      FROM public.phases p WHERE p.project_id=_project_id AND p.is_archived=false),
    sp AS (SELECT 'sprint_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.sort_order, s.created_at) AS ref, s.id
      FROM public.sprints s WHERE s.project_id=_project_id AND s.is_archived=false),
    ws AS (SELECT 'state_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY w.sort_order, w.created_at) AS ref, w.id
      FROM public.board_workflow_states w WHERE w.project_id=_project_id AND w.is_archived=false),
    bi AS (SELECT 'backlog_' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.sort_order, b.created_at) AS ref, b.*,
      ph.ref AS phase_ref, sp.ref AS sprint_ref, ws.ref AS state_ref
      FROM public.backlog_items b LEFT JOIN ph ON ph.id = b.phase_id
      LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.id = b.sprint_id
      LEFT JOIN ws ON ws.id = b.workflow_state_id
      WHERE b.project_id = _project_id AND b.is_archived = false)
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'source_id', id, 'title', title,
      'description', public.btpm_decrypt(description, _org), 'priority', priority,
      'sort_order', sort_order, 'phase_ref', phase_ref, 'sprint_ref', sprint_ref,
      'workflow_state_ref', state_ref) ORDER BY sort_order), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _backlog FROM bi;
    _agile := jsonb_build_object('enabled', true,
      'workflow_states', COALESCE(_states, '[]'::jsonb),
      'sprints', COALESCE(_sprints, '[]'::jsonb),
      'backlog_items', COALESCE(_backlog, '[]'::jsonb));
  ELSE
    _agile := jsonb_build_object('enabled', false,
      'workflow_states', '[]'::jsonb, 'sprints', '[]'::jsonb, 'backlog_items', '[]'::jsonb);
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('version', 'clone_blueprint_v1', 'blueprint_kind', 'project',
    'saved_at', to_jsonb(now()), 'schedule_mode', _schedule_mode, 'anchor_source', _anchor_source,
    'anchor_date', _anchor,
    'source', jsonb_build_object('organization_id', _org, 'workspace_id', _ws,
      'project_id', _project_id, 'phase_id', NULL),
    'project', _project_obj, 'phase', NULL, 'phases', _phases, 'tasks', _tasks,
    'dependencies', _deps, 'kpi_definitions', _kpis, 'agile', _agile);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preview_project_people_preset_application(_preset_id uuid, _project_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor           uuid := auth.uid();
  v_preset          public.project_people_presets;
  v_project         record;
  v_items           jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_errors          jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_will_team       int := 0;
  v_will_stake      int := 0;
  v_already         int := 0;
  v_skipped         int := 0;
  v_total           int := 0;
  v_has_blocking    boolean := false;
  v_preset_name     text;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_preset FROM public.project_people_presets WHERE id = _preset_id;
  IF v_preset.id IS NULL THEN
    -- Uniform not-authorized envelope (do not leak existence)
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT id, workspace_id, organization_id
    INTO v_project
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF v_project.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Read authority: preset workspace access + project read access
  IF NOT (public.is_workspace_member(v_actor, v_preset.workspace_id)
          OR public.is_org_admin(v_actor, v_preset.organization_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_project(v_actor, _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_preset_name := public.btpm_decrypt(v_preset.name, v_preset.organization_id);

  -- Preset/project scope errors are fatal (has_blocking_errors=true)
  IF v_preset.workspace_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_project.workspace_id
     OR v_preset.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_project.organization_id THEN
    v_has_blocking := true;
    v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'code','workspace_mismatch',
      'message','Preset and project belong to different workspaces or organizations.'));
  END IF;
  IF v_preset.scope_type <> 'workspace' THEN
    v_has_blocking := true;
    v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'code','invalid_scope','message','Preset scope must be workspace.'));
  END IF;
  IF v_preset.archived_at IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_has_blocking := true;
    v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'code','preset_archived','message','Preset is archived.'));
  END IF;

  IF v_has_blocking THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'summary', jsonb_build_object(
        'preset_id',              _preset_id,
        'preset_name',            v_preset_name,
        'project_id',             _project_id,
        'total_members',          0,
        'will_add_team_members',  0,
        'will_add_stakeholders',  0,
        'already_exists',         0,
        'skipped_ineligible',     0,
        'has_blocking_errors',    true
      ),
      'items',  '[]'::jsonb,
      'errors', v_errors
    );
  END IF;

  -- Per-member classification (materialized in one CTE for consistency)
  WITH src AS (
    SELECT
      m.id                                                             AS member_id,
      m.member_kind,
      m.stakeholder_type,
      m.user_id,
      m.canonical_role_key,
      NULLIF(btrim(public.btpm_decrypt(m.role_label,    v_preset.organization_id)), '') AS role_label,
      NULLIF(btrim(public.btpm_decrypt(m.external_name, v_preset.organization_id)), '') AS external_name_plain
    FROM public.project_people_preset_members m
    WHERE m.preset_id = _preset_id
  ),
  classified AS (
    SELECT
      s.*,
      CASE
        -- ============ Team member (internal) ============
        WHEN s.member_kind = 'team_member' THEN
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.project_team_members ptm
                          WHERE ptm.project_id = _project_id AND ptm.user_id = s.user_id)
              THEN 'already_exists'
            WHEN NOT public.is_active_user(s.user_id)
              THEN 'inactive_user'
            WHEN NOT public.is_workspace_member(s.user_id, v_project.workspace_id)
              THEN 'no_longer_workspace_member'
            ELSE 'will_add'
          END
        -- ============ Internal stakeholder ============
        WHEN s.member_kind = 'stakeholder' AND s.stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member' THEN
          CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.project_stakeholders sk
                          WHERE sk.project_id = _project_id
                            AND sk.stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member'
                            AND sk.user_id = s.user_id
                            AND sk.removed_at IS NULL)
              THEN 'already_exists'
            WHEN NOT public.is_active_user(s.user_id)
              THEN 'inactive_user'
            WHEN NOT public.is_workspace_member(s.user_id, v_project.workspace_id)
              THEN 'no_longer_workspace_member'
            WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.project_stakeholders sk
                          WHERE sk.project_id = _project_id
                            AND sk.stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member'
                            AND sk.user_id = s.user_id
                            AND sk.removed_at IS NOT NULL)
              THEN 'otherwise_ineligible'
            ELSE 'will_add'
          END
        -- ============ External stakeholder ============
        WHEN s.member_kind = 'stakeholder' AND s.stakeholder_type = 'external' THEN
          CASE
            WHEN s.external_name_plain IS NULL THEN 'invalid_external'
            WHEN EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.project_stakeholders sk
              WHERE sk.project_id = _project_id
                AND sk.stakeholder_type = 'external'
                AND sk.removed_at IS NULL
                AND lower(btrim(sk.external_name)) = lower(s.external_name_plain)
            ) THEN 'already_exists'
            ELSE 'will_add'
          END
        ELSE 'otherwise_ineligible'
      END AS classification
    FROM src s
  )
  SELECT
    COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'member_id',          c.member_id,
      'member_kind',        c.member_kind,
      'stakeholder_type',   c.stakeholder_type,
      'user_id',            c.user_id,
      'display_name',       CASE
        WHEN c.user_id IS NOT NULL
          THEN (SELECT COALESCE(
                          CASE WHEN pr.organization_id IS NOT NULL
                               THEN public.btpm_decrypt(pr.display_name, pr.organization_id)
                               ELSE pr.display_name END,
                          pr.email, c.user_id::text)
                  FROM public.profiles pr WHERE pr.id = c.user_id)
        ELSE c.external_name_plain
      END,
      'canonical_role_key', c.canonical_role_key,
      'role_label',         c.role_label,
      'classification',     c.classification,
      'reason', CASE
        WHEN c.classification = 'otherwise_ineligible'
             AND c.member_kind = 'stakeholder'
             AND c.stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member'
          THEN 'previously_removed'
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) ORDER BY c.member_kind, c.member_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    COUNT(*)::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.classification = 'will_add' AND c.member_kind = 'team_member')::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.classification = 'will_add' AND c.member_kind = 'stakeholder')::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.classification = 'already_exists')::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.classification NOT IN ('will_add','already_exists'))::int
    INTO v_items, v_total, v_will_team, v_will_stake, v_already, v_skipped
    FROM classified c;

  IF v_total = 0 THEN
    v_has_blocking := true;
    v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'code','empty_preset','message','Preset has no members to apply.'));
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'summary', jsonb_build_object(
      'preset_id',              _preset_id,
      'preset_name',            v_preset_name,
      'project_id',             _project_id,
      'total_members',          v_total,
      'will_add_team_members',  v_will_team,
      'will_add_stakeholders',  v_will_stake,
      'already_exists',         v_already,
      'skipped_ineligible',     v_skipped,
      'has_blocking_errors',    v_has_blocking
    ),
    'items',  v_items,
    'errors', v_errors
  );
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preview_project_planning_change(_project_id uuid, _new_start date, _new_end date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pr record; bad record;
BEGIN
  SELECT id, organization_id, workspace_id, name, start_date, target_end_date
    INTO pr FROM public.projects WHERE id = _project_id;
  IF pr.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'requires_extension', false, 'blocked', true,
      'blocked_reason', 'project_not_found',
      'parent_current_start', NULL, 'parent_current_end', NULL,
      'parent_proposed_start', NULL, 'parent_proposed_end', NULL); END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'requires_extension', false, 'blocked', true,
      'blocked_reason', 'not_authorized',
      'parent_current_start', pr.start_date, 'parent_current_end', pr.target_end_date,
      'parent_proposed_start', _new_start, 'parent_proposed_end', _new_end); END IF;
  IF _new_start IS NOT NULL AND _new_end IS NOT NULL AND _new_end < _new_start THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'requires_extension', false, 'blocked', true,
      'blocked_reason', 'invalid_range',
      'parent_current_start', pr.start_date, 'parent_current_end', pr.target_end_date,
      'parent_proposed_start', _new_start, 'parent_proposed_end', _new_end); END IF;
  IF _new_start IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id, name, start_date AS d INTO bad FROM public.phases
     WHERE project_id = pr.id AND status <> 'cancelled' AND NOT is_archived
       AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND start_date < _new_start
     ORDER BY start_date ASC LIMIT 1;
    IF bad.id IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'requires_extension', false, 'blocked', true,
        'blocked_reason', 'project_shrinks_under_child_start:' || bad.name || ':' || bad.d::text,
        'parent_current_start', pr.start_date, 'parent_current_end', pr.target_end_date,
        'parent_proposed_start', _new_start, 'parent_proposed_end', _new_end); END IF;
  END IF;
  IF _new_end IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id, name, target_end_date AS d INTO bad FROM public.phases
     WHERE project_id = pr.id AND status <> 'cancelled' AND NOT is_archived
       AND target_end_date IS NOT NULL AND target_end_date > _new_end
     ORDER BY target_end_date DESC LIMIT 1;
    IF bad.id IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', false, 'requires_extension', false, 'blocked', true,
        'blocked_reason', 'project_shrinks_under_child_end:' || bad.name || ':' || bad.d::text,
        'parent_current_start', pr.start_date, 'parent_current_end', pr.target_end_date,
        'parent_proposed_start', _new_start, 'parent_proposed_end', _new_end); END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('valid', true, 'requires_extension', false, 'blocked', false,
    'blocked_reason', NULL,
    'parent_project_id', pr.id, 'parent_project_name', pr.name,
    'parent_current_start', pr.start_date, 'parent_current_end', pr.target_end_date,
    'parent_proposed_start', _new_start, 'parent_proposed_end', _new_end);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_governance_cadences(_organization_id uuid, _workspace_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _include_archived boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM _gov_report_assert_scope(_organization_id, _workspace_id);

  WITH eligible_projects AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.organization_id, p.workspace_id
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.organization_id = _organization_id
      AND (_workspace_id IS NULL OR p.workspace_id = _workspace_id)
      AND (_project_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(_project_ids))
      AND (
        is_org_admin(_uid, p.organization_id)
        OR is_workspace_member(_uid, p.workspace_id)
      )
  ),
  cadence_record_agg AS (
    SELECT
      r.cadence_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL) AS record_count,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.archived_at IS NULL THEN r.actual_date_held END) AS last_completed_date
    FROM governance_records r
    WHERE r.cadence_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY r.cadence_id
  ),
  decision_per_cadence AS (
    SELECT r.cadence_id, COUNT(d.*) AS decision_count
    FROM governance_records r
    LEFT JOIN governance_record_decisions d
           ON d.governance_record_id = r.id AND d.archived_at IS NULL
    WHERE r.cadence_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.archived_at IS NULL
      AND r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY r.cadence_id
  ),
  link_per_cadence AS (
    SELECT r.cadence_id, COUNT(l.*) AS link_count
    FROM governance_records r
    LEFT JOIN governance_record_links l
           ON l.governance_record_id = r.id AND l.archived_at IS NULL
    WHERE r.cadence_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.archived_at IS NULL
      AND r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY r.cadence_id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id',     c.organization_id,
    'workspace_id',        c.workspace_id,
    'project_id',          c.project_id,
    'cadence_id',          c.id,
    'event_type',          c.event_type,
    'event_name',          public.btpm_decrypt(c.event_name, c.organization_id),
    'frequency_type',      c.frequency_type,
    'owner_id',            c.owner_id,
    'owner_display_name',  CASE WHEN c.owner_id IS NULL THEN NULL
                                ELSE public.btpm_decrypt(pr.display_name, c.organization_id) END,
    'owner_email',         CASE WHEN c.owner_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pr.email END,
    'next_expected_date',  c.next_expected_date,
    'last_completed_date', cra.last_completed_date,
    'record_count',        COALESCE(cra.record_count, 0),
    'decision_count',      COALESCE(dpc.decision_count, 0),
    'link_count',          COALESCE(lpc.link_count, 0),
    'derived_status',      _gov_derive_cadence_status(c.frequency_type, c.next_expected_date, c.archived_at),
    'is_archived',         (c.archived_at IS NOT NULL),
    'archived_at',         c.archived_at,
    'created_at',          c.created_at,
    'updated_at',          c.updated_at
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM governance_cadences c
  JOIN eligible_projects ep ON ep.id = c.project_id
  LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON pr.id = c.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN cadence_record_agg cra ON cra.cadence_id = c.id
  LEFT JOIN decision_per_cadence dpc ON dpc.cadence_id = c.id
  LEFT JOIN link_per_cadence lpc ON lpc.cadence_id = c.id
  WHERE _include_archived OR c.archived_at IS NULL;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_governance_event_types(_organization_id uuid, _workspace_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM _gov_report_assert_scope(_organization_id, _workspace_id);

  WITH eligible_projects AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.organization_id, p.workspace_id
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.organization_id = _organization_id
      AND (_workspace_id IS NULL OR p.workspace_id = _workspace_id)
      AND (_project_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(_project_ids))
      AND (
        is_org_admin(_uid, p.organization_id)
        OR is_workspace_member(_uid, p.workspace_id)
      )
  ),
  cadence_buckets AS (
    SELECT
      c.organization_id, c.workspace_id, c.project_id, c.event_type,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL) AS active_cadence_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL
                          AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
                          AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
                          AND c.next_expected_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_count,
      MIN(CASE WHEN c.archived_at IS NULL
                AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
                AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
              THEN c.next_expected_date END) AS next_expected_date
    FROM governance_cadences c
    WHERE c.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY c.organization_id, c.workspace_id, c.project_id, c.event_type
  ),
  record_buckets AS (
    SELECT
      r.project_id, r.event_type,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL) AS record_count,
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.archived_at IS NULL THEN r.actual_date_held END) AS latest_record_date
    FROM governance_records r
    WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY r.project_id, r.event_type
  ),
  decision_buckets AS (
    SELECT r.project_id, r.event_type, COUNT(d.*) AS decision_count
    FROM governance_records r
    LEFT JOIN governance_record_decisions d
           ON d.governance_record_id = r.id AND d.archived_at IS NULL
    WHERE r.archived_at IS NULL
      AND r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY r.project_id, r.event_type
  ),
  unioned AS (
    SELECT cb.project_id, cb.event_type FROM cadence_buckets cb
    UNION
    SELECT rb.project_id, rb.event_type FROM record_buckets rb
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id',      ep.organization_id,
    'workspace_id',         ep.workspace_id,
    'project_id',           u.project_id,
    'event_type',           u.event_type,
    'active_cadence_count', COALESCE(cb.active_cadence_count, 0),
    'record_count',         COALESCE(rb.record_count, 0),
    'decision_count',       COALESCE(db.decision_count, 0),
    'latest_record_date',   rb.latest_record_date,
    'next_expected_date',   cb.next_expected_date,
    'overdue_count',        COALESCE(cb.overdue_count, 0)
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM unioned u
  JOIN eligible_projects ep ON ep.id = u.project_id
  LEFT JOIN cadence_buckets  cb ON cb.project_id = u.project_id AND cb.event_type = u.event_type
  LEFT JOIN record_buckets   rb ON rb.project_id = u.project_id AND rb.event_type = u.event_type
  LEFT JOIN decision_buckets db ON db.project_id = u.project_id AND db.event_type = u.event_type;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_governance_records(_organization_id uuid, _workspace_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[], _include_archived boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM _gov_report_assert_scope(_organization_id, _workspace_id);

  WITH eligible_projects AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.organization_id, p.workspace_id
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.organization_id = _organization_id
      AND (_workspace_id IS NULL OR p.workspace_id = _workspace_id)
      AND (_project_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(_project_ids))
      AND (
        is_org_admin(_uid, p.organization_id)
        OR is_workspace_member(_uid, p.workspace_id)
      )
  ),
  decisions_per_record AS (
    SELECT d.governance_record_id, COUNT(*) AS decision_count
    FROM governance_record_decisions d
    WHERE d.archived_at IS NULL
      AND d.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY d.governance_record_id
  ),
  links_per_record AS (
    SELECT
      l.governance_record_id,
      COUNT(*)                                                          AS link_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'task')             AS linked_task_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'phase')            AS linked_phase_reference_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'risk')             AS linked_risk_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'blocker')          AS linked_blocker_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'kpi_definition')   AS linked_kpi_definition_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'kpi_update')       AS linked_kpi_update_count
    FROM governance_record_links l
    WHERE l.archived_at IS NULL
      AND l.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY l.governance_record_id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id',              r.organization_id,
    'workspace_id',                 r.workspace_id,
    'project_id',                   r.project_id,
    'record_id',                    r.id,
    'cadence_id',                   r.cadence_id,
    'event_type',                   r.event_type,
    'event_name',                   public.btpm_decrypt(r.event_name, r.organization_id),
    'expected_date_snapshot',       r.expected_date_snapshot,
    'actual_date_held',             r.actual_date_held,
    'was_late',                     CASE
      WHEN r.expected_date_snapshot IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE r.actual_date_held > r.expected_date_snapshot
    END,
    'days_late',                    CASE
      WHEN r.expected_date_snapshot IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE GREATEST(0, (r.actual_date_held - r.expected_date_snapshot))
    END,
    'has_sharepoint_evidence',      (r.sharepoint_evidence_reference IS NOT NULL),
    'has_external_reference_url',   (r.external_reference_url IS NOT NULL),
    'decision_count',               COALESCE(dpr.decision_count, 0),
    'link_count',                   COALESCE(lpr.link_count, 0),
    'linked_task_count',            COALESCE(lpr.linked_task_count, 0),
    'linked_phase_reference_count', COALESCE(lpr.linked_phase_reference_count, 0),
    'linked_risk_count',            COALESCE(lpr.linked_risk_count, 0),
    'linked_blocker_count',         COALESCE(lpr.linked_blocker_count, 0),
    'linked_kpi_definition_count',  COALESCE(lpr.linked_kpi_definition_count, 0),
    'linked_kpi_update_count',      COALESCE(lpr.linked_kpi_update_count, 0),
    'is_archived',                  (r.archived_at IS NOT NULL),
    'archived_at',                  r.archived_at,
    'created_at',                   r.created_at,
    'created_by',                   r.created_by
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM governance_records r
  JOIN eligible_projects ep ON ep.id = r.project_id
  LEFT JOIN decisions_per_record dpr ON dpr.governance_record_id = r.id
  LEFT JOIN links_per_record lpr ON lpr.governance_record_id = r.id
  WHERE _include_archived OR r.archived_at IS NULL;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.report_project_governance_summary(_organization_id uuid, _workspace_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _project_ids uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM _gov_report_assert_scope(_organization_id, _workspace_id);

  WITH eligible_projects AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.organization_id, p.workspace_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) AS project_name
    FROM projects p
    WHERE p.organization_id = _organization_id
      AND (_workspace_id IS NULL OR p.workspace_id = _workspace_id)
      AND (_project_ids IS NULL OR p.id = ANY(_project_ids))
      AND (
        is_org_admin(_uid, p.organization_id)
        OR is_workspace_member(_uid, p.workspace_id)
      )
  ),
  ws AS (
    SELECT w.id, public.btpm_decrypt(w.name, w.organization_id) AS workspace_name
    FROM workspaces w
    WHERE w.organization_id = _organization_id
  ),
  cadence_agg AS (
    SELECT
      c.project_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL)                          AS active_cadence_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NOT NULL)                      AS archived_cadence_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL
                          AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
                          AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
                          AND c.next_expected_date < CURRENT_DATE)           AS overdue_cadence_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL
                          AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
                          AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
                          AND c.next_expected_date >= CURRENT_DATE
                          AND c.next_expected_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days')
                                                                              AS due_soon_cadence_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL AND c.frequency_type = 'ad_hoc')
                                                                              AS ad_hoc_cadence_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.archived_at IS NULL AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc')
                                                                              AS recurring_cadence_count
    FROM governance_cadences c
    WHERE c.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
    GROUP BY c.project_id
  ),
  next_expected AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.project_id)
      c.project_id, c.next_expected_date, c.id AS cadence_id
    FROM governance_cadences c
    WHERE c.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
      AND c.archived_at IS NULL
      AND c.frequency_type <> 'ad_hoc'
      AND c.next_expected_date IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY c.project_id, c.next_expected_date ASC
  ),
  last_completed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.project_id)
      r.project_id, r.actual_date_held, r.id AS record_id
    FROM governance_records r
    WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
      AND r.archived_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY r.project_id, r.actual_date_held DESC, r.created_at DESC
  ),
  record_agg AS (
    SELECT
      r.project_id,
      COUNT(*)                                                                         AS total_record_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.actual_date_held >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days')  AS records_last_30_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.actual_date_held >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')  AS records_last_90_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.sharepoint_evidence_reference IS NULL)                  AS records_missing_sharepoint_evidence_count
    FROM governance_records r
    WHERE r.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
      AND r.archived_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY r.project_id
  ),
  decision_agg AS (
    SELECT d.project_id, COUNT(*) AS decision_count
    FROM governance_record_decisions d
    WHERE d.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
      AND d.archived_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.project_id
  ),
  link_agg AS (
    SELECT
      l.project_id,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'task')           AS linked_task_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'phase')          AS linked_phase_reference_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'risk')           AS linked_risk_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'blocker')        AS linked_blocker_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'kpi_definition') AS linked_kpi_definition_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.linked_object_type = 'kpi_update')     AS linked_kpi_update_count
    FROM governance_record_links l
    WHERE l.project_id IN (SELECT id FROM eligible_projects)
      AND l.archived_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY l.project_id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'organization_id',                          ep.organization_id,
    'workspace_id',                             ep.workspace_id,
    'workspace_name',                           ws.workspace_name,
    'project_id',                               ep.id,
    'project_name',                             ep.project_name,
    'active_cadence_count',                     COALESCE(ca.active_cadence_count, 0),
    'archived_cadence_count',                   COALESCE(ca.archived_cadence_count, 0),
    'overdue_cadence_count',                    COALESCE(ca.overdue_cadence_count, 0),
    'due_soon_cadence_count',                   COALESCE(ca.due_soon_cadence_count, 0),
    'ad_hoc_cadence_count',                     COALESCE(ca.ad_hoc_cadence_count, 0),
    'recurring_cadence_count',                  COALESCE(ca.recurring_cadence_count, 0),
    'next_expected_governance_date',            ne.next_expected_date,
    'next_expected_cadence_id',                 ne.cadence_id,
    'last_completed_governance_date',           lc.actual_date_held,
    'last_completed_record_id',                 lc.record_id,
    'total_governance_record_count',            COALESCE(ra.total_record_count, 0),
    'records_last_30_days',                     COALESCE(ra.records_last_30_days, 0),
    'records_last_90_days',                     COALESCE(ra.records_last_90_days, 0),
    'records_missing_sharepoint_evidence_count',COALESCE(ra.records_missing_sharepoint_evidence_count, 0),
    'decision_count',                           COALESCE(da.decision_count, 0),
    'linked_task_count',                        COALESCE(la.linked_task_count, 0),
    'linked_phase_reference_count',             COALESCE(la.linked_phase_reference_count, 0),
    'linked_risk_count',                        COALESCE(la.linked_risk_count, 0),
    'linked_blocker_count',                     COALESCE(la.linked_blocker_count, 0),
    'linked_kpi_definition_count',              COALESCE(la.linked_kpi_definition_count, 0),
    'linked_kpi_update_count',                  COALESCE(la.linked_kpi_update_count, 0),
    'governance_health_status',                 CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ca.active_cadence_count, 0) = 0
           AND COALESCE(ca.archived_cadence_count, 0) = 0       THEN 'no_cadence'
      WHEN COALESCE(ca.active_cadence_count, 0) = 0
           AND COALESCE(ca.archived_cadence_count, 0) > 0       THEN 'inactive_only'
      WHEN COALESCE(ca.overdue_cadence_count, 0) > 0            THEN 'overdue'
      WHEN COALESCE(ca.due_soon_cadence_count, 0) > 0           THEN 'due_soon'
      WHEN COALESCE(ca.recurring_cadence_count, 0) = 0
           AND COALESCE(ca.ad_hoc_cadence_count, 0) > 0         THEN 'ad_hoc_only'
      ELSE                                                            'on_track'
    END
  )), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO _result
  FROM eligible_projects ep
  LEFT JOIN ws            ON ws.id = ep.workspace_id
  LEFT JOIN cadence_agg   ca ON ca.project_id = ep.id
  LEFT JOIN next_expected ne ON ne.project_id = ep.id
  LEFT JOIN last_completed lc ON lc.project_id = ep.id
  LEFT JOIN record_agg    ra ON ra.project_id = ep.id
  LEFT JOIN decision_agg  da ON da.project_id = ep.id
  LEFT JOIN link_agg      la ON la.project_id = ep.id;

  RETURN _result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_project_id(_target_type text, _target_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE _target_type
    WHEN 'project' THEN _target_id
    WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.phases WHERE id = _target_id)
    WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.tasks  WHERE id = _target_id)
    WHEN 'risk' THEN (
      SELECT CASE r.target_type
        WHEN 'project' THEN r.target_id
        WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.phases WHERE id = r.target_id)
        WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.tasks  WHERE id = r.target_id)
      END FROM public.risks r WHERE r.id = _target_id
    )
    WHEN 'blocker' THEN (
      SELECT CASE b.target_type
        WHEN 'project' THEN b.target_id
        WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.phases WHERE id = b.target_id)
        WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.tasks  WHERE id = b.target_id)
      END FROM public.blockers b WHERE b.id = _target_id
    )
    WHEN 'kpi_definition' THEN (
      SELECT CASE k.target_type
        WHEN 'project' THEN k.target_id
        WHEN 'phase'   THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.phases WHERE id = k.target_id)
        WHEN 'task'    THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.tasks  WHERE id = k.target_id)
      END FROM public.kpi_definitions k WHERE k.id = _target_id
    )
    WHEN 'governance_cadence' THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.governance_cadences WHERE id = _target_id)
    WHEN 'governance_record'  THEN (SELECT project_id FROM public.governance_records  WHERE id = _target_id)
    ELSE NULL
  END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_sharepoint_project_binding(_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(project_binding_id uuid, project_id uuid, workspace_id uuid, organization_id uuid, binding_mode sharepoint_project_binding_mode, binding_status sharepoint_project_binding_status, is_restricted boolean, folder_web_url text, folder_relative_path text, folder_item_id text, effective_site_web_url text, effective_site_id text, effective_library_web_url text, effective_library_id_or_drive_id text, workspace_binding_id uuid, workspace_binding_status sharepoint_workspace_binding_status, last_validated_at timestamp with time zone, last_validation_code text, last_validation_note text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_ws uuid; v_org uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized'; END IF;
  SELECT p.workspace_id, p.organization_id INTO v_ws, v_org
  FROM public.projects p WHERE p.id = _project_id;
  IF v_ws IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'project_not_found'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_project_access(auth.uid(), _project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT pb.id, pb.project_id, pb.workspace_id, pb.organization_id,
    pb.binding_mode, pb.binding_status, pb.is_restricted,
    pb.folder_web_url, pb.folder_relative_path, pb.folder_item_id,
    COALESCE(pb.resolved_site_web_url, wb.site_web_url),
    COALESCE(pb.resolved_site_id, wb.site_id),
    COALESCE(pb.resolved_library_web_url, wb.library_web_url),
    COALESCE(pb.resolved_library_id_or_drive_id, wb.library_id_or_drive_id),
    wb.id, wb.binding_status,
    pb.last_validated_at, pb.last_validation_code, pb.last_validation_note
  FROM public.sharepoint_project_bindings pb
  LEFT JOIN public.sharepoint_workspace_bindings wb
    ON wb.id = pb.workspace_sharepoint_binding_id
  WHERE pb.project_id = _project_id AND pb.binding_status <> 'disabled' LIMIT 1;
END; $function$
