CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_project_people_preset_from_project(_project_id uuid, _name text, _description text DEFAULT NULL::text, _correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, _idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor          uuid := auth.uid();
  v_project        record;
  v_name_norm      text;
  v_desc_norm      text;
  v_dupe_id        uuid;
  v_prior_preset   uuid;
  v_prior_meta     jsonb;
  v_preset_row     public.project_people_presets;
  v_new_preset_id  uuid;
  v_team_count     integer := 0;
  v_int_count      integer := 0;
  v_ext_count      integer := 0;
  v_member_count   integer := 0;
  r                record;
BEGIN
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 1. Authentication
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(v_actor) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status,
      'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
      'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 2. Resolve Project scope server-side (never trust caller)
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT id, workspace_id, organization_id
    INTO v_project
    FROM public.projects
   WHERE id = _project_id
   FOR SHARE;

  IF v_project.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status,
      'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
      'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 3. Authority
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IF NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(v_actor, _project_id)
     OR NOT public.can_write_demo(v_actor, v_project.workspace_id) THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'not_authorized'::public.pmg_command_status,
      'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
      'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
      '{}'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 4. WPP.7 HARDENING: transaction-scoped advisory lock BEFORE replay lookup
  --    Keyed on (command, actor, idempotency_key). Guarantees at most one
  --    concurrent execution per (actor,key) tuple across all sessions, so
  --    the pmg_command_audit replay probe below cannot race a sibling call
  --    that has not yet committed its audit row.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IF _idempotency_key IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(_idempotency_key)) > 0 THEN
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      hashtextextended(
        'save_project_people_preset_from_project|' || v_actor::text || '|' || _idempotency_key,
        0
      )
    );

    -- 4b. Idempotency replay (safe under the advisory lock).
    SELECT (metadata->>'preset_id')::uuid, metadata
      INTO v_prior_preset, v_prior_meta
      FROM public.pmg_command_audit
     WHERE command = 'save_project_people_preset_from_project'
       AND actor_id = v_actor
       AND idempotency_key = _idempotency_key
       AND status = 'applied'::public.pmg_command_status
     ORDER BY created_at DESC
     LIMIT 1;

    IF v_prior_preset IS NOT NULL
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.project_people_presets WHERE id = v_prior_preset) THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'no_change'::public.pmg_command_status,
        'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
        'project_people_preset', v_prior_preset, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', v_prior_preset,
          'workspace_id', v_project.workspace_id,
          'reason', 'idempotent_replay',
          'team_count',        COALESCE((v_prior_meta->>'team_count')::int, 0),
          'stakeholder_count', COALESCE((v_prior_meta->>'stakeholder_count')::int, 0)
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 5. Validate name
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  v_name_norm := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(_name, '')), '');
  v_desc_norm := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(_description, '')), '');
  IF v_name_norm IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status,
      'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
      'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','name_required'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 6. Duplicate active preset name (decrypt+compare)
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FOR r IN
    SELECT id, name
      FROM public.project_people_presets
     WHERE workspace_id = v_project.workspace_id
       AND archived_at IS NULL
     FOR UPDATE
  LOOP
    IF lower(btrim(public.btpm_decrypt(r.name, v_project.organization_id))) = lower(v_name_norm) THEN
      v_dupe_id := r.id;
      EXIT;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF v_dupe_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status,
      'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
      'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','duplicate_name'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 7. Count active source rows
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_team_count
    FROM public.project_team_members WHERE project_id = _project_id;

  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member')::int,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stakeholder_type = 'external')::int
    INTO v_int_count, v_ext_count
    FROM public.project_stakeholders
   WHERE project_id = _project_id AND removed_at IS NULL;

  IF v_team_count = 0 AND v_int_count = 0 AND v_ext_count = 0 THEN
    RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
      'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status,
      'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
      'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
      jsonb_build_object('reason','empty_source'),
      '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END IF;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 8. Transactional creation.
  --    Note: project_stakeholders.external_name and role_label are plaintext
  --    columns (verified in production: no encryption trigger on
  --    project_stakeholders and rows contain human-readable values). Only
  --    project_team_members.role_label is protected under organization_id
  --    and is decrypted below.
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BEGIN
    INSERT INTO public.project_people_presets (
      organization_id, workspace_id, scope_type, name, description, created_by
    ) VALUES (
      v_project.organization_id, v_project.workspace_id, 'workspace',
      v_name_norm, v_desc_norm, v_actor
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_new_preset_id;

    INSERT INTO public.project_people_preset_members (
      preset_id, member_kind, stakeholder_type,
      user_id, external_name, canonical_role_key, role_label
    )
    SELECT
      v_new_preset_id, 'team_member', NULL,
      ptm.user_id, NULL,
      NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(ptm.canonical_role_key, '')), ''),
      NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(public.btpm_decrypt(ptm.role_label, ptm.organization_id), '')), '')
      FROM public.project_team_members ptm
     WHERE ptm.project_id = _project_id;

    INSERT INTO public.project_people_preset_members (
      preset_id, member_kind, stakeholder_type,
      user_id, external_name, canonical_role_key, role_label
    )
    SELECT
      v_new_preset_id, 'stakeholder', 'workspace_member',
      s.user_id, NULL, NULL,
      NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(s.role_label, '')), '')
      FROM public.project_stakeholders s
     WHERE s.project_id = _project_id
       AND s.removed_at IS NULL
       AND s.stakeholder_type = 'workspace_member'
       AND s.user_id IS NOT NULL;

    INSERT INTO public.project_people_preset_members (
      preset_id, member_kind, stakeholder_type,
      user_id, external_name, canonical_role_key, role_label
    )
    SELECT
      v_new_preset_id, 'stakeholder', 'external',
      NULL,
      btrim(s.external_name),
      NULL,
      NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(s.role_label, '')), '')
      FROM public.project_stakeholders s
     WHERE s.project_id = _project_id
       AND s.removed_at IS NULL
       AND s.stakeholder_type = 'external'
       AND s.external_name IS NOT NULL
       AND length(btrim(s.external_name)) > 0;

    SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_member_count
      FROM public.project_people_preset_members
     WHERE preset_id = v_new_preset_id;
  EXCEPTION
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
        'invalid'::public.pmg_command_status,
        'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
        'project_people_preset', NULL, _project_id,
        jsonb_build_object('reason','source_invalid','detail', SQLERRM),
        '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
  END;

  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 9. Audit
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT * INTO v_preset_row FROM public.project_people_presets WHERE id = v_new_preset_id;

  PERFORM public._ppp_record_audit(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status,
    'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
    v_preset_row,
    'project_people_preset', v_new_preset_id,
    _correlation_id, _idempotency_key,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source_project_id',           _project_id,
      'source_workspace_id',         v_project.workspace_id,
      'team_count',                  v_team_count,
      'stakeholder_internal_count',  v_int_count,
      'stakeholder_external_count',  v_ext_count,
      'stakeholder_count',           v_int_count + v_ext_count,
      'member_count',                v_member_count
    )
  );

  RETURN public.pmg_build_result(
    'applied'::public.pmg_command_status,
    'save_project_people_preset_from_project',
    'project_people_preset', v_new_preset_id, _project_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id',                 v_new_preset_id,
      'workspace_id',       v_project.workspace_id,
      'team_count',         v_team_count,
      'stakeholder_count',  v_int_count + v_ext_count,
      'member_count',       v_member_count
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb, NULL);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_workspace_project_deep_matches(_workspace_id uuid, _query text, _include_archived boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_org uuid;
  v_q text;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(v_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;

  SELECT organization_id INTO v_org FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = _workspace_id;
  IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace not found'; END IF;

  IF NOT (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, _workspace_id)
          OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, v_org)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized for this workspace';
  END IF;

  v_q := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(_query), ''), ''));
  IF length(v_q) < 2 THEN
    RETURN '[]'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  WITH accessible AS (
    SELECT p.id AS project_id,
           p.organization_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) AS project_name,
           CASE WHEN p.program_id IS NOT NULL
                THEN public.btpm_decrypt(pr.name, pr.organization_id)
                ELSE NULL END AS program_name
      FROM public.projects p
      LEFT JOIN public.programs pr ON pr.id = p.program_id
     WHERE p.workspace_id = _workspace_id
       AND (_include_archived OR p.is_archived = false)
       AND public.has_project_access(v_uid, p.id)
  ),
  proj_match AS (
    SELECT project_id,
           'project'::text AS type,
           project_name AS label,
           NULL::text AS context_label,
           NULL::uuid AS phase_id,
           NULL::uuid AS task_id
      FROM accessible
     WHERE lower(COALESCE(project_name,'')) LIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
  ),
  prog_match AS (
    SELECT project_id,
           'program'::text AS type,
           program_name AS label,
           NULL::text AS context_label,
           NULL::uuid AS phase_id,
           NULL::uuid AS task_id
      FROM accessible
     WHERE program_name IS NOT NULL
       AND lower(program_name) LIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
  ),
  phase_match AS (
    SELECT a.project_id,
           'phase'::text AS type,
           public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id) AS label,
           a.project_name AS context_label,
           ph.id AS phase_id,
           NULL::uuid AS task_id
      FROM public.phases ph
      JOIN accessible a ON a.project_id = ph.project_id
     WHERE lower(COALESCE(public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id),''))
           LIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
  ),
  task_match AS (
    SELECT a.project_id,
           'task'::text AS type,
           public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id) AS label,
           public.btpm_decrypt(ph.name, ph.organization_id) AS context_label,
           t.phase_id,
           t.id AS task_id
      FROM public.tasks t
      JOIN public.phases ph ON ph.id = t.phase_id
      JOIN accessible a ON a.project_id = t.project_id
     WHERE lower(COALESCE(public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id),''))
           LIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
  ),
  all_matches AS (
    SELECT * FROM proj_match
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM prog_match
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM phase_match
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM task_match
  ),
  grouped AS (
    SELECT project_id,
           COUNT(*) AS match_count,
           jsonb_agg(
             jsonb_build_object(
               'type', type,
               'label', label,
               'context_label', context_label,
               'phase_id', phase_id,
               'task_id', task_id
             )
             ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'project' THEN 0 WHEN 'program' THEN 1 WHEN 'phase' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
           ) AS matches
      FROM all_matches
     GROUP BY project_id
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'project_id', project_id,
           'match_count', match_count,
           'matches', matches
         )), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_result
    FROM grouped;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_workspace_reference_targets(_workspace_id uuid, _query text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_org uuid;
  v_q text;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(v_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;

  SELECT organization_id INTO v_org FROM public.workspaces WHERE id = _workspace_id;
  IF v_org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace not found'; END IF;

  IF NOT (public.is_workspace_member(v_uid, _workspace_id)
          OR public.is_org_admin(v_uid, v_org)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized for this workspace';
  END IF;

  v_q := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(_query), ''), ''));

  WITH proj AS (
    SELECT 'project'::text AS target_type,
           p.id AS target_id,
           p.workspace_id,
           p.id AS project_id,
           NULL::uuid AS phase_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(p.name, p.organization_id) AS display_label,
           NULL::text AS context_label,
           p.updated_at
      FROM public.projects p
     WHERE p.workspace_id = _workspace_id
       AND p.is_archived = false
  ),
  ph AS (
    SELECT 'phase'::text AS target_type,
           x.id AS target_id,
           x.workspace_id,
           x.project_id,
           NULL::uuid AS phase_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(x.name, x.organization_id) AS display_label,
           public.btpm_decrypt(p2.name, p2.organization_id) AS context_label,
           x.updated_at
      FROM public.phases x
      JOIN public.projects p2 ON p2.id = x.project_id
     WHERE x.workspace_id = _workspace_id
       AND x.is_archived = false
  ),
  tk AS (
    SELECT 'task'::text AS target_type,
           t.id AS target_id,
           t.workspace_id,
           t.project_id,
           t.phase_id,
           public.btpm_decrypt(t.name, t.organization_id) AS display_label,
           public.btpm_decrypt(p3.name, p3.organization_id)
             || ' › ' ||
             public.btpm_decrypt(ph2.name, ph2.organization_id) AS context_label,
           t.updated_at
      FROM public.tasks t
      JOIN public.projects p3 ON p3.id = t.project_id
      JOIN public.phases   ph2 ON ph2.id = t.phase_id
     WHERE t.workspace_id = _workspace_id
  ),
  combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM proj
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ph
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM tk
  ),
  filtered AS (
    SELECT *
      FROM combined
     WHERE v_q = '' OR lower(COALESCE(display_label,'')) LIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
                    OR lower(COALESCE(context_label,'')) LIKE '%' || v_q || '%'
     ORDER BY
       CASE target_type WHEN 'project' THEN 0 WHEN 'phase' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
       updated_at DESC
     LIMIT 25
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'target_type', target_type,
           'target_id', target_id,
           'workspace_id', workspace_id,
           'project_id', project_id,
           'phase_id', phase_id,
           'display_label', display_label,
           'context_label', context_label
         )), '[]'::jsonb)
    INTO v_result
    FROM filtered;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_admin_get_integration_detail(_integration_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _ti public.tenant_integrations;
  _secrets jsonb;
  _matrix jsonb;
  _key_count int;
BEGIN
  IF _integration_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'integration_id is required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO _ti FROM public.tenant_integrations WHERE id = _integration_id;
  IF _ti.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'integration not found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_caller(_ti.tenant_id);

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(s) ORDER BY s.secret_scope, s.secret_name), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _secrets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      r.id AS secret_ref_id,
      r.secret_name,
      r.secret_kind,
      r.secret_scope::text AS secret_scope,
      r.status::text AS status,
      r.organization_id,
      o.name AS organization_name,
      r.updated_at,
      r.rotated_at,
      r.disabled_at,
      r.revoked_at
    FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r
    LEFT JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = r.organization_id
    WHERE r.integration_id = _ti.id
  ) s;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(m) ORDER BY m.organization_name), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _matrix
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.id AS organization_id,
      o.name AS organization_name,
      o.slug AS organization_slug,
      o.organization_kind::text AS organization_kind,
      o.environment_role::text AS environment_role,
      (o.environment_role = 'production') AS is_production,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
         WHERE oso.integration_id = _ti.id AND oso.organization_id = o.id) AS override_count,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
         WHERE oso.integration_id = _ti.id AND oso.organization_id = o.id AND oso.is_disabled = true) AS disabled_override_count,
      CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
                     WHERE oso.integration_id = _ti.id AND oso.organization_id = o.id AND oso.is_disabled = true)
          THEN 'disabled'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
                     WHERE oso.integration_id = _ti.id AND oso.organization_id = o.id AND oso.is_disabled = false)
          THEN 'organization_override'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r
                     WHERE r.integration_id = _ti.id AND r.secret_scope = 'tenant' AND r.status = 'active')
          THEN 'tenant_default'
        ELSE 'missing'
      END AS effective_source
    FROM public.organizations o
    WHERE o.tenant_id = _ti.tenant_id
  ) m;

  _key_count := CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(_ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) = 'object'
      THEN (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM jsonb_object_keys(COALESCE(_ti.config_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)))
    ELSE 0
  END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'integration', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', _ti.id,
      'tenant_id', _ti.tenant_id,
      'kind', _ti.kind::text,
      'name', _ti.name,
      'status', _ti.status::text,
      'is_enabled', _ti.is_enabled,
      'has_config_metadata', (_key_count > 0),
      'config_metadata_key_count', _key_count,
      'last_tested_at', _ti.last_tested_at,
      'last_success_at', _ti.last_success_at,
      'last_error_at', _ti.last_error_at,
      'last_error_message', _ti.last_error_message,
      'created_at', _ti.created_at,
      'updated_at', _ti.updated_at,
      'tenant_active_secret_count',
        (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r
          WHERE r.integration_id = _ti.id AND r.secret_scope = 'tenant' AND r.status = 'active')
    ),
    'secrets', _secrets,
    'organization_matrix', _matrix
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_admin_get_organization_detail(_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _o public.organizations;
  _tenant_name text;
  _default_org_id uuid;
  _is_prod boolean;
  _workspace_count int;
  _org_admin_count int;
  _integrations jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _organization_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'organization_id is required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO _o FROM public.organizations WHERE id = _organization_id;
  IF _o.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'organization not found' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_caller(_o.tenant_id);

  SELECT name, default_organization_id INTO _tenant_name, _default_org_id
    FROM public.tenants WHERE id = _o.tenant_id;

  _is_prod := (_o.environment_role = 'production');

  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO _workspace_count
    FROM public.workspaces w
   WHERE w.organization_id = _o.id AND w.is_archived = false;

  -- 4D.10A.1 fix: correct enum value is `org_admin`, not `organization_admin`.
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO _org_admin_count
    FROM public.organization_memberships om
   WHERE om.organization_id = _o.id
     AND om.status = 'active'
     AND om.role = 'org_admin'::public.organization_role;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::jsonb) INTO _integrations
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ti.id AS integration_id,
      ti.kind::text AS kind,
      ti.name,
      ti.status::text AS status,
      ti.is_enabled,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r
        WHERE r.integration_id = ti.id AND r.secret_scope = 'tenant' AND r.status = 'active') AS tenant_active_secret_count,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
        WHERE oso.integration_id = ti.id AND oso.organization_id = _o.id) AS override_count,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
        WHERE oso.integration_id = ti.id AND oso.organization_id = _o.id AND oso.is_disabled = true) AS disabled_override_count,
      (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public.organization_secret_overrides oso
        WHERE oso.integration_id = ti.id AND oso.organization_id = _o.id AND oso.is_disabled = false) AS active_override_count
    FROM public.tenant_integrations ti
    WHERE ti.tenant_id = _o.tenant_id
    ORDER BY ti.kind::text, ti.name
  ) x;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'organization', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', _o.id,
      'tenant_id', _o.tenant_id,
      'tenant_name', _tenant_name,
      'name', _o.name,
      'slug', _o.slug,
      'organization_kind', _o.organization_kind::text,
      'environment_role', _o.environment_role::text,
      'is_default', (_o.id = _default_org_id),
      'created_at', _o.created_at,
      'updated_at', _o.updated_at
    ),
    'environment_safety', jsonb_build_object(
      'is_production', _is_prod,
      'outbound_email', _is_prod,
      'external_api_write', _is_prod,
      'real_integration', _is_prod,
      'export', true,
      'export_without_watermark', _is_prod,
      'storage_write', true,
      'background_job_enqueue', true
    ),
    'workspace_count', _workspace_count,
    'org_admin_count', _org_admin_count,
    'integrations', _integrations
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_admin_get_overview(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _t record;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_caller(_tenant_id);

  SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.status::text AS status, t.default_organization_id,
         def.name AS default_organization_name

  FROM public.tenants t
  LEFT JOIN public.organizations def ON def.id = t.default_organization_id
  WHERE t.id = _tenant_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'tenant', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', _t.id,
      'name', _t.name,
      'slug', _t.slug,
      'status', _t.status,
      'default_organization_id', _t.default_organization_id,
      'default_organization_name', _t.default_organization_name
    ),
    'counts', jsonb_build_object(
      'organizations',        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.organizations o WHERE o.tenant_id = _tenant_id),
      'active_members',       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_memberships tm WHERE tm.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND tm.status = 'active'),
      'admins',               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_memberships tm WHERE tm.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND tm.status = 'active' AND tm.role IN ('tenant_owner','tenant_admin')),
      'integrations',         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_integrations ti WHERE ti.tenant_id = _tenant_id),
      'integrations_enabled', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_integrations ti WHERE ti.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND ti.is_enabled = true),
      'storage_objects',      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_storage_objects s WHERE s.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL),
      'export_packages',      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_export_packages e WHERE e.tenant_id = _tenant_id),
      'jobs_queued',          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_background_jobs j WHERE j.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND j.status = 'queued'),
      'jobs_running',         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_background_jobs j WHERE j.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND j.status = 'running'),
      'jobs_failed',          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tenant_background_jobs j WHERE j.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND j.status = 'failed')
    ),
    'generated_at', now()
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_admin_list_integration_secret_metadata(_integration_id uuid, _organization_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(integration_id uuid, organization_id uuid, organization_name text, secret_name text, secret_kind text, secret_scope text, status text, rotated_at timestamp with time zone, disabled_at timestamp with time zone, revoked_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _integ public.tenant_integrations;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _integ FROM public.tenant_integrations WHERE id = _integration_id;
  IF _integ.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Integration % not found', _integration_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF NOT public.is_tenant_admin(_integ.tenant_id, auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only Tenant Admin may read integration secret metadata for tenant %', _integ.tenant_id
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF _organization_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.organizations
     WHERE id = _organization_id AND tenant_id = _integ.tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Organization % does not belong to tenant %', _organization_id, _integ.tenant_id
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
    SELECT r.integration_id, r.organization_id, o.name AS organization_name,
           r.secret_name, r.secret_kind,
           r.secret_scope::text, r.status::text,
           r.rotated_at, r.disabled_at, r.revoked_at, r.updated_at, r.created_at
      FROM public.tenant_secret_refs r
      LEFT JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id = r.organization_id
     WHERE r.integration_id = _integ.id
       AND (
         _organization_id IS NULL
         OR (r.secret_scope = 'organization_override' AND r.organization_id = _organization_id)
         OR (r.secret_scope = 'tenant')
       )
     ORDER BY r.secret_scope::text, r.secret_name, o.name NULLS FIRST;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_admin_list_members(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(membership_id uuid, user_id uuid, display_name text, email text, role text, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, deactivated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_caller(_tenant_id);
  RETURN QUERY
  -- Actual tenant memberships
  SELECT
    tm.id                                                   AS membership_id,
    tm.user_id                                              AS user_id,
    CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
         THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
         ELSE p.display_name END                            AS display_name,
    p.email                                                 AS email,
    tm.role::text                                           AS role,
    tm.status::text                                         AS status,
    tm.created_at                                           AS created_at,
    tm.deactivated_at                                       AS deactivated_at
  FROM public.tenant_memberships tm
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = tm.user_id
  WHERE tm.tenant_id = _tenant_id

  UNION ALL

  -- Pending invitations that target this tenant (not yet accepted / not expired /
  -- not revoked) and whose email is not already an active tenant member.
  SELECT
    i.id                                                    AS membership_id,
    NULL::uuid                                              AS user_id,
    NULL::text                                              AS display_name,
    i.email                                                 AS email,
    COALESCE(i.tenant_role::text, 'tenant_member')          AS role,
    'pending'::text                                         AS status,
    i.created_at                                            AS created_at,
    NULL::timestamptz                                       AS deactivated_at
  FROM public.invitations i
  WHERE i.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    AND i.status = 'pending'
    AND i.expires_at > now()
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.tenant_memberships tm2
      JOIN public.profiles p2 ON p2.id = tm2.user_id
      WHERE tm2.tenant_id = _tenant_id
        AND tm2.status = 'active'
        AND lower(p2.email) = lower(i.email)
    )
  ORDER BY 6 DESC, 5, 4 NULLS LAST;  -- status desc (active/pending), role, email
END;
$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _tid uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT tenant_id INTO _tid FROM public.organizations WHERE id=_organization_id;
  IF _tid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'organization_not_found' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  PERFORM public._assert_tenant_admin_caller(_tid);
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT tm.user_id,
         CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
              THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
              ELSE p.display_name END AS dn,
         p.email,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_memberships om
           WHERE om.organization_id=_organization_id AND om.user_id=tm.user_id AND om.status='active'
         )
  FROM public.tenant_memberships tm
  LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=tm.user_id
  WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tid AND tm.status='active'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_memberships om
      WHERE om.organization_id=_organization_id AND om.user_id=tm.user_id
        AND om.role='org_admin' AND om.status='active'
    )
    AND (_query IS NULL OR _query='' OR p.email ILIKE '%'||_query||'%' OR
         (CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL
               THEN public.btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
               ELSE p.display_name END) ILIKE '%'||_query||'%')
  ORDER BY dn NULLS LAST, p.email NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 50;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_adoption_initiative(_initiative_id uuid, _name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _status adoption_initiative_status DEFAULT NULL::adoption_initiative_status, _priority pm_priority DEFAULT NULL::pm_priority, _target_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, _sort_order integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, _set_name boolean DEFAULT false, _set_owner boolean DEFAULT false, _set_target_date boolean DEFAULT false, _set_summary boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _org uuid; _ws uuid; _proj uuid; _uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
  IF _uid IS NULL OR NOT public.is_active_user(_uid) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated'; END IF;
  SELECT organization_id, workspace_id, project_id INTO _org, _ws, _proj
  FROM public.adoption_initiatives WHERE id = _initiative_id;
  IF _org IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_initiative'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_pm_authority(_uid, _ws) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden'; END IF;

  UPDATE public.adoption_initiatives SET
    name = CASE WHEN _set_name THEN COALESCE(_name, name) ELSE name END,
    owner_id = CASE WHEN _set_owner THEN _owner_id ELSE owner_id END,
    status = COALESCE(_status, status),
    priority = COALESCE(_priority, priority),
    target_date = CASE WHEN _set_target_date THEN _target_date ELSE target_date END,
    summary = CASE WHEN _set_summary THEN _summary ELSE summary END,
    sort_order = COALESCE(_sort_order, sort_order),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = _initiative_id;

  PERFORM public.log_activity_event(
    _organization_id => _org, _actor_id => _uid,
    _event_type => 'adoption_initiative_updated',
    _target_type => 'project', _target_id => _proj,
    _metadata => jsonb_build_object('adoption_initiative_id', _initiative_id),
    _workspace_id => _ws
  );
  RETURN _initiative_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_governance_cadence(_cadence_id uuid, _event_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _frequency_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _event_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _next_expected_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _expected_evidence_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _clear_event_name boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_owner boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_next_expected_date boolean DEFAULT false, _clear_expected_evidence_type boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE _row governance_cadences%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO _row FROM governance_cadences WHERE id = _cadence_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cadence not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002'; END IF;
  PERFORM _gov_assert_project_write(_row.project_id);
  UPDATE governance_cadences SET
    event_type = COALESCE(_event_type, event_type),
    frequency_type = COALESCE(_frequency_type, frequency_type),
    event_name = CASE WHEN _clear_event_name THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(_event_name, event_name) END,
    owner_id = CASE WHEN _clear_owner THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(_owner_id, owner_id) END,
    next_expected_date = CASE WHEN _clear_next_expected_date THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(_next_expected_date, next_expected_date) END,
    expected_evidence_type = CASE WHEN _clear_expected_evidence_type THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(_expected_evidence_type, expected_evidence_type) END,
    updated_at = now(),
    updated_by = auth.uid()
  WHERE id = _cadence_id;
  PERFORM log_activity_event(_row.organization_id, auth.uid(),
    'governance_cadence_updated', 'governance_cadence', _cadence_id,
    jsonb_build_object('project_id', _row.project_id), _row.workspace_id);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_project_benefit(_benefit_id uuid, _benefit_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, _metric_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, _unit_of_measure text DEFAULT NULL::text, _target_value numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, _realization_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, _custom_benefit_type_label text DEFAULT NULL::text, _clear_custom_benefit_type_label boolean DEFAULT false, _description text DEFAULT NULL::text, _clear_description boolean DEFAULT false, _baseline_value numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, _clear_baseline_value boolean DEFAULT false, _actual_value numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, _clear_actual_value boolean DEFAULT false, _benefit_owner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _clear_benefit_owner_id boolean DEFAULT false, _expected_realization_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _clear_expected_realization_date boolean DEFAULT false, _actual_realization_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, _clear_actual_realization_date boolean DEFAULT false, _evidence_note text DEFAULT NULL::text, _clear_evidence_note boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _b public.project_benefits%ROWTYPE;
  _proj_status text;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO _b FROM public.project_benefits WHERE id = _benefit_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Benefit not found' USING ERRCODE='P0002';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.has_project_pm_authority(auth.uid(), _b.project_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Project-edit authority required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT status::text INTO _proj_status FROM public.projects WHERE id = _b.project_id;

  UPDATE public.project_benefits SET
    benefit_type = COALESCE(_benefit_type, benefit_type),
    metric_name = CASE
      WHEN _metric_name IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(_metric_name)) > 0
      THEN btrim(_metric_name) ELSE metric_name END,
    unit_of_measure = CASE
      WHEN _unit_of_measure IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(_unit_of_measure)) > 0
      THEN btrim(_unit_of_measure) ELSE unit_of_measure END,
    target_value = COALESCE(_target_value, target_value),
    realization_status = COALESCE(_realization_status, realization_status),
    custom_benefit_type_label = CASE
      WHEN _clear_custom_benefit_type_label THEN NULL
      WHEN _custom_benefit_type_label IS NOT NULL
        THEN NULLIF(btrim(_custom_benefit_type_label), '')
      ELSE custom_benefit_type_label END,
    description = CASE
      WHEN _clear_description THEN NULL
      WHEN _description IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(btrim(_description), '')
      ELSE description END,
    baseline_value = CASE
      WHEN _clear_baseline_value THEN NULL
      WHEN _baseline_value IS NOT NULL THEN _baseline_value
      ELSE baseline_value END,
    actual_value = CASE
      WHEN _clear_actual_value THEN NULL
      WHEN _actual_value IS NOT NULL THEN _actual_value
      ELSE actual_value END,
    benefit_owner_id = CASE
      WHEN _clear_benefit_owner_id THEN NULL
      WHEN _benefit_owner_id IS NOT NULL THEN _benefit_owner_id
      ELSE benefit_owner_id END,
    expected_realization_date = CASE
      WHEN _clear_expected_realization_date THEN NULL
      WHEN _expected_realization_date IS NOT NULL THEN _expected_realization_date
      ELSE expected_realization_date END,
    actual_realization_date = CASE
      WHEN _clear_actual_realization_date THEN NULL
      WHEN _actual_realization_date IS NOT NULL THEN _actual_realization_date
      ELSE actual_realization_date END,
    evidence_note = CASE
      WHEN _clear_evidence_note THEN NULL
      WHEN _evidence_note IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(btrim(_evidence_note), '')
      ELSE evidence_note END,
    updated_by = auth.uid(),
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = _benefit_id;

  PERFORM public.log_activity_event(
    _b.organization_id, auth.uid(),
    CASE WHEN _proj_status IN ('completed','cancelled')
         THEN 'project_benefit_updated_post_closure'
         ELSE 'project_benefit_updated' END,
    'project_benefit', _benefit_id,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'project_id', _b.project_id,
      'project_status_at_event', _proj_status,
      'post_closure', (_proj_status IN ('completed','cancelled'))
    ),
    _b.workspace_id);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ws_list_add_member_candidates(_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_org_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated';
  END IF;

  SELECT w.organization_id INTO v_org_id
  FROM public.workspaces w WHERE w.id = _workspace_id;
  IF v_org_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace not found';
  END IF;

  IF NOT (public.is_org_admin(auth.uid(), v_org_id)
          OR public.is_workspace_admin_or_higher(auth.uid(), _workspace_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: workspace admin or org admin required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id AS user_id,
    CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND p.display_name IS NOT NULL
         THEN btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
         ELSE p.display_name END AS display_name,
    CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND p.email IS NOT NULL
         THEN btpm_decrypt(p.email, p.organization_id)
         ELSE p.email END AS email
  FROM public.profiles p
  WHERE p.organization_id = v_org_id
    AND p.is_active = true
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_memberships wm
      WHERE wm.workspace_id = _workspace_id AND wm.user_id = p.id
    )
  ORDER BY display_name NULLS LAST, email;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ws_list_members(_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, email text, workspace_role text, is_active boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_read_demo_or_member(auth.uid(), _workspace_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied: not a workspace member or org admin';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    p.id AS user_id,
    CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND p.display_name IS NOT NULL
         THEN btpm_decrypt(p.display_name, p.organization_id)
         ELSE p.display_name END AS display_name,
    CASE WHEN p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND p.email IS NOT NULL
         THEN btpm_decrypt(p.email, p.organization_id)
         ELSE p.email END AS email,
    (SELECT ur.role::text FROM public.user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id = p.id AND ur.workspace_id = _workspace_id ORDER BY CASE ur.role WHEN 'workspace_admin' THEN 1 WHEN 'project_manager' THEN 2 WHEN 'contributor' THEN 3 WHEN 'viewer' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END LIMIT 1) AS workspace_role,
    p.is_active
  FROM public.workspace_memberships wm JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id = wm.user_id
  WHERE wm.workspace_id = _workspace_id ORDER BY p.display_name NULLS LAST, p.email;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ws_list_pending_invitations(_workspace_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, email text, role text, invited_at timestamp with time zone, expires_at timestamp with time zone, is_expired boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_active_user(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account is deactivated'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.is_workspace_admin_or_higher(auth.uid(), _workspace_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied'; END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT inv.id, inv.email, inv.role::text, inv.created_at AS invited_at, inv.expires_at, (inv.expires_at <= now()) AS is_expired
  FROM public.invitations inv WHERE inv.workspace_id = _workspace_id AND inv.status = 'pending' ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC;
END;
$function$
